products.name: pdk
products.description: Process Design Kit (PDK) master record defining the foundry-specific design rules, device models, standard cell libraries, and technology files required for IC design at a given process node. Captures PDK version, foundry name, process node (e.g., 3nm, 5nm, 7nm), SPICE model sets, DRC/LVS rule decks, layer stack definitions, and EDA tool compatibility matrix. SSOT for PDK versioning used in Cadence Virtuoso and Synopsys Design Compiler flows.

attributes.name: pdk_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the PDK master record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for all downstream joins and lineage tracking.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.process_node. Business justification: Ensures alignment of PDKs with official process‑node definitions for compliance, cost, and yield analysis in engineering reports.

attributes.name: agile_plm_part_number
attributes.description: Part number assigned to this PDK in Oracle Agile PLM for product data and change management. Used to track PDK-related Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and Product Change Notifications (PCNs).

attributes.name: checksum_sha256

attributes.name: pdk_code

attributes.name: layer_stack_definition

attributes.name: license_type

attributes.name: lithography_type

attributes.name: min_supply_voltage_v

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_supported

attributes.name: pdk_name

attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SEMI Standards

products.name: rtl_specification
products.description: Register Transfer Level (RTL) design specification and source record capturing the functional hardware description of a design block, IP subsystem, or full chip. Tracks RTL module hierarchy, HDL language (VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog, Chisel), design intent documentation, clock domain definitions and CDC boundary annotations, reset strategy, interface protocols (AXI, AHB, APB, Wishbone), power domain definitions (UPF/CPF), functional coverage model targets, lint rule compliance status, and linkage to the parent IC design project. For analog/mixed-signal blocks, captures behavioral model references (Verilog-AMS, VHDL-AMS) and links to transistor-level schematic source in Cadence Virtuoso where applicable. For FPGA targets, captures synthesis constraints, pin assignments, and target device family. Managed as a versioned artifact in revision control (Git, Perforce) with provenance tracking through Siemens Teamcenter PLM.

attributes.name: rtl_specification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the RTL specification record in the lakehouse. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; IEEE Std 1364 (Verilog); IEEE Std 1076 (VHDL)

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the responsible design engineer or RTL architect who owns this specification. Used for accountability, review routing, and workforce planning in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: license_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IP license agreement governing the use of third-party or licensed IP content within this RTL specification. Populated when ip_reuse_source is 'licensed_third_party'. Supports IP compliance and NRE cost tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; ITAR; EAR; IEEE Std 1800

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) shuttle run assigned for prototype fabrication of this RTL design. MPW shuttles allow multiple designs to share a single wafer to reduce NRE costs for early silicon validation.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Camstar MES; SAP S/4HANA (PP)

attributes.name: primary_ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: FK to design.ic_design_project.ic_design_project_id — RTL specifications are created within the context of an IC design project. This is a mandatory parent-child relationship required for design hierarchy navigation.

attributes.name: product_spec_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_spec. Business justification: Supports validation and regulatory compliance: ties each RTL spec to the authoritative product specification used in safety and performance certification.

attributes.name: to_ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: FK to design.ic_design_project.ic_design_project_id — Every RTL specification belongs to exactly one IC design project. This is the fundamental parent-child relationship for design artifacts. Engineers navigate from project to RTL modules daily.

attributes.name: ams_behavioral_model_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or path to the Verilog-AMS or VHDL-AMS behavioral model associated with this analog/mixed-signal RTL block. Populated only when is_analog_mixed_signal is True. Links to the Cadence Virtuoso schematic source.

attributes.name: cdc_annotation_status
attributes.description: Completion status of Clock Domain Crossing (CDC) boundary annotations within the RTL specification. CDC annotation is mandatory for multi-clock designs prior to synthesis sign-off to prevent metastability failures.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1800; Synopsys Design Compiler; JEDEC

attributes.name: clock_domain_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct clock domains defined within this RTL design block. Drives Clock Domain Crossing (CDC) analysis requirements and verification complexity estimation.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1800; Synopsys Design Compiler; Cadence Innovus

attributes.name: commit_hash
attributes.description: The specific commit hash or changelist number in the revision control system corresponding to the approved version of this RTL specification. Provides immutable provenance linkage to the exact source snapshot.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RTL specification record was first created in the system of record. Provides audit trail for design provenance and compliance with ISO 9001 design record retention requirements.

attributes.name: design_block_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the RTL design block, IP subsystem, or full-chip entity described by this specification (e.g., 'USB3_PHY_Controller', 'DDR5_Memory_Interface', 'Top_Level_SoC'). Serves as the primary identity label for the design artifact.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1364; IEEE Std 1800 (SystemVerilog); Cadence Virtuoso

attributes.name: design_block_type
attributes.description: Classification of the RTL design block scope. Determines applicable design rules, verification methodology, and integration requirements. 'ip_core' blocks are subject to IP licensing tracking; 'fpga_target' blocks require device-specific synthesis constraints. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: full_chip|subsystem|ip_core|interface_block|analog_mixed_signal|fpga_target — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1800; JEDEC; Cadence Virtuoso and Innovus

attributes.name: design_intent_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the functional design intent, architectural decisions, and key requirements captured in this RTL specification. Provides context for design reviews, IP reuse assessments, and new engineer onboarding.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; IEEE Std 1800; ISO 9001

attributes.name: dfm_rule_set_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design for Manufacturability (DFM) Rule Set Version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Design for Manufacturability (DFM) rule set applied to this RTL specification. DFM rules ensure the design can be reliably manufactured at the target process node with acceptable yield.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Cadence Innovus; Synopsys Design Compiler

tag_set.value: Design for Manufacturability (DFM) Rule Set Version

attributes.name: dft_strategy
attributes.description: Design for Testability (DFT) methodology applied to this RTL block. Defines the test insertion approach used to enable Automatic Test Pattern Generation (ATPG) and silicon test coverage on Automatic Test Equipment (ATE).
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1149.1 (JTAG/Boundary Scan); JEDEC; Synopsys Design Compiler

attributes.name: ear_eccn_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN)
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) assigned to this RTL specification under the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Determines export licensing requirements for cross-border transfer of design data.
attributes.references: BIS/EAR (15 CFR Parts 730-774); ITAR; CHIPS Act Compliance

tag_set.value: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN)

attributes.name: fpga_device_family
attributes.business_glossary_term: Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) Target Device Family
attributes.description: Target FPGA device family for synthesis and implementation (e.g., 'Xilinx Ultrascale+', 'Intel Agilex', 'Lattice ECP5'). Populated only when is_fpga_target is True. Determines device-specific synthesis constraints and IP primitives.
attributes.references: JEDEC; IEEE Std 1364; Synopsys Design Compiler

tag_set.value: Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) Target Device Family

attributes.name: functional_coverage_target_pct
attributes.description: Target functional coverage percentage defined in the verification plan for this RTL specification. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Used to gate simulation sign-off and tapeout readiness reviews.

attributes.name: hdl_language
attributes.description: Primary Hardware Description Language used to author the RTL source code for this design block. Determines EDA tool compatibility, lint rule sets, and synthesis flow configuration in Synopsys Design Compiler.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1364 (Verilog); IEEE Std 1800 (SystemVerilog); IEEE Std 1076 (VHDL); JEDEC

attributes.name: interface_protocols
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of hardware interface protocols implemented in this RTL block (e.g., 'AXI4, AHB5, APB3, Wishbone, PCIe, USB3'). Used for integration compatibility checks and IP reuse assessments.
attributes.references: AMBA AXI Specification (ARM); IEEE Std 1149.1; JEDEC

attributes.name: ip_reuse_source
attributes.description: Origin classification of the IP content in this RTL specification. 'licensed_third_party' requires IP license compliance tracking; 'open_source' requires license obligation management (e.g., GPL, Apache); 'internal' indicates proprietary reuse. Classified confidential due to IP licensing sensitivity.
attributes.references: ITAR; EAR; IEEE Std 1800; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: is_analog_mixed_signal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RTL specification includes analog or mixed-signal content requiring behavioral model references (Verilog-AMS, VHDL-AMS) and linkage to transistor-level schematic source in Cadence Virtuoso.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1076.1 (VHDL-AMS); Cadence Virtuoso; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: is_fpga_target
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RTL specification is intended for FPGA implementation rather than ASIC tapeout. When True, synthesis constraints, pin assignments, and target device family fields are applicable.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1364; JEDEC; Synopsys Design Compiler

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RTL specification is subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) export controls. When True, access must be restricted to authorized US persons and export license requirements apply.
attributes.references: ITAR (22 CFR Parts 120-130); BIS/EAR; US Department of State

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Indicator

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this RTL specification record. Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: lint_compliance_status
attributes.description: Status of RTL lint rule compliance checks for this specification. Lint tools (e.g., Synopsys SpyGlass, Cadence HAL) enforce coding guidelines and detect potential design errors. 'clean' is required before synthesis sign-off.
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Compiler; IEEE Std 1800; ISO 9001

attributes.name: logic_gate_count_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated number of equivalent logic gates for this RTL design block, derived from synthesis estimation runs in Synopsys Design Compiler. Used for area budgeting, floorplanning, and Power-Performance-Area (PPA) target setting.
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Compiler; Cadence Innovus; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: nre_cost_usd
attributes.description: Estimated Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) cost in US dollars associated with developing this RTL specification. Used for project budgeting, customer design-in pricing, and financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA CO module.

attributes.name: obsolescence_date
attributes.description: Date on which this RTL specification was marked obsolete, typically superseded by a newer version or upon product End of Life (EOL). Supports Product Change Notification (PCN) and Last Time Buy (LTB) processes.

attributes.name: pdk_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Process Design Kit (PDK) library set used for this RTL specification. The PDK defines technology-specific design rules, device models, and standard cell libraries. Critical for reproducibility and tapeout readiness.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Cadence Virtuoso; Synopsys Design Compiler

attributes.name: power_domain_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct power domains defined in the Unified Power Format (UPF) or Common Power Format (CPF) specification for this RTL block. Drives low-power verification and power intent analysis.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1801 (UPF); Cadence Innovus; Synopsys Design Compiler

attributes.name: power_intent_format
attributes.description: Standard format used to specify power intent for this RTL design block. UPF (IEEE 1801) and CPF (Cadence) are the two industry standards. 'none' indicates no multi-voltage power management is implemented.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1801 (UPF); Cadence Innovus; Synopsys Design Compiler

attributes.name: repository_path
attributes.description: Full path or URL to the revision control repository location where the RTL source files for this specification are stored (e.g., Git remote URL or Perforce depot path). Classified confidential as it reveals internal IP infrastructure.

attributes.name: reset_strategy
attributes.description: Reset architecture employed in this RTL design block. Defines whether resets are synchronous, asynchronous, or mixed, which impacts timing closure, DFT scan insertion, and silicon reliability.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1800; Synopsys Design Compiler; JEDEC

attributes.name: revision_control_system
attributes.description: Version control system in which the RTL source files for this specification are managed. Enables provenance tracking and audit trail for design changes.

attributes.name: specification_approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this RTL specification was formally approved through the PLM design review process. Marks the effective start of the specification as a binding design baseline. Required for ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 design record compliance.

attributes.name: specification_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the RTL specification artifact as tracked in Siemens Teamcenter PLM and revision control systems (Git, Perforce). Used for cross-system traceability and design review references.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: specification_released_date
attributes.description: Date on which this RTL specification was released for downstream use (synthesis, physical design, verification). Distinct from approval date; release may follow approval after additional sign-off steps.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; ISO 9001

attributes.name: specification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the RTL specification artifact within the PLM workflow. Controls downstream design activities: 'draft' allows edits; 'approved' gates synthesis; 'released' permits tapeout submission; 'obsolete' marks superseded versions.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; ISO 9001

attributes.name: tapeout_target_date
attributes.description: Planned date for final GDS/GDSII design submission (tapeout) to the fabrication facility. Tapeout is the milestone at which the RTL design is frozen and submitted for mask generation. Drives program schedule and supply chain commitments.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA (PP); SEMI Standards

attributes.name: target_clock_frequency_mhz
attributes.description: Target operating clock frequency in megahertz (MHz) for the primary clock domain of this RTL design block. Drives timing constraint definition in Synopsys PrimeTime and synthesis optimization targets.
attributes.references: Synopsys PrimeTime; Synopsys Design Compiler; JEDEC

attributes.name: target_process_node
attributes.description: Semiconductor fabrication process node for which this RTL design is targeted (e.g., '5nm', '7nm', '28nm', '180nm'). Determines applicable PDK, design rules, and standard cell libraries used in synthesis and physical design.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; PDK documentation; Cadence Virtuoso

attributes.name: teamcenter_item_reference
attributes.description: Native item identifier assigned to this RTL specification within Siemens Teamcenter PLM. Enables direct cross-system traceability between the lakehouse silver layer record and the authoritative PLM system of record.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: version_label
attributes.description: Semantic version label of this RTL specification revision (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.3.1'). Tracks design evolution through revision control (Git, Perforce) and PLM change management. Incremented on each approved change.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; IEEE Std 1800

products.name: netlist
products.description: Synthesized netlist artifact produced by logic synthesis tools (Synopsys Design Compiler) from RTL. Captures netlist type (pre-synthesis, post-synthesis, post-layout), gate count, cell library version, synthesis constraints file reference, timing slack summary, power estimate, and linkage to the RTL specification and PDK version used. Tracks netlist versions across design iterations for design provenance.

attributes.name: netlist_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the synthesized netlist artifact record in the design domain. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: IEEE 1364 (Verilog HDL Standard), Synopsys Design Compiler Internal Object Model

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Netlist approval workflow requires recording approving engineer; sign‑off report references employee_id of approver.

attributes.name: design_ip_core_id
attributes.description: Reference to an IP (Intellectual Property) core incorporated in this netlist, if applicable. Links to licensed third-party or internally developed IP blocks (e.g., PCIe PHY, USB controller, ARM Cortex core) for IP usage tracking and license compliance.
attributes.references: IEEE 2000 (IP Reuse Standard), SEMI IP Standards, ITAR/EAR IP Export Controls

attributes.name: eda_tool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.eda_tool. Business justification: Netlist is produced by a specific EDA tool; adding eda_tool_id creates a proper reference and removes tool name/version duplication.

attributes.name: primary_netlist_ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent IC design project or block to which this netlist belongs. Links the netlist artifact to its design hierarchy context within the PLM system.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM, Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: primary_netlist_pdk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Process Design Kit (PDK) version used during logic synthesis. The PDK defines the standard cell library, design rules, and technology parameters for the target fabrication process node.
attributes.references: SEMI P10 (PDK Standard), Cadence Virtuoso PDK Framework

attributes.name: primary_netlist_rtl_specification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the RTL specification artifact from which this netlist was synthesized. Establishes design provenance traceability from RTL source to synthesized gate-level netlist.
attributes.references: IEEE 1364 (Verilog HDL Standard), IEEE 1800 (SystemVerilog Standard), Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: to_ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: FK to design.ic_design_project.ic_design_project_id — Netlist belongs to a design project. Required for project-level artifact tracking and version management.

attributes.name: to_pdk_id
attributes.description: FK to design.pdk.pdk_id — Synthesis uses PDK standard cell libraries. The netlist must reference which PDK version was used for synthesis.

attributes.name: to_rtl_specification_id
attributes.description: FK to design.rtl_specification.rtl_specification_id — A netlist is synthesized from an RTL specification. This is the core design flow linkage (RTL -> synthesis -> netlist) required for design provenance.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the netlist was formally approved for promotion to the next design stage. Supports design review audit trails and milestone tracking for tapeout schedule management.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Approval Workflow, ISO 9001 (Quality Management Systems)

attributes.name: area_estimate_um2
attributes.description: Estimated silicon area of the synthesized netlist in square micrometers (µm²) as reported by the synthesis tool. Represents the combinational and sequential cell area before physical placement. A key PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metric.
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Compiler Area Report, SEMI Standards

attributes.name: cell_instance_count
attributes.description: Total number of standard cell instances instantiated in the synthesized netlist. Distinct from gate count — counts actual cell placements including sequential elements (flip-flops, latches) and combinational cells.
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Compiler Cell Count Report

attributes.name: cell_library_name
attributes.description: Name of the standard cell library used during logic synthesis (e.g., 'TSMC_N5_SC_HD_v1.2'). Defines the set of logic gates, flip-flops, and combinational cells mapped during synthesis from the PDK.
attributes.references: SEMI P10 (PDK Standard), Synopsys Design Compiler Liberty (.lib) Format

attributes.name: cell_library_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the standard cell library used during synthesis. Critical for design reproducibility and provenance — different library versions may have different timing, power, or area characteristics.
attributes.references: Synopsys Liberty (.lib) Format, SEMI P10 (PDK Standard)

attributes.name: checksum_sha256
attributes.description: SHA-256 cryptographic hash of the netlist file content. Used to verify file integrity, detect unauthorized modifications, and ensure design provenance authenticity across EDA tool handoffs and IP delivery.
attributes.references: NIST FIPS 180-4 (SHA-256), ITAR (Design IP Protection), EAR (Export Administration Regulations)

attributes.name: combinational_cell_count
attributes.description: Number of combinational logic cells (AND, OR, MUX, inverters, etc.) in the synthesized netlist. Used for area estimation and logic optimization analysis during PPA (Power-Performance-Area) evaluation.

attributes.name: constraints_file_ref
attributes.description: File path or repository reference to the Synopsys Design Constraints (SDC) file used during synthesis. The SDC file specifies timing constraints, clock definitions, input/output delays, and false paths that govern synthesis optimization.
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Constraints (SDC) Format Standard, IEEE 1801 (UPF)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this netlist record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking for the design domain.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 (Quality Management Systems), SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act - Data Audit Trail)

attributes.name: critical_path_delay_ps
attributes.description: Propagation delay of the longest (critical) timing path in the synthesized netlist, measured in picoseconds (ps). Determines the maximum achievable operating frequency and is a key PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metric for design optimization.
attributes.references: Synopsys PrimeTime Static Timing Analysis (STA), IEEE 1801

attributes.name: design_block_name
attributes.description: Name of the IC design block or module represented by this netlist (e.g., 'ALU', 'memory_controller', 'pcie_phy'). Corresponds to the top-level module name in the RTL hierarchy submitted to the synthesis tool.
attributes.references: IEEE 1364 (Verilog HDL), IEEE 1800 (SystemVerilog), Synopsys Design Compiler

attributes.name: design_iteration
attributes.description: Sequential iteration counter for synthesis runs on the same design block. Increments with each new synthesis attempt, enabling tracking of design convergence progress and comparison of PPA metrics across iterations.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Revision Management, Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: dfm_rule_check_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design for Manufacturability (DFM) Rule Check Status
attributes.description: Status of Design for Manufacturability (DFM) rule checks applied to this netlist. DFM rules ensure the synthesized design is compatible with the target fabrication process constraints to maximize yield.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards, Synopsys IC Compiler DFM, ITRS/IRDS Roadmap

tag_set.value: Design for Manufacturability (DFM) Rule Check Status

attributes.name: dft_scan_coverage_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design for Testability (DFT) Scan Coverage Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of sequential elements covered by DFT (Design for Testability) scan chains in the synthesized netlist. Higher coverage improves defect detection during Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) testing. Target is typically ≥95% for production designs.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD22 (DFT Standards), IEEE 1149.1 (JTAG Boundary Scan), Synopsys DFT Compiler

tag_set.value: Design for Testability (DFT) Scan Coverage Percentage

attributes.name: dynamic_power_mw
attributes.description: Estimated dynamic (switching) power consumption in milliwatts (mW) from the synthesis power analysis report. Represents power consumed by logic transitions and is activity-dependent. Used for thermal and battery life analysis.
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Compiler Power Report, IEEE 1801 (UPF)

attributes.name: file_path
attributes.description: Repository or file system path to the synthesized netlist artifact file (e.g., '/design/proj/cpu_core/syn/v3/cpu_core_top.v'). Enables EDA tool flows and downstream physical design steps to locate and consume the netlist.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Document Management, Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: File format of the synthesized netlist artifact (e.g., Verilog gate-level netlist, VHDL, SPICE, EDIF, Liberty). Determines compatibility with downstream EDA tools for physical design, simulation, and verification flows.

attributes.name: gate_count
attributes.description: Total number of logic gates (expressed in equivalent 2-input NAND gate equivalents) in the synthesized netlist. A primary measure of design complexity and silicon area consumption used for Power-Performance-Area (PPA) analysis.
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Compiler Area Report, IEEE 1364

attributes.name: leakage_power_uw
attributes.description: Estimated static leakage power consumption in microwatts (µW) from the synthesis power analysis report. Represents power consumed when the circuit is idle due to sub-threshold leakage currents. Critical for low-power and IoT product designs.
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Compiler Power Report, IEEE 1801 (UPF)

attributes.name: netlist_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name assigned to the netlist artifact, typically reflecting the design block name and synthesis iteration (e.g., 'cpu_core_top_postsyn_v3'). Used for identification in EDA tool flows and design review sessions.
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Compiler Naming Conventions, IEEE 1364

attributes.name: netlist_type
attributes.description: Classification of the netlist stage in the IC design flow: pre_synthesis (RTL-level functional netlist before synthesis), post_synthesis (gate-level netlist after logic synthesis by Synopsys Design Compiler), or post_layout (netlist annotated with parasitic extraction data after physical design in Cadence Innovus).
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Compiler User Guide, Cadence Innovus Implementation System, IEEE 1364

attributes.name: process_node_nm
attributes.description: Target semiconductor fabrication process node in nanometers (nm) for which this netlist was synthesized (e.g., '5nm', '7nm', '28nm'). Determines the standard cell library and timing models used during synthesis.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards, ITRS/IRDS Roadmap, PDK Specification

attributes.name: sequential_cell_count
attributes.description: Number of sequential logic cells (flip-flops, latches, registers) in the synthesized netlist. Used for Design for Testability (DFT) scan chain planning and power analysis of dynamic switching activity.
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Compiler, JEDEC JESD22 (DFT Standards)

attributes.name: synthesis_run_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the logic synthesis run that produced this netlist was executed. Provides the principal business event timestamp for design provenance, audit trails, and design iteration tracking.
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Compiler Run Log, Siemens Teamcenter PLM Audit Trail

attributes.name: synthesis_runtime_minutes
attributes.description: Wall-clock runtime of the synthesis job in minutes. Used for EDA compute resource planning, license utilization tracking, and identifying synthesis runs that exceed expected runtimes due to design complexity or tool issues.
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Compiler Run Log, EDA License Management

attributes.name: synthesis_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the netlist artifact within the design flow. Tracks progression from initial synthesis run through completion, failure, archival, or supersession by a newer version.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Lifecycle States, Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: tapeout_target_date
attributes.description: Planned tapeout date for the IC design project associated with this netlist. Used to assess synthesis schedule adherence and Time-to-Market (TTM) risk. Tapeout is the final design submission milestone for manufacturing.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Project Schedule, SEMI Standards

attributes.name: target_clock_freq_mhz
attributes.description: Target operating clock frequency in megahertz (MHz) specified in the synthesis constraints (SDC). Defines the timing closure goal for the synthesis run and is used to evaluate whether timing slack objectives are met.

attributes.name: timing_closure_achieved
attributes.description: Indicates whether timing closure has been achieved for this netlist (True = all timing paths meet constraints with non-negative slack; False = timing violations remain). A prerequisite gate for advancing to physical design and tapeout.
attributes.references: Synopsys PrimeTime Static Timing Analysis (STA), IEEE 1801

attributes.name: timing_slack_hold_ps
attributes.description: Worst-case hold timing slack in picoseconds (ps) across all timing paths in the synthesized netlist, as reported by Synopsys PrimeTime. Negative hold slack indicates a hold violation requiring buffer insertion or path adjustment.
attributes.references: Synopsys PrimeTime Timing Analysis, JEDEC Timing Standards

attributes.name: timing_slack_setup_ps
attributes.description: Worst-case setup timing slack in picoseconds (ps) across all timing paths in the synthesized netlist, as reported by Synopsys PrimeTime. Negative slack indicates a timing violation (setup violation) that must be resolved before tapeout. Critical PPA metric.
attributes.references: Synopsys PrimeTime Timing Analysis, IEEE 1801 (UPF), JEDEC Timing Standards

attributes.name: timing_violation_count
attributes.description: Total number of timing path violations (setup and hold combined) reported in the synthesis timing analysis. A value of zero indicates timing closure has been achieved. Used to track synthesis convergence progress across iterations.

attributes.name: total_power_estimate_mw
attributes.description: Estimated total power consumption of the synthesized netlist in milliwatts (mW), as reported by the synthesis tool. Includes dynamic switching power and static leakage power. A key PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metric for product qualification.
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Compiler Power Analysis, IEEE 1801 (UPF - Unified Power Format)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this netlist record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 (Quality Management Systems), SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act - Data Audit Trail)

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the netlist artifact following semantic versioning conventions (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.3.1'). Tracks netlist iterations across design synthesis runs to support design provenance and change management.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Change Management, Siemens Teamcenter PLM

products.name: timing_analysis_run
products.description: Static Timing Analysis (STA) run record produced by Synopsys PrimeTime capturing timing closure status for a design at a specific design stage. Tracks worst negative slack (WNS), total negative slack (TNS), setup/hold violations count, operating corner (PVT), clock frequency targets, analysis mode (pre-CTS, post-CTS, post-route), and pass/fail status. Enables timing closure tracking across design iterations.

attributes.name: timing_analysis_run_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Static Timing Analysis (STA) run record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the timing_analysis_run data product.

attributes.name: baseline_ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: FK to design.ic_design_project.ic_design_project_id — Timing runs belong to a project for aggregated timing closure tracking across design iterations.

attributes.name: netlist_id
attributes.description: FK to design.netlist.netlist_id — STA runs analyze timing on a specific netlist version. This linkage is required for timing closure tracking.

attributes.name: physical_layout_id
attributes.description: FK to design.physical_layout.physical_layout_id — Post-route STA runs reference a specific physical layout version for parasitic-annotated timing. Critical for post-layout timing closure.

attributes.name: primary_timing_ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IC design or SoC/ASIC design entity for which this STA run was executed. Links the timing analysis result to the parent design record managed in Cadence Virtuoso/Innovus or Siemens Teamcenter PLM.

attributes.name: submitted_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Timing analysis run submission is logged by the engineer who initiates it; required for run audit report.

attributes.name: analysis_mode
attributes.description: Timing analysis mode applied in this STA run. Setup checks for maximum path delay violations; hold checks for minimum path delay violations; OCV (On-Chip Variation), AOCV (Advanced OCV), and POCV (Parametric OCV) modes apply statistical derating for silicon variation modeling. Determines which slack metrics are applicable.

attributes.name: clock_domain_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct clock domains analyzed in this STA run. Multi-clock domain designs require careful CDC (Clock Domain Crossing) analysis. Relevant for SoC and ASIC designs with multiple functional blocks operating at different frequencies.

attributes.name: clock_frequency_target_mhz
attributes.description: Target clock frequency in megahertz (MHz) specified for this STA run, representing the design's PPA (Power Performance Area) performance goal. Used to evaluate whether timing closure is achieved at the required operating frequency.

attributes.name: clock_period_target_ps
attributes.description: Target clock period in picoseconds (ps) corresponding to the clock frequency target. Directly used by Synopsys PrimeTime as the timing constraint for setup/hold analysis. Derived from clock_frequency_target_mhz but stored independently as the authoritative STA constraint value.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this STA run record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer data product. Represents the audit trail creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: critical_path_count
attributes.description: Number of critical timing paths (paths with negative or near-zero slack) identified in this STA run. Used by design engineers to prioritize optimization efforts in Synopsys Design Compiler or Cadence Innovus for timing closure.

attributes.name: derating_factor_hold
attributes.description: On-Chip Variation (OCV) derating factor applied to hold timing paths in this STA run. Represents the percentage by which cell delays are derated for hold analysis. Typically different from setup derating to model the asymmetric nature of process variation effects on min/max paths.
attributes.references: Synopsys PrimeTime; JEDEC JESD79; PDK OCV Guidelines

attributes.name: derating_factor_setup
attributes.description: On-Chip Variation (OCV) derating factor applied to setup timing paths in this STA run. Represents the percentage by which cell delays are derated to model process variation (e.g., 0.95 = 5% derating). Used in OCV/AOCV/POCV analysis modes for silicon-accurate sign-off.
attributes.references: Synopsys PrimeTime; JEDEC JESD79; PDK OCV Guidelines

attributes.name: design_stage
attributes.description: Physical design stage at which this STA run was performed, reflecting the state of the netlist and parasitics. Values: pre_synthesis (RTL-level), post_synthesis (gate-level), pre_cts (before Clock Tree Synthesis), post_cts (after CTS), post_route (after detailed routing), signoff (final tapeout signoff). Drives interpretation of WNS/TNS results.

attributes.name: design_version
attributes.description: Version or revision label of the IC design netlist or GDS/GDSII database at the time this STA run was executed (e.g., 'v2.3.1', 'tapeout_rc2'). Enables timing closure tracking across design iterations and correlates with PLM change records.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; GDSII standard

attributes.name: hold_violation_count
attributes.description: Total number of hold timing violations (negative hold slack endpoints) reported by Synopsys PrimeTime in this STA run. A value of zero indicates full hold timing closure. Critical for designs with multi-cycle paths, clock domain crossings, and post-CTS analysis.

attributes.name: is_multi_corner_run
attributes.description: Indicates whether this STA run covers multiple PVT corners simultaneously (True) or a single corner (False). Multi-corner runs are used for comprehensive sign-off coverage across all operating conditions required by the PDK and target application specifications.
attributes.references: Synopsys PrimeTime; PDK Corner Definitions; JEDEC JESD79

attributes.name: is_signoff_run
attributes.description: Indicates whether this STA run is designated as an official tapeout signoff run (True) or an intermediate/exploratory analysis run (False). Signoff runs are subject to formal design review, PLM change control, and foundry submission requirements.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: liberty_library_version
attributes.description: Version of the Liberty (.lib) timing library files used in this STA run. Liberty libraries contain cell timing models, power models, and operating condition data from the PDK. Library version directly affects timing analysis accuracy and sign-off validity.
attributes.references: Liberty Reference Manual; PDK (Process Design Kit); Synopsys PrimeTime

attributes.name: max_capacitance_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of maximum capacitance violations reported in this STA run. Capacitance violations indicate nets with excessive load that degrade timing and signal integrity. Must be resolved through buffer insertion or net splitting before tapeout.
attributes.references: Synopsys PrimeTime; PDK Design Rules; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: max_transition_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of maximum transition time violations reported in this STA run. Transition violations indicate signal edges that are too slow, potentially causing functional failures or increased power consumption. Must be resolved before tapeout signoff per PDK design rules.
attributes.references: Synopsys PrimeTime; PDK Design Rules; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: pdk_version
attributes.description: Version of the Process Design Kit (PDK) used for this STA run. The PDK defines the foundry's process parameters, design rules, and standard cell libraries. PDK version is critical for tapeout sign-off traceability and foundry submission compliance.
attributes.references: PDK (Process Design Kit); SEMI Standards; Foundry PDK Release Notes

attributes.name: primetime_version
attributes.description: Version of Synopsys PrimeTime used to execute this STA run (e.g., 'PrimeTime 2023.12-SP3'). Critical for result reproducibility, audit trails, and identifying version-specific timing model differences that may affect sign-off validity.

attributes.name: process_node_nm
attributes.description: Semiconductor process technology node in nanometers at which the design is implemented (e.g., '5nm', '7nm', '28nm'). Determines PDK library characteristics, timing model accuracy, and applicable EUV/DUV lithography constraints relevant to STA sign-off.
attributes.references: PDK (Process Design Kit); SEMI Standards; ITRS Roadmap

attributes.name: pvt_corner
attributes.description: Operating corner (Process-Voltage-Temperature) under which this STA run was performed (e.g., 'ss_0p72v_125c' for slow-slow worst-case, 'ff_1p08v_m40c' for fast-fast best-case). Defined by the PDK (Process Design Kit) and critical for sign-off coverage across all operating conditions.
attributes.references: Synopsys PrimeTime; PDK Corner Definitions; JEDEC JESD79

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the STA run results were formally reviewed and approved by the responsible design engineer or timing closure lead. Null if the run has not yet been reviewed. Required for tapeout sign-off audit trail.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; ISO 9001; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the senior design engineer or timing closure lead who reviewed and approved the results of this STA run. Required for signoff runs as part of the formal design review process before tapeout submission.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; ISO 9001

attributes.name: run_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this Static Timing Analysis run completed execution in Synopsys PrimeTime. Used to calculate run duration and assess EDA compute resource utilization. Null if the run is still in progress or was aborted.

attributes.name: run_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Wall-clock duration of this STA run in seconds, from job submission to completion. Used for EDA compute resource planning, license utilization tracking, and identifying unusually long runs that may indicate tool or design issues.

attributes.name: run_identifier
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric run identifier assigned by the EDA tool flow or MES integration (e.g., 'PT-RUN-20240315-0042'). Used for cross-referencing with Synopsys PrimeTime job logs, Cadence Innovus signoff reports, and Siemens Teamcenter PLM design records.

attributes.name: run_iteration
attributes.description: Sequential iteration number of this STA run within the current design stage and PVT corner. Enables tracking of timing closure convergence across multiple optimization-analysis cycles (e.g., iteration 1 through N until timing closure is achieved).
attributes.references: Synopsys PrimeTime; EDA Design Flow Management

attributes.name: run_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label assigned to this Static Timing Analysis run, typically encoding the design name, corner, and iteration (e.g., 'soc_top_ss_0p72v_125c_postroute_iter3'). Used for identification in Synopsys PrimeTime run logs and design review meetings.

attributes.name: run_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the design engineer describing the purpose, context, or key findings of this STA run (e.g., 'Post-ECO run after fixing 3 critical paths in clock tree', 'Baseline run for tapeout corner coverage'). Supports design review and knowledge transfer.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Execution lifecycle status of this STA run job in the EDA tool flow. 'submitted' indicates the job is queued, 'running' indicates active execution, 'completed' indicates successful completion, 'failed' indicates tool error or license failure, 'aborted' indicates user-cancelled run. Distinct from timing_closure_status which reflects the timing result.
attributes.references: Synopsys PrimeTime; EDA Tool Flow Management

attributes.name: run_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this Static Timing Analysis run was initiated in Synopsys PrimeTime. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this record. Used for tracking timing closure progress over time and correlating with design iteration milestones.

attributes.name: sdc_constraints_version
attributes.description: Version or identifier of the Synopsys Design Constraints (SDC) file used in this STA run. SDC files define clock definitions, input/output delays, and timing exceptions. Versioning ensures traceability of constraint changes across design iterations.
attributes.references: Synopsys Design Compiler; Synopsys PrimeTime; SDC Standard

attributes.name: setup_violation_count
attributes.description: Total number of setup timing violations (negative setup slack endpoints) reported by Synopsys PrimeTime in this STA run. A value of zero indicates full setup timing closure. Tracked across iterations to measure convergence progress toward tapeout readiness.

attributes.name: spef_version
attributes.description: Version or identifier of the SPEF (Standard Parasitic Exchange Format) file used for parasitic extraction in this STA run. SPEF files contain RC parasitics from the routed layout and directly impact timing accuracy. Null for pre-route analysis stages.

attributes.name: supply_voltage_v
attributes.description: Nominal supply voltage in volts (V) applied for this STA run's PVT corner. Defined by the PDK operating conditions and UPF (Unified Power Format) power intent. Directly impacts cell delay models and timing analysis results.
attributes.references: IEEE 1801 (UPF); PDK Operating Conditions; Synopsys PrimeTime

attributes.name: temperature_c
attributes.description: Operating temperature in degrees Celsius (°C) for this STA run's PVT corner. Temperature affects transistor characteristics and cell delays. Typical corners range from -40°C (automotive cold) to 125°C (worst-case hot). Defined by the PDK and target application requirements.
attributes.references: PDK Operating Conditions; JEDEC JESD79; IATF 16949 (Automotive)

attributes.name: timing_closure_status
attributes.description: Overall timing closure pass/fail status for this STA run. 'pass' indicates all setup and hold violations are resolved and the design meets timing at the specified PVT corner and clock frequency. 'waived' indicates known violations accepted with engineering sign-off. 'pending_review' indicates results awaiting design team review. Primary KPI for tapeout readiness.

attributes.name: total_hold_negative_slack_ps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Hold Negative Slack (THNS) in Picoseconds
attributes.description: Total Hold Negative Slack (THNS) in picoseconds — the sum of all negative hold slack values across all violating hold endpoints in this STA run. Complements TNS (setup) to provide a complete picture of hold timing closure status.

tag_set.value: Total Hold Negative Slack (THNS) in Picoseconds

attributes.name: total_negative_slack_ps
attributes.description: Total Negative Slack (TNS) in picoseconds — the sum of all negative slack values across all violating timing endpoints in this STA run. Indicates the overall magnitude of timing violations in the design. Used alongside WNS to assess timing closure convergence across design iterations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this STA run record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer data product. Tracks updates such as status changes, waiver additions, or review approvals for audit trail and data lineage compliance.

attributes.name: waiver_count
attributes.description: Number of timing violations formally waived with engineering sign-off in this STA run. Waivers are granted for violations on non-critical paths, test-mode-only paths, or paths with functional justification. Tracked for tapeout risk assessment and compliance with design review processes.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: worst_hold_slack_ps
attributes.description: Worst Hold Slack (WHS) in picoseconds for hold timing analysis in this STA run. Represents the most critical hold violation — the largest shortfall in minimum path delay. Negative values indicate hold violations that must be fixed before tapeout. Applicable when analysis_mode includes hold or setup_hold.

attributes.name: worst_negative_slack_ps
attributes.description: Worst Negative Slack (WNS) in picoseconds reported by Synopsys PrimeTime for this STA run. Represents the most critical timing violation — the largest shortfall between required and actual signal arrival time. A value of 0 or positive indicates no setup/hold violation on the worst path. Key metric for timing closure tracking.

products.name: physical_layout
products.description: Physical design layout record representing the floorplan, placement, clock tree, and routing state of an IC design at a specific stage in the physical implementation flow. Captures die dimensions and core area, cell utilization percentage, routing congestion metrics by metal layer, DRC violation count and categories, LVS clean status, metal layer stack usage and fill density, power grid IR-drop analysis results, clock tree synthesis (CTS) metrics (skew, insertion delay), electromigration compliance status, antenna rule violations, and GDS/GDSII or OASIS file reference. Tracks physical design iterations from initial floorplan through final tapeout-ready layout in Cadence Innovus, Synopsys ICC2, or Siemens Aprisa. SSOT for physical design state at each iteration checkpoint.

attributes.name: physical_layout_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each physical design layout record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key for the physical_layout data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Layout engineering effort costs are allocated to a cost center for accurate product cost accounting.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical design engineer responsible for this layout iteration. Enables accountability tracking, design review assignment, and workforce analytics in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.fab_tool. Business justification: Physical layout files are assigned to a specific fab tool for mask generation; required by the 'Layout‑to‑Tool Assignment' process.

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: FK to design.ic_design_project.ic_design_project_id — Physical layouts belong to a specific IC design project. Required for design artifact management.

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle run assignment for this layout, if applicable. MPW shuttles allow multiple designs to share a single wafer run to reduce NRE (Non-Recurring Engineering) costs for prototype fabrication.

attributes.name: netlist_id
attributes.description: FK to design.netlist.netlist_id — Physical layout (place and route) takes a netlist as input. This is the core PnR flow linkage required for design provenance.

attributes.name: pdk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Process Design Kit (PDK) version used for this physical layout. The PDK defines the technology node rules, design rule checks (DRC), and layer stack for the target fabrication process.
attributes.references: SEMI P10 (PDK Standard); Foundry PDK Documentation

attributes.name: primary_physical_ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent IC design record for which this physical layout iteration was produced. Links the layout to its originating design project.

attributes.name: antenna_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of antenna rule violations detected in the layout. Antenna violations occur when metal segments accumulate charge during plasma etching that can damage gate oxide. Must be resolved or mitigated with antenna diodes before tapeout.
attributes.references: Foundry Antenna Rule Specification; SEMI P10

attributes.name: cell_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the core area occupied by placed standard cells, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 72.500 = 72.5%). High utilization (>85%) may indicate routing congestion risk; low utilization (<50%) may indicate oversized floorplan.

attributes.name: core_area_mm2
attributes.description: Area of the core logic region in square millimeters (mm²), excluding I/O ring, power ring, and seal ring. Used to assess logic density and available routing resources.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this physical layout record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 (Audit Trail); ISO 9001 Quality Records

attributes.name: cts_insertion_delay_ps
attributes.description: Clock insertion delay in picoseconds (ps) from the clock source to the farthest clock sink in the clock tree. Impacts setup timing margin and must be accounted for in static timing analysis (STA).
attributes.references: Cadence Innovus CTS Report; Synopsys PrimeTime STA

attributes.name: cts_skew_ps
attributes.description: Clock skew in picoseconds (ps) achieved by the Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS) engine at this layout iteration. Measures the maximum difference in clock arrival times across all sink flip-flops. Lower skew improves timing closure margin.

attributes.name: dfm_score
attributes.description: Quantitative DFM (Design for Manufacturability) score assigned to this layout iteration by the DFM analysis tool (e.g., Mentor Calibre YieldAnalyzer). Higher scores indicate better manufacturability and expected yield; used to guide layout optimization before tapeout.
attributes.references: SEMI P10; Mentor Calibre DFM; IEEE 1687

attributes.name: dft_coverage_pct
attributes.description: Fault coverage percentage achieved by the DFT (Design for Testability) implementation at this layout stage, as reported by ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) tools. Typically required to exceed 95% for production test qualification.
attributes.references: IEEE 1149.1 (JTAG Boundary Scan); Mentor Tessent ATPG; JEDEC

attributes.name: die_area_mm2
attributes.description: Total die area in square millimeters (mm²) computed from the floorplan boundary. A primary PPA (Power, Performance, Area) metric used for cost estimation, yield modeling, and competitive benchmarking.

attributes.name: die_height_um
attributes.description: Height of the die boundary in micrometers (µm) as defined in the physical layout floorplan. Together with die width, determines die area for yield and cost analysis.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD30 (Package Outline Standards); SEMI M1

attributes.name: die_width_um
attributes.description: Width of the die boundary in micrometers (µm) as defined in the physical layout floorplan. Used for package selection, wafer yield estimation, and cost modeling.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD30 (Package Outline Standards); SEMI M1

attributes.name: drc_critical_violation_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Critical Design Rule Check (DRC) Violation Count
attributes.description: Number of DRC violations classified as critical (yield-impacting or functionality-blocking) as opposed to waivable violations. Critical DRC violations must be resolved before tapeout; waivable violations may be accepted with foundry approval.
attributes.references: Foundry DRC Runset Specification; SEMI P10

tag_set.value: Critical Design Rule Check (DRC) Violation Count

attributes.name: drc_violation_count
attributes.description: Total number of Design Rule Check (DRC) violations detected in this layout iteration by the signoff DRC tool (e.g., Mentor Calibre, Synopsys IC Validator). A value of zero is required for tapeout approval.
attributes.references: SEMI P10 (DRC Rules); Foundry DRC Runset Specification

attributes.name: eda_tool
attributes.description: EDA tool used to produce this physical layout iteration. Identifies the physical implementation platform (Cadence Innovus, Synopsys IC Compiler 2, Siemens Aprisa, or Cadence Virtuoso for custom layouts) for provenance and reproducibility.
attributes.references: EDA Industry Standard Tools; SEMI E10

attributes.name: eda_tool_version
attributes.description: Version string of the EDA tool used to generate this layout (e.g., 'Innovus 21.1', 'ICC2 2022.03'). Critical for design reproducibility and debugging layout-specific tool behavior.
attributes.references: Cadence Innovus Release Notes; Synopsys ICC2 Release Notes

attributes.name: em_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether all metal interconnects in the layout comply with electromigration (EM) current density limits specified by the foundry PDK. TRUE = EM compliant; FALSE = EM violations present requiring wire widening or rerouting.
attributes.references: Foundry EM Design Rules; JEDEC JEP122 (Electromigration)

attributes.name: gds_file_checksum
attributes.description: SHA-256 cryptographic checksum of the GDSII/OASIS layout file for integrity verification. Used to confirm that the submitted tapeout file has not been corrupted or tampered with during transfer to the foundry.
attributes.references: NIST FIPS 180-4 (SHA-256); Foundry Tapeout Submission Requirements

attributes.name: gds_file_format
attributes.description: Format of the layout database file referenced in gds_file_path. GDSII is the traditional foundry submission format; OASIS (Open Artwork System Interchange Standard) is the modern compressed alternative; LEF/DEF is used for abstract/physical exchange.

attributes.name: gds_file_path
attributes.business_glossary_term: Graphic Data System II (GDSII) File Path
attributes.description: File system or object storage path to the GDSII (Graphic Data System II) or OASIS layout database file for this physical layout iteration. The GDSII file is the primary deliverable submitted to the foundry for mask generation at tapeout.
attributes.references: SEMI P10 (GDSII Standard); Calma GDSII Stream Format

tag_set.value: Graphic Data System II (GDSII) File Path

attributes.name: implementation_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the physical implementation flow for this layout iteration. Stages progress from initial floorplan through placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), routing, signoff, and final tapeout submission. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: floorplan|placement|cts|routing|signoff|tapeout — promote to reference product if additional stages are needed]
attributes.references: Cadence Innovus Physical Implementation Flow; IEEE 1801 (UPF Power Intent)

attributes.name: ir_drop_max_mv
attributes.description: Maximum static IR drop in millivolts (mV) observed in the power grid analysis at this layout iteration. Excessive IR drop degrades circuit performance and reliability; must remain within foundry-specified limits for tapeout approval.
attributes.references: Cadence Voltus Power Integrity Analysis; IEEE 1801 (UPF)

attributes.name: iteration_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this physical layout iteration checkpoint was captured and committed to the design database. Represents the principal business event time for this layout record, enabling chronological tracking of design progress.
attributes.references: Cadence Innovus Design Checkpoint; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: layout_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name identifying this physical layout iteration, typically including the design name and iteration label (e.g., 'SoC_v3_floorplan_iter2'). Used in Cadence Innovus and Synopsys ICC2 project naming conventions.

attributes.name: layout_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this physical layout record. Tracks whether the layout is actively being worked on, under design review, approved for next stage, rejected requiring rework, or archived as a historical iteration.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Lifecycle Management; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: layout_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this physical layout iteration following semantic versioning (e.g., '1.0.0', '2.3.1'). Tracks incremental changes through the physical implementation flow from floorplan to tapeout.

attributes.name: leakage_power_uw
attributes.description: Static leakage power in microwatts (µW) estimated for this layout at the target operating conditions. Critical for battery-powered and low-power IoT/mobile applications; tracked separately from dynamic power for PPA optimization.

attributes.name: lvs_clean
attributes.description: Indicates whether the physical layout passes Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) verification with zero errors, confirming that the layout netlist matches the schematic netlist. TRUE = LVS clean (required for tapeout); FALSE = LVS errors present.
attributes.references: Mentor Calibre LVS; Synopsys Hercules; SEMI P10

attributes.name: metal_fill_density_pct
attributes.description: Average metal fill density percentage across all metal layers after dummy metal fill insertion. Foundry CMP (Chemical Mechanical Planarization) processes require metal density to remain within specified min/max bounds to ensure planar surfaces.
attributes.references: Foundry CMP Metal Fill Rules; SEMI P10

attributes.name: metal_layer_count
attributes.description: Number of metal routing layers used in this physical layout, as defined by the PDK technology node stack (e.g., 12 for advanced FinFET nodes). Determines routing resource availability and BEOL (Back End of Line) complexity.
attributes.references: SEMI P10 (PDK Layer Stack); ITRS Roadmap

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing design decisions, known issues, waiver justifications, or iteration-specific observations recorded by the physical design engineer. Supports design review documentation and knowledge transfer.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Change Management; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: power_consumption_mw
attributes.description: Estimated total power consumption in milliwatts (mW) from power analysis at this layout iteration, including dynamic switching power and static leakage power. A key PPA (Power, Performance, Area) metric for product specification compliance.
attributes.references: Cadence Voltus Power Analysis; Synopsys PrimePower; IEEE 1801 (UPF)

attributes.name: routing_congestion_layer
attributes.description: Metal layer identifier (e.g., 'M4', 'M7') where the maximum routing congestion was observed. Used to guide targeted floorplan or placement adjustments to relieve congestion on the most constrained layer.

attributes.name: routing_congestion_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum routing congestion percentage observed across all metal layers in the layout, expressed as overflow percentage. Values above 5% typically indicate routing closure risk requiring floorplan or placement adjustment.
attributes.references: Cadence Innovus Routing Congestion Report; IEEE 1481

attributes.name: tapeout_date
attributes.description: Date on which the final GDSII/OASIS layout was submitted to the foundry for mask generation (tapeout). A critical milestone in the IC design lifecycle tracked against the product TTM (Time to Market) schedule.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Milestone Tracking; SEMI

attributes.name: tns_ps
attributes.description: Total Negative Slack (TNS) in picoseconds (ps), representing the sum of all negative slack values across all timing paths. Indicates the overall magnitude of timing violations in the design; must reach zero for tapeout signoff.

attributes.name: total_cell_count
attributes.description: Total number of standard cells placed in the core area at this layout iteration. Includes combinational logic, sequential elements, buffers, and inverters. Used to assess design complexity and placement density.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this physical layout record was last modified in the data platform. Supports incremental data processing, change detection, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 (Audit Trail); ISO 9001 Quality Records

attributes.name: wns_ps
attributes.description: Worst Negative Slack (WNS) in picoseconds (ps) from static timing analysis at this layout iteration. Negative values indicate timing violations; zero or positive values indicate timing closure. A key metric for tapeout readiness.

products.name: tapeout
products.description: Tapeout event record capturing the final design submission milestone for manufacturing. Records tapeout date, GDS/GDSII file version, mask set identifier, foundry submission reference, PDK version used, final DRC/LVS clean status, OPC/RET processing status, design sign-off checklist completion, NRE cost committed, and MPW shuttle assignment if applicable. SSOT for tapeout provenance linking design to fabrication domain.

attributes.name: tapeout_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for the tapeout event record. Primary key for the tapeout data product in the design domain.

attributes.name: chips_act_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.chips_act_obligation. Business justification: CHIPS Act reporting obligations are tied to each tapeout; linking supports mandatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Tapeout manufacturing costs are charged to a cost center for COGS reporting and cost control.

attributes.name: customer_design_win_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_design_win. Business justification: Enables tracking of each tapeout against its originating design win for NRE cost recovery and warranty reporting.

attributes.name: export_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.export_license. Business justification: Each tapeout shipment must be covered by an export license; linking enables audit of license usage per tapeout.

attributes.name: foundry_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: Tapeout submission must specify the foundry supplier to coordinate mask set delivery and wafer fab.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the semiconductor product (IC, SoC, ASIC, FPGA) associated with this tapeout event. Links the tapeout to the product master record.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Tapeout projects are tracked via internal orders to capture capital spend and cost commitments.

attributes.name: mask_set_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to the photolithography mask set generated from this tapeout. Used to track mask fabrication orders, reticle inventory, and wafer fabrication lots linked to this design submission.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: pdk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Process Design Kit (PDK) version used for this tapeout. The PDK defines the foundry-specific design rules, device models, and layer stack used during physical design.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Cadence Virtuoso PDK Framework

attributes.name: physical_layout_id
attributes.description: FK to design.physical_layout.physical_layout_id — Tapeout submits a final physical layout (GDS) to the foundry. Must reference which layout version was taped out.

attributes.name: primary_tapeout_ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent IC design record from which this tapeout was generated. Links tapeout provenance back to the design lifecycle in the design domain.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Tapeout revenue and margin are attributed to a profit center for product line profitability analysis.

attributes.name: research_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Tapeout Completion Report requires associating each tapeout with its originating research project for closure and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: tapeout_mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) shuttle assignment if this tapeout is part of a shared wafer run. Null if this is a dedicated wafer tapeout.

attributes.name: to_ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: FK to design.ic_design_project.ic_design_project_id — A tapeout event is the culmination of an IC design project. This is the critical milestone linkage.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: WBS linkage ties tapeout tasks to financial work packages for schedule‑cost integration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the tapeout record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: design_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the IC design being taped out (e.g., product code name or internal design designation). Used for identification in design review meetings and foundry communications.

attributes.name: design_revision
attributes.description: Revision identifier of the design at the time of tapeout (e.g., A0, B1, C2). Distinguishes successive tapeout iterations of the same design, critical for mask set versioning and silicon bring-up tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: design_type
attributes.description: Classification of the IC design type being taped out. Distinguishes ASIC, SoC, FPGA, analog, mixed-signal, RF, memory, and photonic designs, which have different EDA flows, PDK requirements, and sign-off criteria. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ASIC|SoC|FPGA|analog|mixed_signal|RF|memory|photonic — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dfm_score
attributes.description: Quantitative Design for Manufacturability (DFM) score assigned to the layout at tapeout, reflecting predicted yield sensitivity to process variation. Higher scores indicate better manufacturability. Sourced from DFM analysis tools integrated with the EDA flow.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Cadence Innovus DFM; Synopsys IC Compiler

attributes.name: dft_coverage_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of logic nodes covered by Design for Testability (DFT) structures (scan chains, BIST) as measured by Automatic Test Pattern Generation (ATPG) at tapeout sign-off. Directly impacts post-silicon test quality and DPPM targets.

attributes.name: die_size_mm2
attributes.description: Physical area of the die in square millimeters as defined in the final GDS layout at tapeout. A key Power-Performance-Area (PPA) metric used for cost modeling, yield estimation, and wafer utilization planning.

attributes.name: drc_clean
attributes.description: Indicates whether the final GDS layout passed all Design Rule Check (DRC) violations with zero errors at the time of tapeout submission. A TRUE value is a mandatory tapeout sign-off criterion per foundry requirements.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Cadence Innovus; Synopsys IC Validator

attributes.name: erc_clean
attributes.description: Indicates whether the design passed Electrical Rule Check (ERC) with no violations at tapeout. ERC validates electrical connectivity integrity including floating nodes, antenna violations, and electromigration rules.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Cadence Virtuoso; Synopsys Calibre

attributes.name: expected_yield_pct
attributes.description: Predicted die yield percentage (good dies per wafer as a percentage of total dies per wafer) at the time of tapeout, based on DFM analysis and process node historical yield data. Used for production planning and cost-per-die estimation.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; SPC Guidelines; KLA ICOS Inspection Systems

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification of the tapeout design under US Export Administration Regulations (EAR) or International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Determines licensing requirements for foundry submission to foreign entities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EAR99|ECCN_3E001|ECCN_3A001|ITAR_controlled|not_classified — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: BIS/EAR (Export Administration Regulations); ITAR; CHIPS Act Compliance

attributes.name: foundry_name
attributes.description: Name of the semiconductor fabrication facility (FAB) or foundry to which the tapeout was submitted (e.g., TSMC, Samsung Foundry, GlobalFoundries, Intel Foundry Services). Used for supply chain and vendor management reporting.

attributes.name: foundry_submission_ref
attributes.description: Foundry-assigned reference number or confirmation code for the tapeout submission. Used to track the submission status with the external foundry partner and cross-reference with foundry manufacturing orders.

attributes.name: gds_file_path
attributes.business_glossary_term: Graphic Data System II (GDSII) File Path
attributes.description: Storage path or URI of the final GDS/GDSII layout file in the design data repository. Enables traceability from the tapeout record to the physical design artifact. Classified confidential as it contains proprietary IP location data.
attributes.references: SEMI P10; Cadence Virtuoso and Innovus; ITAR

tag_set.value: Graphic Data System II (GDSII) File Path

attributes.name: gds_file_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Graphic Data System II (GDSII) File Version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the final GDS/GDSII layout file submitted for tapeout. Provides design data provenance linking the physical layout file to the tapeout event. Sourced from Cadence Virtuoso or equivalent EDA tool.
attributes.references: SEMI P10 (GDSII Stream Format); Cadence Virtuoso and Innovus

tag_set.value: Graphic Data System II (GDSII) File Version

attributes.name: ip_sign_off_complete
attributes.business_glossary_term: Intellectual Property (IP) Core Sign-Off Completion Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether all third-party and internal Intellectual Property (IP) cores integrated in the design have received sign-off approval for inclusion in the tapeout. Ensures IP licensing compliance and integration verification are complete.
attributes.references: IEEE 1685 (IP-XACT); ITAR; EAR; Oracle Agile PLM

tag_set.value: Intellectual Property (IP) Core Sign-Off Completion Status

attributes.name: lithography_type
attributes.description: Photolithography exposure technology used for the critical layers in this tapeout. Distinguishes Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV), Deep Ultraviolet (DUV), and legacy lithography types, which impact mask cost, yield, and process complexity.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; EUV/DUV Lithography Standards; ITRS/IRDS Roadmap

attributes.name: lvs_clean
attributes.description: Indicates whether the final GDS layout passed Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) verification with zero discrepancies. Confirms that the physical layout matches the intended circuit schematic, a mandatory tapeout sign-off criterion.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Cadence Virtuoso; Synopsys Calibre

attributes.name: mask_cost_usd
attributes.description: Cost of the photolithography mask set fabrication for this tapeout in US dollars. A major component of NRE cost, tracked separately for cost accounting and foundry invoice reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: mask_count
attributes.description: Total number of photolithography masks in the mask set for this tapeout. Directly drives NRE mask cost and is a key input to tapeout cost modeling. Includes FEOL, MOL, and BEOL layers.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: metal_layer_count
