attributes.description: Current qualification and release status of this implant condition. Indicates whether the condition is approved for production use or still under development.

attributes.name: requires_pre_amorphization
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a pre-amorphization implant (typically germanium or silicon) is required before the main dopant implant to reduce channeling effects.

attributes.name: target_junction_depth_nm
attributes.description: Intended electrical junction depth in nanometers after implant and anneal. Critical specification for transistor performance and short-channel effect control.

attributes.name: target_sheet_resistance_ohms_per_sq
attributes.description: Target electrical sheet resistance in ohms per square after implant and anneal. Key electrical parameter for verifying dopant activation and concentration.

attributes.name: target_threshold_voltage_mv
attributes.description: Target transistor threshold voltage in millivolts that this implant condition is designed to achieve. Critical for device performance and power consumption.

attributes.name: tilt_angle_degrees
attributes.description: Angle of wafer tilt relative to the ion beam axis, measured in degrees. Used to control channeling effects and implant profile symmetry. Typical range: 0° to 7°.

attributes.name: twist_angle_degrees
attributes.description: Rotational angle of the wafer around its normal axis during implantation, measured in degrees. Used in conjunction with tilt angle to optimize implant uniformity. Typical range: 0° to 360°.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this implant condition. Incremented when process parameters are modified. Enables change tracking and configuration management.

products.name: deposition_condition
products.description: Thin film deposition process condition master record for CVD, PVD, ALD, and epitaxial deposition steps. Captures deposition method (LPCVD, PECVD, ALD, PVD, EPI), target material, target thickness, deposition temperature, pressure, precursor gases and flow rates, RF power, deposition rate, uniformity spec, and associated process step. Covers FEOL gate dielectric, BEOL metal interconnect, and barrier/liner deposition conditions.

attributes.name: deposition_condition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the thin film deposition process condition record.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm) for which this deposition condition is qualified.
attributes.references: SEMI P37 - Specification for Semiconductor Process Equipment

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Deposition conditions are product‑specific; required for the Deposition Process Specification.

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_process_step. Business justification: Deposition condition records are defined for a particular process step; linking directly improves traceability.

attributes.name: spc_control_chart_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Control Plan ID
attributes.description: Reference to the SPC control plan defining monitoring strategy, control limits, and sampling frequency for this deposition condition.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

tag_set.value: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Control Plan ID

attributes.name: substance_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.substance_inventory. Business justification: Deposition processes use chemicals; linking to substance inventory enables REACH and hazardous‑substance tracking.

attributes.name: carrier_gas
attributes.description: Inert carrier gas used to transport precursors and maintain chamber environment (e.g., Ar, N2, He).

attributes.name: carrier_gas_flow_rate_sccm
attributes.description: Flow rate of carrier gas in standard cubic centimeters per minute (sccm).

attributes.name: chamber_configuration
attributes.description: Specific chamber setup or hardware configuration required (e.g., single-wafer, batch, showerhead type, electrode spacing).

attributes.name: condition_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code used to identify this deposition condition in manufacturing execution systems and process documentation.

attributes.name: condition_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or identifier for this deposition condition recipe.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deposition condition record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deposition_method
attributes.description: Thin film deposition technique used: LPCVD (Low Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition), PECVD (Plasma Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition), ALD (Atomic Layer Deposition), PVD (Physical Vapor Deposition), EPI (Epitaxial Growth), MOCVD (Metal Organic Chemical Vapor Deposition).

attributes.name: deposition_pressure_torr
attributes.description: Process chamber pressure in Torr during deposition. Affects film density, step coverage, and deposition rate.

attributes.name: deposition_rate_angstrom_per_minute
attributes.description: Target deposition rate in angstroms per minute. Key process control parameter affecting throughput and film quality.

attributes.name: deposition_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Process chamber temperature in degrees Celsius during deposition. Critical parameter affecting film quality, stress, and conformality.

attributes.name: deposition_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration of the deposition step in seconds required to achieve target thickness.

attributes.name: deposition_condition_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the deposition condition, including application notes, special considerations, and process intent.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this deposition condition is retired or superseded. Null indicates currently active condition.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this deposition condition becomes effective and available for production use.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing site or fab location where this deposition condition is qualified and used.

attributes.name: film_stress_mpa
attributes.description: Intrinsic mechanical stress in the deposited film measured in megapascals (MPa). Positive values indicate tensile stress, negative values indicate compressive stress. Affects wafer bow and device reliability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deposition condition record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: owner_engineer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process engineer responsible for developing, maintaining, and supporting this deposition condition.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Engineering organization or department responsible for this deposition condition (e.g., Thin Films Engineering, BEOL Integration).

attributes.name: precursor_gas_1
attributes.description: Primary precursor gas or chemical reactant used in the deposition process (e.g., SiH4, TiCl4, WF6, TEOS).

attributes.name: precursor_gas_1_flow_rate_sccm
attributes.description: Flow rate of primary precursor gas in standard cubic centimeters per minute (sccm). Controls deposition rate and film stoichiometry.

attributes.name: precursor_gas_2
attributes.description: Secondary precursor gas or reactant used in the deposition process (e.g., NH3, O2, N2, H2).

attributes.name: precursor_gas_2_flow_rate_sccm
attributes.description: Flow rate of secondary precursor gas in standard cubic centimeters per minute (sccm).

attributes.name: process_capability_cpk
attributes.description: Statistical process capability index (Cpk) for this deposition condition, measuring process centering and variation relative to specification limits. Target is typically ≥1.33 for production.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability

attributes.name: process_category
attributes.description: Manufacturing stage where deposition occurs: FEOL (Front End of Line) for gate dielectrics and transistor formation, MOL (Middle of Line) for contacts, BEOL (Back End of Line) for metal interconnects.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when this deposition condition was formally qualified and approved for production use.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification and release status of this deposition condition for production use.

attributes.name: refractive_index
attributes.description: Optical refractive index of the deposited film at specified wavelength. Used for film characterization and thickness measurement via ellipsometry.

attributes.name: rf_frequency_mhz
attributes.description: Radio frequency in megahertz used for plasma generation (e.g., 13.56 MHz, 27.12 MHz).

attributes.name: rf_power_watts
attributes.description: Radio frequency power applied in watts for plasma-enhanced deposition methods (PECVD). Controls plasma density and ion bombardment energy.

attributes.name: step_coverage_percent
attributes.description: Ratio of film thickness on vertical sidewalls to horizontal surfaces, expressed as percentage. Critical for via and trench filling in advanced nodes.
attributes.references: SEMI P37 - Specification for Semiconductor Process Equipment

attributes.name: target_layer
attributes.description: Functional layer name in the device stack where material is deposited (e.g., gate oxide, barrier layer, metal1, via2, passivation).
attributes.references: SEMI P37 - Specification for Semiconductor Process Equipment

attributes.name: target_material
attributes.description: Chemical composition or material being deposited (e.g., SiO2, Si3N4, TiN, W, Cu, HfO2, Al2O3, Ta, TaN, Co).

attributes.name: target_thickness_angstrom
attributes.description: Specified target thickness of the deposited film in angstroms (Å). Critical for device electrical performance and process control.

attributes.name: thickness_tolerance_angstrom
attributes.description: Allowable deviation from target thickness in angstroms, defining the acceptable process window.

attributes.name: tool_class
attributes.description: Equipment type or platform family qualified for this deposition condition (e.g., Applied Materials Centura, Lam Vector, Tokyo Electron Telius).

attributes.name: uniformity_specification_percent
attributes.description: Maximum allowable thickness non-uniformity across the wafer surface, expressed as percentage (e.g., ±2% 1-sigma). Critical for yield and device performance.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this deposition condition, tracking revisions and updates over time.

products.name: etch_condition
products.description: Etch process condition master record for dry etch (RIE, ICP, CCP) and wet etch steps. Captures etch type (dry/wet), etchant chemistry, gas flows, chamber pressure, RF power (source and bias), etch rate, selectivity targets, critical dimension bias, endpoint detection method, and associated process step. Covers FEOL gate patterning, contact/via etch, and BEOL metal etch conditions.

attributes.name: etch_condition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the etch process condition master record. Primary key for the etch condition entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm) for which this etch condition is qualified. Links to the technology node master record.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Etch conditions are tied to each IC product to ensure consistent etch performance; used in Etch Process Specification.

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_process_step. Business justification: Etch condition records belong to a specific process step; internal FK provides direct association.

attributes.name: substance_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.substance_inventory. Business justification: Etch steps involve etchant chemicals; compliance requires associating each etch condition with the regulated substance record.

attributes.name: application_scope
attributes.description: Description of the intended application scope or use case for this etch condition (e.g., high aspect ratio contact etch, metal gate patterning, shallow trench isolation).

attributes.name: chamber_pressure_torr
attributes.description: Operating pressure inside the etch chamber measured in Torr. Critical parameter for plasma density and etch uniformity control.

attributes.name: condition_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the etch condition for system tracking and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) integration.

attributes.name: condition_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or identifier for the etch condition recipe. Used for operational reference and communication among process engineers.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this etch condition record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: critical_dimension_bias_nm
attributes.description: Expected change in critical dimension (CD) due to the etch process in nanometers. Positive value indicates CD growth, negative indicates CD shrinkage. Used for Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) and Design for Manufacturability (DFM).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this etch condition is retired or superseded. Null if still active. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this etch condition becomes effective and available for production use. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: endpoint_detection_method
attributes.description: Method used to detect the completion of the etch process. Options include time-based, Optical Emission Spectroscopy (OES), laser interferometry, mass spectrometry, or none for over-etch strategies.

attributes.name: etch_method
attributes.description: Specific etch method or technology used. For dry etch: Reactive Ion Etch (RIE), Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP), Capacitively Coupled Plasma (CCP). For wet etch: immersion or spray.

attributes.name: etch_rate_angstrom_per_minute
attributes.description: Target etch rate for the primary material in angstroms per minute. Key process parameter for throughput and uniformity control.

attributes.name: etch_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the etch process in seconds. May be time-based or endpoint-detection-based depending on the process control strategy.

attributes.name: etch_type
attributes.description: Classification of the etch process as either dry etch (plasma-based: RIE, ICP, CCP) or wet etch (chemical immersion).

attributes.name: etchant_chemistry
attributes.description: The chemical composition of the etchant used. For dry etch: gas mixture (e.g., CF4/O2, SF6/O2, Cl2/BCl3). For wet etch: liquid chemistry (e.g., HF, BOE, H3PO4).

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility where this etch condition is qualified and used. Supports multi-site manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: is_baseline_condition
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the baseline or reference etch condition for the process step. True if this is the standard condition, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this etch condition record was last updated or modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the etch condition. Used for operational guidance and knowledge capture.

attributes.name: over_etch_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of additional etch time beyond endpoint detection to ensure complete material removal. Expressed as a percentage of the main etch time.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit or department responsible for this etch condition (e.g., FEOL Process Engineering, BEOL Integration).

attributes.name: primary_gas_flow_sccm
attributes.description: Flow rate of the primary etch gas in standard cubic centimeters per minute (SCCM). Applicable to dry etch processes.

attributes.name: process_category
attributes.description: Classification of the etch step within the fabrication flow: Front End of Line (FEOL) for gate patterning, Middle of Line (MOL) for contact/via etch, or Back End of Line (BEOL) for metal etch.

attributes.name: profile_angle_degrees
attributes.description: Target sidewall angle of the etched feature in degrees from vertical. 90 degrees indicates perfectly vertical (anisotropic) etch. Critical for device performance and yield.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the etch condition was formally qualified and approved for production use. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification and approval status of the etch condition. Indicates whether the condition is ready for production use or still under development.

attributes.name: recipe_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the etch recipe. Used for change control and traceability when recipe parameters are updated.

attributes.name: rf_bias_power_watts
attributes.description: RF power applied to the substrate electrode (bias power) in watts. Controls ion energy and directionality for anisotropic etching.

attributes.name: rf_source_power_watts
attributes.description: RF power applied to the plasma source coil or electrode in watts. Controls plasma density and etch rate in ICP and CCP systems.

attributes.name: secondary_gas_flow_sccm
attributes.description: Flow rate of the secondary or carrier gas in standard cubic centimeters per minute (SCCM). Used for process tuning and selectivity control.

attributes.name: selectivity_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of etch rate of the target material to the etch rate of the underlying or masking material. Critical for process control and preventing over-etch damage.

attributes.name: substrate_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Temperature of the wafer substrate during the etch process in degrees Celsius. Affects etch rate, selectivity, and profile control.

attributes.name: target_cd_nm
attributes.description: Target critical dimension after etch in nanometers. Defines the intended feature size for the etched structure.

attributes.name: target_layer
attributes.description: The specific layer or material being etched (e.g., polysilicon, oxide, nitride, metal1, metal2, via1, contact). Identifies the layer in the device stack.

attributes.name: target_material
attributes.description: The material composition of the target layer being etched (e.g., silicon, silicon dioxide, silicon nitride, tungsten, copper, aluminum, titanium nitride).

attributes.name: tool_class
attributes.description: Classification or family of etch equipment for which this condition is designed (e.g., Applied Materials Centura, Lam Research Kiyo, Tokyo Electron Tactras).

attributes.name: uniformity_target_percent
attributes.description: Target uniformity of etch depth or CD across the wafer, expressed as a percentage (1-sigma or 3-sigma). Lower values indicate better uniformity.

products.name: cmp_condition
products.description: Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) process condition master record defining slurry chemistry, pad type, platen pressure, carrier speed, table speed, endpoint detection method, target removal amount, post-CMP clean recipe, and within-wafer uniformity spec. Covers STI CMP, ILD CMP, W-plug CMP, Cu damascene CMP, and barrier CMP steps across FEOL, MOL, and BEOL.

attributes.name: cmp_condition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the CMP process condition master record. Primary key.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (process geometry) for which this CMP condition is qualified, such as 7nm, 5nm, 3nm FinFET or GAA nodes.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: CMP conditions are maintained per IC product for the CMP Process Specification and quality control.

attributes.name: substance_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.substance_inventory. Business justification: CMP slurry chemicals are regulated; linking condition to substance inventory supports substance reporting and safety.

attributes.name: carrier_speed_rpm
attributes.description: Rotational speed of the wafer carrier head during CMP processing, measured in revolutions per minute. Affects relative velocity and material removal uniformity.

attributes.name: cmp_step_type
attributes.description: Classification of the CMP process step based on the material and layer being planarized. STI (Shallow Trench Isolation) for FEOL, ILD (Inter-Layer Dielectric) for MOL/BEOL, W-plug for tungsten contact fill, Cu damascene for copper interconnect, barrier for barrier metal removal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: STI|ILD|W-plug|Cu damascene|barrier|poly|tungsten contact|cobalt contact — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: condition_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to this CMP condition for tracking and reference in Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and process control systems.

attributes.name: condition_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or identifier for this CMP process condition, typically including the CMP step type and target layer.

attributes.name: conditioner_type
attributes.description: Type of diamond conditioning disk or brush used to maintain pad surface texture and porosity during CMP processing. Conditioning prevents pad glazing and maintains consistent removal rates.

attributes.name: conditioning_frequency
attributes.description: Schedule for pad conditioning operations, such as ex-situ (between wafers), in-situ (during polishing), or time-based intervals. Maintains pad performance and removal rate stability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CMP condition record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: defect_density_spec_per_wafer
attributes.description: Maximum allowable number of CMP-induced defects per wafer, including scratches, particles, residue, and surface damage. Measured by post-CMP inspection tools.

attributes.name: cmp_condition_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of this CMP process condition, including special considerations, application scope, and any unique characteristics or constraints.

attributes.name: dishing_spec_angstrom
attributes.description: Maximum allowable depression or dishing in metal features (copper lines, tungsten plugs) after CMP, measured in angstroms. Excessive dishing degrades electrical performance and reliability.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this CMP condition version was superseded or retired from production use. Null for currently active conditions.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this CMP condition version became active and available for production use.

attributes.name: endpoint_detection_method
attributes.description: Technology used to determine when the target material removal amount has been achieved. Optical methods detect reflectivity changes, motor current monitors torque variations, time-based uses fixed duration, acoustic detects friction changes, eddy current senses metal thickness.

attributes.name: equipment_class
attributes.description: Classification of CMP tool type qualified for this condition, such as rotary single-wafer, linear, or orbital polisher. Different tool architectures may require condition adjustments.

attributes.name: erosion_spec_angstrom
attributes.description: Maximum allowable thinning of dielectric material in dense pattern areas relative to isolated areas, measured in angstroms. Erosion affects metal line height uniformity and interconnect reliability.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the fabrication facility where this CMP condition is qualified and used. Enables multi-site process tracking and technology transfer.

attributes.name: is_baseline_condition
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the baseline or reference CMP condition for this step type and technology node. Baseline conditions serve as the standard for process capability and yield comparisons.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CMP condition record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or observations related to this CMP condition, including troubleshooting guidance, known issues, or optimization opportunities.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Engineering organization or department responsible for maintaining and updating this CMP process condition.

attributes.name: pad_product_name
attributes.description: Commercial product name or part number of the CMP polishing pad as designated by the vendor.
attributes.references: SEMI C30 - Specification for Polishing Slurries

attributes.name: pad_type
attributes.description: Classification and material composition of the CMP polishing pad, including hardness, porosity, groove pattern, and surface texture characteristics that affect removal rate and uniformity.
attributes.references: SEMI C30 - Specification for Polishing Slurries

attributes.name: pad_vendor
attributes.description: Manufacturer or supplier of the CMP polishing pad used in this process condition.
attributes.references: SEMI C30 - Specification for Polishing Slurries

attributes.name: platen_pressure_psi
attributes.description: Downforce pressure applied by the wafer carrier to the polishing pad surface, measured in pounds per square inch. Critical parameter controlling removal rate and within-wafer uniformity.

attributes.name: polish_time_seconds
attributes.description: Target duration of the CMP polishing step in seconds, from wafer contact with pad to endpoint detection or time-based completion.

attributes.name: post_cmp_clean_recipe
attributes.description: Cleaning process recipe applied immediately after CMP to remove slurry residue, particles, and contaminants from the wafer surface. Typically includes brush scrubbing, chemical rinse, and DI water rinse steps.

attributes.name: process_layer
attributes.description: Manufacturing layer classification indicating whether this CMP step occurs in Front End of Line (FEOL), Middle of Line (MOL), or Back End of Line (BEOL) processing.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when this CMP condition successfully completed qualification testing and was approved for production use.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this CMP condition in the process qualification workflow. Draft conditions are under development, under qualification are being validated, qualified have passed testing, production approved are released for volume manufacturing, suspended are temporarily disabled, obsolete are retired.

attributes.name: qualified_by_engineer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process engineer responsible for qualifying and approving this CMP condition for production use.

attributes.name: removal_rate_angstrom_per_min
attributes.description: Expected rate of material removal during CMP processing, measured in angstroms per minute. Determined by slurry chemistry, pad type, pressure, and speed parameters.

attributes.name: selectivity_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of removal rates between the target material and underlying stop layer or adjacent materials. High selectivity ensures controlled polishing without excessive removal of barrier or dielectric layers.

attributes.name: slurry_chemistry_type
attributes.description: Chemical composition classification of the CMP slurry used in this condition, including abrasive type (silica, ceria, alumina), pH level, and chemical additives for selectivity and removal rate control.
attributes.references: SEMI C30 - Specification for Polishing Slurries

attributes.name: slurry_flow_rate_ml_per_min
attributes.description: Target volumetric flow rate of CMP slurry delivered to the polishing pad surface during processing, measured in milliliters per minute.

attributes.name: slurry_product_name
attributes.description: Commercial product name or part number of the CMP slurry as designated by the vendor.
attributes.references: SEMI C30 - Specification for Polishing Slurries

attributes.name: slurry_vendor
attributes.description: Manufacturer or supplier of the CMP slurry chemical used in this process condition.
attributes.references: SEMI C30 - Specification for Polishing Slurries

attributes.name: table_speed_rpm
attributes.description: Rotational speed of the CMP platen table holding the polishing pad, measured in revolutions per minute. Combined with carrier speed determines relative motion and removal characteristics.

attributes.name: target_layer_name
attributes.description: Specific layer or film stack being planarized by this CMP process, such as oxide, nitride, metal layer designation (M1, M2, etc.), or via layer.

attributes.name: target_removal_amount_angstrom
attributes.description: Specified thickness of material to be removed during the CMP process, measured in angstroms. Critical for achieving target post-CMP film thickness and planarity.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this CMP condition record, incremented when process parameters are modified. Enables change tracking and process history analysis.

attributes.name: wafer_to_wafer_uniformity_spec_percent
attributes.description: Maximum allowable variation in average material removal between wafers processed under this condition, expressed as a percentage. Ensures consistent lot-level processing.

attributes.name: within_wafer_uniformity_spec_percent
attributes.description: Maximum allowable variation in material removal across the wafer surface, expressed as a percentage. Calculated as (max - min) / (2 * mean) * 100. Critical for device performance uniformity.

products.name: litho_condition
products.description: Photolithography process condition master record for a specific layer and technology node. Captures scanner model, wavelength (EUV 13.5nm / DUV 193nm / 248nm), NA, sigma (inner/outer), illumination mode (dipole, quadrupole, freeform), resist type, resist thickness, exposure dose, focus offset, develop process, bake temperatures, and associated OPC rule set reference. Critical for CD control and overlay performance.

attributes.name: litho_condition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the photolithography process condition master record.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm) for which this lithography condition is defined.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Lithography conditions are defined per IC product; needed for Lithography Process Specification and OPC alignment.

attributes.name: opc_rule_set_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) Rule Set ID
attributes.description: Reference to the OPC rule set used to correct mask patterns for optical proximity effects at this lithography condition.

tag_set.value: Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) Rule Set ID

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_process_step. Business justification: Lithography condition is applied to a particular process step; internal FK enables step‑level linkage.

attributes.name: substance_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.substance_inventory. Business justification: Lithography uses photoresist and developers; linking to substance inventory satisfies REACH and hazardous‑material compliance.

attributes.name: cd_tolerance_nm
attributes.description: Allowable tolerance range for critical dimension variation in nanometers.

attributes.name: condition_code
attributes.description: Unique business code or identifier used to reference this lithography condition in manufacturing execution systems.

attributes.name: condition_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or identifier for this specific lithography process condition.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lithography condition record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: depth_of_focus_nm
attributes.description: Depth of focus in nanometers, representing the range over which acceptable image quality is maintained.

attributes.name: develop_process_type
attributes.description: Method used for resist development (e.g., puddle, spray, immersion).

attributes.name: develop_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds for the resist development step.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this lithography condition is no longer valid for production use.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this lithography condition becomes effective for production use.

attributes.name: exposure_dose_mj_cm2
attributes.description: Exposure energy dose in millijoules per square centimeter required to properly expose the resist.

attributes.name: exposure_latitude_percent
attributes.description: Exposure latitude as a percentage, indicating the allowable variation in exposure dose while maintaining acceptable CD control.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility where this lithography condition is used.

attributes.name: focus_offset_nm
attributes.description: Focus offset from best focus position in nanometers, used to optimize depth of focus and process window.

attributes.name: hard_bake_temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature in Celsius for the hard bake step performed after development to stabilize the resist pattern.

attributes.name: hard_bake_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds for the hard bake step.

attributes.name: illumination_mode
attributes.description: Off-axis illumination mode used to enhance resolution and process window (e.g., dipole, quadrupole, freeform).

attributes.name: is_baseline_condition
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the baseline or reference lithography condition for the layer and technology node.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lithography condition record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the semiconductor layer (e.g., Metal1, Poly, Contact) to which this lithography condition applies.

attributes.name: lithography_type
attributes.description: Type of lithography technology used: EUV (Extreme Ultraviolet), DUV (Deep Ultraviolet), i-line, or g-line.

attributes.name: multi_patterning_type
attributes.description: Multi-patterning technique used: none, LELE (Litho-Etch-Litho-Etch), SADP (Self-Aligned Double Patterning), SAQP (Self-Aligned Quadruple Patterning), or EUV single exposure.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this lithography condition.

attributes.name: numerical_aperture
attributes.description: Numerical aperture of the scanner lens system, determining resolution capability (e.g., 0.33 for EUV, 1.35 for immersion DUV).

attributes.name: overlay_tolerance_nm
attributes.description: Maximum allowable overlay error in nanometers between this layer and previous layers.

attributes.name: owner_engineer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process engineer responsible for this lithography condition definition and maintenance.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Organization or department responsible for this lithography condition (e.g., Lithography Engineering, Process Integration).

attributes.name: post_exposure_bake_temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature in Celsius for the post-exposure bake step, critical for chemically amplified resists.

attributes.name: post_exposure_bake_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds for the post-exposure bake step.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when this lithography condition was qualified for production use.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification status of this lithography condition in the process development lifecycle.

attributes.name: resist_thickness_nm
attributes.description: Target thickness of the photoresist coating in nanometers.

attributes.name: resist_type
attributes.description: Type or brand of photoresist material used (e.g., chemically amplified resist, metal oxide resist for EUV).

attributes.name: scanner_model
attributes.description: Model name or identifier of the photolithography scanner equipment (e.g., ASML NXE:3400, Nikon NSR-S630D) used for this condition.

attributes.name: sigma_inner
attributes.description: Inner sigma value defining the inner radius of the illumination pupil, used for off-axis illumination optimization.

attributes.name: sigma_outer
attributes.description: Outer sigma value defining the outer radius of the illumination pupil, used for off-axis illumination optimization.

attributes.name: target_cd_nm
attributes.description: Target critical dimension (linewidth or feature size) in nanometers that this lithography condition is designed to achieve.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this lithography condition, used to track revisions and changes over time.

attributes.name: wavelength_nm
attributes.description: Exposure wavelength in nanometers (e.g., 13.5 for EUV, 193 for ArF DUV, 248 for KrF DUV).

products.name: ocap_action
products.description: Out-of-Control Action Plan (OCAP) action record triggered when an SPC rule violation or process excursion is detected. Captures the triggering SPC event reference, OCAP procedure reference, action type (hold lot, notify engineer, adjust recipe, escalate), assigned engineer, action timestamp, resolution description, lot disposition, and root cause classification. Implements the corrective response workflow for process excursions per IATF 16949 and SEMI SPC guidelines.
products.reference: SEMI SPC OCAP / IATF 16949 Corrective Action

attributes.name: ocap_action_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the OCAP action record triggered by an SPC rule violation or process excursion event.
attributes.references: SEMI E133 - Specification for SEMI Equipment Communications Standard 2 Message Content (SECS-II)

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing equipment where the process excursion was detected.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability (RAM)

attributes.name: fabrication_process_step_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific process step where the SPC excursion occurred and triggered the OCAP action.
attributes.references: SEMI E133 - Specification for SEMI Equipment Communications Standard 2 Message Content (SECS-II)

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node associated with the process flow where the excursion occurred.
attributes.references: SEMI E133 - Specification for SEMI Equipment Communications Standard 2 Message Content (SECS-II)

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wafer lot that was in process when the SPC excursion was detected and OCAP action was triggered.
attributes.references: SEMI E133 - Specification for SEMI Equipment Communications Standard 2 Message Content (SECS-II)

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: OCAP actions are logged against the specific IC product they affect; used in OCAP Action Tracking per Product.

attributes.name: primary_ocap_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the process engineer or quality engineer assigned to investigate and resolve the OCAP action.

attributes.name: primary_spc_control_chart_id
attributes.description: FK to process.spc_control_chart.spc_control_chart_id — OCAP actions are triggered by SPC rule violations on a specific control chart. This FK enables traceability from corrective action back to the triggering monitoring event.

attributes.name: spc_measurement_id
attributes.description: FK to process.spc_measurement.spc_measurement_id — OCAP actions are triggered by specific SPC rule violations on measurements. This link connects the corrective action to its triggering event.

attributes.name: tertiary_ocap_assigned_engineer_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tertiary Ocap Assigned Engineer Employee Id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

tag_set.value: Tertiary Ocap Assigned Engineer Employee Id

attributes.name: action_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the OCAP action was completed and the process excursion was resolved.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Automotive Quality Management System Standard

attributes.name: action_initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the OCAP action was formally initiated in response to the detected excursion.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Automotive Quality Management System Standard

attributes.name: action_status
attributes.description: Current status of the OCAP action in its lifecycle from initiation through resolution.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Automotive Quality Management System Standard

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Type of corrective action taken in response to the SPC excursion. Defines the immediate response workflow per OCAP procedure. attributes.references: SEMI E133 - Specification for SEMI Equipment Communications Standard 2 Message Content (SECS-II)

attributes.name: affected_wafer_count
attributes.description: Number of wafers in the lot that were affected by the process excursion and subject to the OCAP action.
attributes.references: SEMI E133 - Specification for SEMI Equipment Communications Standard 2 Message Content (SECS-II)

attributes.name: assigned_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit or department responsible for executing the OCAP action (e.g., Process Engineering, Quality Assurance, Equipment Engineering).

attributes.name: closure_notes
attributes.description: Final notes and comments documenting the closure of the OCAP action, including lessons learned and recommendations for process improvement.

attributes.name: containment_action_flag

attributes.name: corrective_action_description

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the OCAP action record was first created in the manufacturing execution system.

attributes.name: customer_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer was notified about the process excursion and its potential impact on product quality.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Automotive Quality Management System Standard

attributes.name: customer_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether customer notification is required due to the potential impact of the excursion on delivered product quality.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Automotive Quality Management System Standard

attributes.name: detection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the SPC rule violation or process excursion was detected by the control chart monitoring system.
attributes.references: SEMI E133 - Specification for SEMI Equipment Communications Standard 2 Message Content (SECS-II)

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Level of management escalation required for the OCAP action based on severity and business impact.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Automotive Quality Management System Standard

attributes.name: escalation_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the OCAP action required escalation to senior engineering or management due to severity or complexity.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Automotive Quality Management System Standard

attributes.name: excursion_severity

attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Automotive Quality Management System Standard

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility where the process excursion occurred and the OCAP action was executed.
attributes.references: SEMI E133 - Specification for SEMI Equipment Communications Standard 2 Message Content (SECS-II)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the OCAP action record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lot_disposition
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the affected wafer lot after OCAP action completion (e.g., released to next step, held for further investigation, scrapped).
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Automotive Quality Management System Standard

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or observations related to the OCAP action that provide context for future reference and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: ocap_procedure_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the documented OCAP procedure that defines the corrective response workflow for this type of excursion.

attributes.name: ocap_responds_to_excursion
attributes.description: FK to process.process_excursion.process_excursion_id — OCAP actions are triggered by excursions/SPC violations. This link connects the corrective action to its triggering event for audit trail and effectiveness tracking.

attributes.name: preventive_action_description

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: root_cause_classification

attributes.name: root_cause_description

attributes.name: spc_rule_violated

attributes.name: verification_method

products.name: process_technology_node
products.description: Reference master for semiconductor technology nodes (process generations) supported by the fab. Captures node name (e.g., 5nm, 3nm, 28nm, 65nm), node generation, device architecture (planar, FinFET, GAA), minimum metal pitch, gate pitch, DRAM half-pitch, introduction year, production readiness status, and associated PDK version. Serves as the top-level classification anchor for process flows, OPC rule sets, and process capability records.

attributes.name: process_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the semiconductor technology node record. Primary key.

attributes.name: product_process_node_id

attributes.name: technology_control_plan_id

attributes.name: application_scope

attributes.name: baseline_cpk

attributes.name: baseline_yield_target_percent

attributes.name: beol_layer_count

attributes.name: process_technology_node_description

attributes.name: design_rule_complexity

products.name: excursion
products.description: Process excursion record capturing any significant out-of-spec, out-of-control, or yield-impacting condition detected during wafer manufacturing that requires formal engineering investigation. Encompasses all yield loss events as a unified excursion type. Captures excursion detection source (SPC, inspection, metrology, electrical test), affected lot list, process step, excursion severity (minor/major/critical), yield loss mode (parametric, systematic, random, electrical), defect density, affected die count, estimated yield impact, detection timestamp, containment actions taken, root cause category, corrective action reference, investigation status, and final disposition. Serves as the single parent investigation record for all process-related yield and excursion events. Distinct from individual OCAP actions which are the immediate corrective responses. SSOT for process excursion and yield loss tracking; quality domain owns outgoing quality excursions and customer returns.

attributes.name: disposition_timestamp

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: specification_upper_limit

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: upper_control_limit

attributes.name: yield_loss_mode
attributes.description: Classification of the yield loss mechanism. Parametric indicates parameter drift, systematic indicates repeatable pattern defects, random indicates sporadic defects, electrical indicates functional test failures, none indicates no yield impact detected.

products.description: Design of Experiments (DOE) record for process optimization and characterization studies. Captures experiment title, process step under study, DOE type (full factorial, fractional factorial, RSM, Taguchi), factors and levels, response variables, wafer split plan, run order, statistical analysis method, key findings, recommended setpoint changes, and process window characterization results. Supports process capability improvement, new technology node development, and recipe optimization.

domains.name: product
domains.description: Authoritative semiconductor product catalog encompassing ICs, SoCs, ASICs, FPGAs, IP cores, and discrete devices. SSOT for product specifications, SKUs, BOM, process node assignments, PPA metrics, product lifecycle status (NPI through EOL), PCN management, and LTB notifications. Integrates with PLM systems.

products.name: ic_catalog
products.description: Master record for all semiconductor products (ICs, SoCs, ASICs, FPGAs, discretes, licensable IP cores). SSOT for product identity, internal/external part numbers, product family assignment, process node, target market, and lifecycle state with full NPI→qualification→production→EOL transition history. Golden record integrated with PLM. Each entry represents a unique silicon design with one or more orderable SKU variants.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the IC catalog entry. Primary key for the master record of semiconductor products including ICs, SoCs, ASICs, FPGAs, discretes, and licensable IP cores.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for product cost tracking and profitability reporting; each IC is assigned to a cost center for budgeting.

attributes.name: eccn_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.eccn_classification. Business justification: Required for Export Control: each IC must be linked to its ECCN classification for export compliance reporting.

attributes.name: family_id
attributes.description: FK to product.product_family

attributes.name: packaging_package_type_id
attributes.description: FK to packaging.package_type

attributes.name: primary_ic_process_node_id
attributes.description: FK to product.process_node.process_node_id — Every IC product is manufactured on a specific process node. This is a fundamental product attribute that references the process node master.

attributes.name: product_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Required for Product Portfolio Management report: each IC catalog entry must have a designated product manager employee.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: Procurement process requires linking each IC catalog entry to its primary supplier for sourcing, cost analysis, and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: aec_qualification_level
attributes.description: Specific AEC qualification standard met. Q100: ICs, Q101: Discretes, Q102: Optoelectronics, Q200: Passives. Set to NA if not automotive qualified.

attributes.name: automotive_qualified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product has passed automotive-grade qualification testing per AEC-Q standards. Required for automotive market. Includes extended temperature, reliability, and quality requirements.

attributes.name: catalog_to_family
attributes.description: FK to product.product_family.product_family_id — Every IC product belongs to a product family in the taxonomy hierarchy. This is the primary classification FK.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the IC was manufactured or substantially transformed. Used for trade compliance, tariffs, and country-of-origin marking requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IC catalog record was first created in the PLM system. Audit trail for data governance and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: design_type
attributes.description: Design methodology used for IC development. Determines NRE cost, time to market, and flexibility. Full custom offers maximum optimization; standard cell balances speed and cost.

attributes.name: die_size_mm2
attributes.description: Physical die area in square millimeters after final layout. Critical cost driver as it determines dies per wafer and manufacturing yield economics. Part of PPA metrics.

attributes.name: ear_eccn_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN)
attributes.description: ECCN code assigned under US Export Administration Regulations. Determines export licensing requirements for dual-use items. Format: 3A001.a. EAR99 indicates no specific ECCN.

tag_set.value: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN)

attributes.name: eol_announcement_date
attributes.description: Date when EOL was formally announced to customers via Product Change Notification (PCN). Triggers last-time-buy (LTB) planning and customer transition activities.

attributes.name: external_part_number
attributes.description: Customer-facing orderable part number published in datasheets and used for commercial transactions. May differ from internal part number for marketing or legacy reasons.

attributes.name: first_silicon_date
attributes.description: Date when first fabricated silicon wafers were received from the fab for initial testing and validation. Marks start of silicon bring-up phase.

attributes.name: hts_code
attributes.description: US Harmonized Tariff Schedule classification code for customs and import duty determination. Format: 8542.31.0000 for electronic integrated circuits.

attributes.name: internal_part_number
attributes.description: Company-assigned unique part number for internal identification, tracking, and PLM integration. Primary business identifier for the IC design.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this catalog entry is currently active and available for business operations. False indicates archived or soft-deleted record retained for historical reference.

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is subject to ITAR export controls for defense-related articles. True if product requires US State Department export license for international shipment.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled

attributes.name: last_ship_date
attributes.description: Final date when product shipments will be made. Marks complete discontinuation of the product. Typically 6-12 months after last-time-buy date to allow for manufacturing lead time.

attributes.name: last_time_buy_date
attributes.description: Final date for customers to place orders before product is discontinued. Typically 6-12 months after EOL announcement. After this date, no new orders are accepted.

attributes.name: lead_free_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product meets RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances) lead-free requirements. True if compliant with EU RoHS Directive for lead-free solder and materials.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current stage in the product lifecycle from New Product Introduction (NPI) through End of Life (EOL). Governs manufacturing, sales, and support activities. Transitions tracked in status history. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NPI|Qualification|Production|Mature|EOL_Announced|EOL_Active|Obsolete — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IC catalog record was last updated. Tracks data currency and change history for audit and synchronization purposes.

attributes.name: npi_phase
attributes.description: Detailed phase within NPI lifecycle for products in pre-production stages. Tracks progress from concept through design, tapeout, silicon bring-up, and qualification. Set to NA for production products. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Concept|Design|Tapeout|Silicon_Validation|Qualification|Ramp|Production|NA — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: operating_frequency_max_mhz
attributes.description: Maximum clock frequency in MHz at which the IC can reliably operate. Key performance metric for processors, SoCs, and high-speed digital circuits. Part of PPA metrics.

attributes.name: operating_voltage_max_v
attributes.description: Maximum supply voltage in volts for safe operation. Defines upper bound of operating voltage range. Exceeding this may cause device damage or reliability issues.

attributes.name: operating_voltage_min_v
attributes.description: Minimum supply voltage in volts for guaranteed operation. Defines lower bound of operating voltage range for power optimization and battery operation.

attributes.name: pin_count
attributes.description: Total number of external pins or balls on the package. Determines PCB routing complexity, package cost, and I/O capability.

attributes.name: power_max_mw
attributes.description: Maximum power consumption in milliwatts under worst-case operating conditions. Used for thermal design, power supply sizing, and system integration planning.

attributes.name: power_typical_mw
attributes.description: Typical operating power consumption in milliwatts under nominal conditions. Critical PPA metric for mobile, IoT, and battery-powered applications. Measured at specified voltage and frequency.

attributes.name: process_technology
attributes.description: Underlying semiconductor process technology architecture. Examples: CMOS (Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor), FinFET (Fin Field-Effect Transistor), GAA (Gate All Around), BiCMOS (Bipolar CMOS). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CMOS|FinFET|GAA|BiCMOS|SOI|GaN|SiGe — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name of the IC product used in customer communications, datasheets, and sales collateral.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the semiconductor product type. Determines design flow, manufacturing process, and business model (silicon vs. licensable IP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IC|SoC|ASIC|FPGA|IP_Core|Discrete|Memory|Analog|Mixed_Signal|RF — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: production_release_date
attributes.description: Date when product was officially released to production status and made available for volume manufacturing and customer orders. Marks end of qualification phase.

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates compliance with EU REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals) regulation. Confirms no Substances of Very High Concern (SVHC) above threshold.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates full compliance with EU RoHS Directive restricting hazardous substances (lead, mercury, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, PBB, PBDE). Required for European market access.

attributes.name: rtl_language
attributes.description: Hardware description language used for RTL design specification. Verilog and SystemVerilog are industry standard for digital design. Set to NA for analog-only or IP-only products.

attributes.name: tapeout_date
attributes.description: Date when final GDSII design database was released to the fab for mask generation and wafer fabrication. Marks completion of design phase and start of manufacturing.

attributes.name: target_market
attributes.description: Primary market segment or application domain for which the IC is designed. Determines qualification requirements, reliability standards, and regulatory compliance needs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Automotive|Consumer|Industrial|Medical|Aerospace|Defense|Telecom|Computing|IoT|AI_ML — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: temperature_grade
attributes.description: Temperature range classification determining qualified operating environment. Commercial: 0-70C, Industrial: -40-85C, Automotive: -40-125C, Military: -55-125C. Critical for market qualification.

attributes.name: transistor_count
attributes.description: Total number of transistors on the die. Key complexity metric for digital ICs and SoCs. Used for design effort estimation and manufacturing complexity assessment.

products.name: sku
products.description: Stock-keeping unit records representing orderable, shippable variants of catalog products. Each SKU captures the specific combination of package type, speed grade, temperature range, voltage variant, and qualification level (commercial, industrial, automotive AEC-Q100/Q101) that constitutes a distinct orderable item. Links to ic_catalog for the parent product definition and to inventory for stock tracking.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock keeping unit record. Primary key for the SKU entity representing a distinct orderable variant of a catalog product.

attributes.name: packaging_package_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to packaging.package_type. Business justification: SKU definition must reference the exact package type; required for Packaging Specification report.

attributes.name: primary_sku_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product definition in the IC catalog. Links this SKU to the base product design and specification.

attributes.name: replacement_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recommended replacement SKU for customers when this SKU reaches end of life. Facilitates design migration and continuity planning.
attributes.references: JEDEC JEP131 Product Change Notification Standards

attributes.name: sales_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Needed for Sales Forecasting process: each SKU is owned by a sales employee who approves forecasts and pricing.

attributes.name: to_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: FK to product.ic_catalog.ic_catalog_id — Every SKU is an orderable variant of a catalog product. This is the most fundamental FK in the domain — without it, SKUs are orphaned from their parent product definition.

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Externally-facing unique alphanumeric code identifying this orderable SKU variant. Used in customer orders, invoices, and supply chain documentation.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the country where final manufacturing or substantial transformation occurred. Required for customs documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SKU record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: customer_part_number
attributes.description: Optional customer-specific part number assigned to this SKU for custom or design-win scenarios. Facilitates customer BOM alignment.
attributes.references: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Customer Material Info

attributes.name: eccn_code
attributes.description: US Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) Export Administration Regulations (EAR) classification code. Determines export licensing requirements.

attributes.name: eol_announcement_date
attributes.description: Date when Product Change Notification (PCN) was issued announcing the end of life for this SKU. Triggers Last Time Buy (LTB) planning for customers.
attributes.references: JEDEC JEP131 Product Change Notification Standards

attributes.name: halogen_free
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is manufactured without halogen-containing materials (chlorine, bromine compounds). Required for certain environmental certifications.

attributes.name: hts_code
attributes.description: International customs classification code for tariff and duty calculation. Used for cross-border shipments and trade compliance.

attributes.name: introduction_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU was first made available for customer orders. Marks the transition from NPI to Active lifecycle status.

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is subject to US ITAR export controls for defense articles. Requires special licensing and handling procedures.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SKU record was most recently updated. Tracks data currency and change history.

attributes.name: last_ship_date
attributes.description: Final date when shipments of this SKU will be fulfilled. Marks the end of product availability and transition to discontinued status.

attributes.name: last_time_buy_date
attributes.description: Final date for customers to place orders for this SKU before discontinuation. Typically 6-12 months after EOL announcement.
attributes.references: JEDEC JEP131 Product Change Notification Standards

attributes.name: lead_time_weeks
attributes.description: Typical manufacturing and delivery lead time in weeks from order placement to shipment. Subject to capacity allocation and supply chain conditions.
attributes.references: SAP Production Planning (PP) Lead Time Scheduling

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current stage in the product lifecycle. NPI (New Product Introduction), Active (full production), Mature (stable demand), Declining (phase-out), EOL Announced (End of Life notice issued), Discontinued (no longer available).

attributes.name: list_price_usd
attributes.description: Published list price in US dollars for this SKU at 1000-unit quantity. Actual transaction prices subject to volume discounts and customer agreements.
attributes.references: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Pricing Conditions

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Official manufacturer part number assigned to this SKU. Used for cross-reference with distributor catalogs and customer Bill of Materials (BOM).

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Smallest quantity that can be ordered for this SKU in a single purchase order line. Driven by packaging constraints and economic order quantities.
attributes.references: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Sales Unit

attributes.name: moisture_sensitivity_level
attributes.description: JEDEC moisture sensitivity classification indicating required storage and handling conditions before reflow soldering. MSL1 (unlimited floor life) to MSL6 (mandatory bake before use). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MSL1|MSL2|MSL2a|MSL3|MSL4|MSL5|MSL5a|MSL6 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: orderable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is currently available for new customer orders. May be false during allocation, quality holds, or phase-out periods.
attributes.references: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Material Status

attributes.name: pcn_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any changes to this SKU specification, manufacturing process, or supply chain require formal Product Change Notification (PCN) to customers per contractual or regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: JEDEC JEP131 Product Change Notification Standards

attributes.name: pin_count
attributes.description: Total number of electrical pins or balls on the package. Critical for PCB design and routing complexity assessment.

attributes.name: qualification_level
attributes.description: Reliability and qualification standard met by this SKU. AEC-Q100 for automotive ICs, AEC-Q101 for discrete automotive, MIL-STD-883 for military/aerospace.
attributes.references: AEC-Q100 Automotive Qualification, AEC-Q101 Discrete Qualification, MIL-STD-883 Military Standards

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU meets EU REACH regulation requirements for chemical substance registration and disclosure.

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU meets EU RoHS directive requirements for restricted substances (lead, mercury, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, PBB, PBDE).

attributes.name: shippable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is currently authorized for shipment. May be false during quality holds, regulatory blocks, or export restrictions.

attributes.name: speed_grade
attributes.description: Performance binning classification indicating maximum operating frequency or timing specification. Higher grades command premium pricing.

attributes.name: standard_cost_usd
attributes.description: Fully-loaded standard manufacturing cost in US dollars including wafer fabrication, assembly, test, and allocated overhead. Used for margin analysis and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: standard_pack_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units in a standard shipping container (tape and reel, tray, tube). Orders are typically placed in multiples of this quantity.
attributes.references: JEDEC JEP113 Tape and Reel Standards

attributes.name: temperature_range
attributes.description: Qualified operating temperature range classification. Commercial (0-70C), Industrial (-40-85C), Automotive (-40-125C), Military (-55-125C), Extended (-40-105C).

attributes.name: unit_weight_grams
attributes.description: Weight of a single packaged unit in grams. Used for shipping cost calculation and logistics planning.

attributes.name: voltage_variant
attributes.description: Core or I/O voltage specification variant for this SKU. Defines power supply requirements and compatibility with system voltage rails.

products.name: family
products.description: Hierarchical grouping of related IC products into product families and sub-families (e.g., Cortex-class SoCs, automotive MCU family, RF transceiver family). Manages the multi-level product taxonomy used for roadmap planning, pricing strategy, and customer design-in targeting. Supports up to five levels of hierarchy: portfolio → family → sub-family → product → variant.

attributes.name: family_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product family. Primary key for the product family entity.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Family Management Dashboard requires linking each product family to its responsible manager employee.

attributes.name: parent_family_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product family in the hierarchy. Supports multi-level taxonomy: portfolio → family → sub-family → product → variant. Null for top-level portfolio entries.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Product families map to profit centers to attribute revenue and margin in financial statements.

attributes.name: active_pcn_count
attributes.description: Number of active PCNs currently in effect for this product family. Indicates ongoing changes to process, materials, or design that require customer notification and approval.

attributes.name: application_domain

attributes.name: eol_date

attributes.name: external_bom_reference

attributes.name: itar_controlled_flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: lot_size

attributes.name: ltb_notification_date

attributes.name: plant_code

attributes.name: production_version

attributes.name: reach_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: revision

attributes.name: rohs_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the BOM and all its components meet RoHS directive requirements for restriction of hazardous substances. Rolled up from component-level compliance data.

tag_set.value: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: scrap_percentage

attributes.name: total_component_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct component line items in this BOM. Provides quick visibility into BOM complexity without querying detail records.

attributes.name: total_material_cost
attributes.description: Rolled-up total material cost for all components in this BOM, calculated from component costs and quantities. Used for product costing and margin analysis.

attributes.name: usage
attributes.description: Intended usage context for this BOM: production for manufacturing execution, costing for financial analysis, engineering for design reference, maintenance for service operations, or sales for customer quotations.

products.name: bom_line
products.description: Line items within a product BOM, each representing a component or sub-assembly. Captures component part number, quantity per assembly, UoM, component type (die, package substrate, passive, interposer), approved substitutes, lead time, and compliance attributes (RoHS, REACH, conflict minerals). Supports multi-level BOM explosion for cost rollup and supply chain risk analysis.

attributes.name: bom_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the BOM line item. Primary key for the BOM line entity.

attributes.name: parent_line_bom_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent BOM line in a multi-level BOM structure. Null for top-level components. Enables recursive BOM explosion and indented BOM reports.

attributes.name: primary_bom_employee_id
attributes.description: The user ID or system account that created this BOM line record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: primary_bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent BOM header that this line belongs to. Links the line item to the overall product BOM structure.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary supplier or vendor for this component. Links to supplier master data for procurement and supply chain management.

attributes.name: to_bom_header
attributes.description: FK to product.bom.bom_id — BOM lines are detail records belonging to a BOM header. This is a classic header-line pattern that is non-negotiable for BOM explosion and cost rollup.

attributes.name: to_bom_id
attributes.description: FK to product.bom.bom_id — Classic header-line relationship. BOM lines are meaningless without their parent BOM header.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM line is currently active and should be used in production planning and costing. Inactive lines are retained for historical reference but excluded from current operations.

attributes.name: approved_substitute_part_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of approved alternate or substitute part numbers that can be used in place of the primary component. Supports supply chain flexibility and risk mitigation.

attributes.name: assembly_process_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the assembly or packaging process used to integrate this component (e.g., wirebond, flip-chip, CoWoS, InFO). Links to process routing and manufacturing execution.

attributes.name: bom_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of this component in the multi-level BOM structure. Level 0 is the finished product, level 1 is direct sub-assembly, level 2 is sub-component of level 1, and so on. Supports BOM explosion for cost rollup and supply chain analysis.

attributes.name: component_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the component, including technical specifications, material properties, and functional purpose within the assembly.

attributes.name: component_part_number
attributes.description: The unique part number or SKU of the component material used in this BOM line. May reference die, package substrate, passive components, interposer, or other materials.

attributes.name: component_type
attributes.description: Classification of the component by its functional role in the semiconductor assembly. Includes die (silicon chip), package substrate, passive components (resistors, capacitors), interposer, leadframe, wirebond, solder ball, underfill material, and mold compound. attributes.name: conflict_minerals_status

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the standard cost. Supports multi-currency costing and global supply chain operations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: critical_component_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is critical to product functionality, quality, or supply chain continuity. Used for risk assessment and inventory planning.

attributes.name: ear_eccn_code
