attributes.name: effectivity_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this BOM line becomes obsolete or is replaced. Null for currently active components. Supports phase-in/phase-out scenarios and Product Change Notification (PCN) tracking.

attributes.name: effectivity_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this BOM line becomes effective. Supports date-based BOM versioning and engineering change management.

attributes.name: engineering_change_order_number
attributes.description: The ECO number that introduced or last modified this BOM line. Provides traceability to engineering change management processes.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Engineering Change Order

attributes.name: itar_controlled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component is subject to ITAR export controls for defense-related articles and services. Critical for aerospace and defense semiconductor applications.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the parent BOM, used for ordering and referencing specific components in the assembly hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP BOM Line Item

attributes.name: make_or_buy_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component is manufactured in-house (make), procured externally (buy), or transferred from another plant (transfer). Drives procurement and production planning logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Material Master Procurement Type

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: The name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) or component manufacturer. May differ from the supplier if purchased through distributors.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: The manufacturers original part number for the component. Used for cross-referencing and supplier communication.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context, assembly instructions, quality requirements, or special handling instructions for this BOM line.

attributes.name: phantom_bom_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a phantom or transient sub-assembly that is not stocked or tracked as inventory. Phantom BOMs are exploded through during MRP but not manufactured as discrete items.

attributes.name: procurement_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The typical lead time in days required to procure this component from suppliers. Used for material requirements planning (MRP) and supply chain risk analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Info Record

attributes.name: quantity_per_assembly
attributes.description: The quantity of this component required to produce one unit of the parent assembly. Supports fractional quantities for materials measured by weight or volume.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP BOM Component Quantity

attributes.name: reach_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component complies with EU REACH Regulation for chemical substance registration and safety. Required for European market access.

attributes.name: reference_designator
attributes.description: The reference designator or location identifier for the component on the physical layout or assembly drawing (e.g., U1, C23, R45). Links BOM to physical design.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether the component complies with EU RoHS Directive restricting hazardous substances (lead, mercury, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, PBB, PBDE). Critical for regulatory compliance and market access.

attributes.description: Expected scrap or yield loss percentage for this component during manufacturing. Used to calculate net material requirements accounting for process losses.

attributes.name: standard_cost

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the component quantity is expressed. Common values include EA (each), KG (kilogram), G (gram), L (liter), ML (milliliter), M (meter), MM (millimeter), WAFER, DIE. products.name: pcn
products.description: Product Change Notification records documenting all planned changes to product specifications, materials, manufacturing processes, or package configurations. Captures PCN number, change type (process, material, package, test), affected SKUs, change rationale, qualification plan, customer notification list, JEDEC JESD46 compliance status, and implementation timeline. Integrates with Oracle Agile PLM change management workflow.

attributes.name: pcn_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product change notification record. Primary key.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: change_notification_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Agile Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Change Order ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier from Oracle Agile PLM system linking this PCN to the formal engineering change order (ECO) or manufacturing change order (MCO) that implements the change.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Change Management Workflow

tag_set.value: Agile Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Change Order ID

attributes.name: change_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: PCN Change Management process mandates linking each change to the responsible engineer employee for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: primary_pcn_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: pcn records are change notifications for specific IC products; linking pcn to ic_catalog provides parent relationship and enables traceability.

attributes.name: to_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: FK to product.ic_catalog.ic_catalog_id — Product Change Notifications affect specific products. Must reference the affected catalog entry (may be multi-valued via junction).

attributes.name: affected_customer_count
attributes.description: Total number of customers who have active orders, design-ins, or inventory of the affected products and must be notified of the change.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Change Management Workflow

attributes.name: affected_product_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated or structured list of product SKUs, part numbers, or device families impacted by this change. May reference specific die revisions, package codes, or product lines.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the PCN received final internal approval from engineering, quality, and business stakeholders to proceed with customer notification and implementation.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Change Management Workflow

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the executive or manager who provided final approval for the PCN, typically a VP of Engineering, Quality Director, or Product Line Manager.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Change Management Workflow

attributes.name: automotive_qualification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the change requires re-qualification under automotive quality standards such as IATF 16949 or AEC-Q100/Q200, applicable when affected products are used in automotive applications.

attributes.name: change_category
attributes.description: Severity classification of the change: major (requires customer qualification), minor (limited impact, may require notification), or notification_only (informational, no action required).
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: change_description
attributes.description: Detailed technical description of the product change, including what is being modified, the scope of the change, and technical specifications affected.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: change_owner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the change owner for customer inquiries and internal coordination regarding the PCN.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Change Management Workflow

attributes.name: change_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the engineer, product manager, or business owner responsible for driving the PCN through approval, customer notification, and implementation.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Change Management Workflow

attributes.name: change_rationale
attributes.description: Business and technical justification for the change, including reasons such as cost reduction, yield improvement, supply chain continuity, obsolescence mitigation, or performance enhancement.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: change_title
attributes.description: Brief descriptive title summarizing the nature of the product change for quick identification.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the PCN record was first created in the system, marking the initiation of the change notification process.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Change Management Workflow

attributes.name: customer_approval_count
attributes.description: Number of customers who explicitly approved or acknowledged acceptance of the proposed change.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: customer_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit customer approval or acknowledgment is required before implementing the change, typically true for major changes affecting form, fit, or function.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: customer_objection_count
attributes.description: Number of customers who formally objected to or raised concerns about the proposed change during the notification period.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: customer_response_deadline
attributes.description: Date by which customers must provide feedback, objections, or approval for the proposed change. After this date, silence may be interpreted as acceptance per JEDEC guidelines.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the product change will be implemented in production and new product shipments will reflect the change. Typically allows customer qualification time after notification.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: electrical_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Engineering assessment of how the change affects electrical characteristics such as timing, power consumption, signal integrity, or parametric specifications.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the change affects environmental compliance status, including RoHS, REACH, halogen-free, or conflict minerals declarations.

attributes.name: form_fit_function_impact
attributes.description: Classification of whether the change affects form (physical dimensions/appearance), fit (mechanical interchangeability), function (electrical/performance characteristics), multiple aspects, or none. Critical for customer qualification scope determination.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: implementation_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the product change was implemented in production and new shipments began reflecting the change. May differ from planned effective_date.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: jedec_compliance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Joint Electron Device Engineering Council (JEDEC) Compliance Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PCN process and content comply with JEDEC JESD46 standard requirements for product change notification in the semiconductor industry.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

tag_set.value: Joint Electron Device Engineering Council (JEDEC) Compliance Status

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the PCN record, tracking changes to status, dates, or other attributes throughout the PCN lifecycle.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Change Management Workflow

attributes.name: last_ship_date
attributes.description: Final date by which product manufactured under the old specification will be shipped to customers. Marks the end of old-spec product availability.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: last_time_buy_date
attributes.description: Final date by which customers can place orders for product manufactured under the old specification before the change takes effect. Applicable for major changes requiring customer transition planning.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: new_specification
attributes.description: Technical specification, process parameters, material composition, or design revision identifier for the product after the change. Defines the target state.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the PCN was officially communicated to affected customers, typically via email, customer portal, or formal letter.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: old_specification
attributes.description: Technical specification, process parameters, material composition, or design revision identifier for the product before the change. Provides baseline for comparison.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: pcn_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the PCN, typically formatted as PCN-YYYYNNNN. Used for customer communication and tracking.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: pcn_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the PCN: draft (being prepared), pending_approval (awaiting internal review), approved (ready for customer notification), customer_notification_sent (communicated to affected customers), in_qualification (customers testing), implemented (change is live in production), cancelled (change abandoned), or superseded (replaced by newer PCN). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|customer_notification_sent|in_qualification|implemented|cancelled|superseded — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM Change Management Workflow

attributes.name: pcn_type
attributes.description: Classification of the change being notified: process change (fab process modification), material change (substrate or compound change), package change (assembly or form factor), test change (ATE or test flow), design change (die revision), or specification change (datasheet update).
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: qualification_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when internal qualification testing was successfully completed and the change was validated for production release.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: qualification_plan
attributes.description: Description of the testing and validation activities required to qualify the changed product, including reliability tests, electrical characterization, and compatibility verification per JEDEC standards.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current state of internal qualification testing for the changed product: not_started, in_progress, completed (passed all tests), failed (did not meet criteria), or waived (qualification not required for this change category).
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: related_pcn_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of related PCN numbers that are associated with this change, such as dependent changes, parallel changes to related products, or prerequisite notifications.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: reliability_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Engineering assessment of how the change affects product reliability, including MTBF, failure modes, stress test results, and long-term performance predictions.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD47 Stress Test Qualification Standards

attributes.name: sample_request_deadline
attributes.description: Last date by which customers can request evaluation samples of the changed product for their own qualification testing.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: samples_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether product samples manufactured with the new change are available for customer evaluation and qualification testing.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: superseded_by_pcn_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superseded By Product Change Notification (PCN) Number
attributes.description: PCN number that replaces or supersedes this PCN, used when a newer change notification obsoletes or modifies a previous one.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

products.name: product_ltb_notification
products.description: Last Time Buy notification records issued when a product reaches EOL, specifying the final order date, final shipment date, recommended replacement product, minimum order quantity for LTB, and customer acknowledgment tracking. Manages the formal LTB process per JEDEC JESD48 standard, ensuring customers have adequate notice to qualify replacement parts or place bridge inventory orders.
products.reference: LTB (Last Time Buy) Notification — JEDEC JESD48

attributes.name: product_ltb_notification_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Product Last Time Buy (LTB) Notification ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Last Time Buy notification record. Primary key for the product LTB notification entity.

tag_set.value: Product Last Time Buy (LTB) Notification ID

attributes.name: ltb_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: LTB Notification handling is assigned to a product manager employee; required for LTB revenue tracking.

attributes.name: primary_replacement_product_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recommended replacement product in the product catalog. Identifies the form-fit-function equivalent or next-generation product that customers should transition to. May be null if no direct replacement exists.

attributes.name: actual_ltb_revenue
attributes.description: Actual revenue realized from LTB orders. Captured after the final order date to measure forecast accuracy and assess the financial impact of the product discontinuance.

attributes.name: actual_ltb_units
attributes.description: Actual unit volume of LTB orders received. Captured after the final order date to measure demand forecast accuracy and assess inventory disposition requirements.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business authority who approved the LTB notification for issuance. Typically a product line manager, business unit director, or discontinuance review board representative.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the LTB notification was approved for issuance. Establishes the audit trail for discontinuance governance and compliance with internal approval processes.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the LTB notification was cancelled. Provides business context for discontinuance reversals, such as renewed customer demand, supply chain recovery, or strategic product portfolio changes.

attributes.name: cancelled_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business authority who cancelled the LTB notification. Populated only if the notification is cancelled before completion, typically due to business strategy changes or supply chain recovery.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the LTB notification was cancelled. Establishes the audit trail for notification lifecycle changes and supports customer communication of discontinuance reversals.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the LTB notification record was first created in the system. Establishes the audit trail for notification lifecycle and supports compliance with record retention requirements.

attributes.name: customer_acknowledgment_deadline
attributes.description: Date by which customers must acknowledge the LTB notification if acknowledgment is required. Ensures timely customer response and enables proactive follow-up for non-responsive accounts.

attributes.name: customer_acknowledgment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers are required to formally acknowledge receipt and understanding of the LTB notification. True for high-value or strategic customers; false for standard commercial notifications.

attributes.name: discontinuance_reason_code
attributes.description: Primary business reason for product discontinuance and LTB issuance. Categorizes the strategic, operational, or compliance driver behind the End of Life (EOL) decision.

attributes.name: discontinuance_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the business rationale for product discontinuance. Provides context for customers and internal stakeholders on the strategic or operational factors driving the EOL decision.

attributes.name: estimated_ltb_revenue
attributes.description: Projected revenue from LTB orders during the notification period. Used for financial planning, production capacity allocation, and business impact assessment of the product discontinuance.

attributes.name: estimated_ltb_units
attributes.description: Projected unit volume of LTB orders. Used for production planning, wafer start authorization, and supply chain capacity allocation during the LTB period.

attributes.name: final_order_date
attributes.description: Last date on which customers may place orders for the discontinued product. After this date, no new orders will be accepted. Critical milestone for customers planning bridge inventory or transitioning to replacement products.

attributes.name: final_shipment_date
attributes.description: Last date on which the discontinued product will be shipped to customers. Represents the absolute end of product availability and marks the transition to replacement product or alternative sourcing.

attributes.name: issued_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who issued the LTB notification to customers. Typically a product marketing manager, customer communications specialist, or PCN coordinator.

attributes.name: issued_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the LTB notification was issued to customers. Marks the official start of the notification period and triggers customer acknowledgment and ordering timelines.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the LTB notification record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to the notification and supports audit trail requirements for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that may be ordered during the LTB period. Caps total available inventory to prevent over-commitment and ensure fair allocation across customer base.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered during the LTB period. Ensures economically viable production runs for discontinued products and helps customers plan bridge inventory requirements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context, special instructions, or customer-specific considerations related to the LTB notification. Supports operational flexibility and captures information not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Primary communication channel used to deliver the LTB notification to customers. Tracks the method of notification delivery for compliance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: notification_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the LTB notification was formally issued to customers. Marks the start of the official notification period and triggers customer acknowledgment requirements per JEDEC JESD48 standard.

attributes.name: notification_language
attributes.description: Primary language in which the LTB notification was issued. Supports multi-lingual customer communication requirements and regulatory compliance in international markets.

attributes.name: notification_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the LTB notification. Externally communicated reference number used in customer correspondence and Product Change Notifications (PCN).

attributes.name: notification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the LTB notification. Tracks progression from draft through issuance, customer acknowledgment, and final expiration or cancellation.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the LTB notification based on timeline and business circumstances. attributes.description: Description of customer application scenarios or operating modes impacted by the errata (e.g., high-speed PCIe Gen4 operation, concurrent multi-channel DMA, low-power sleep modes).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Customer Use Case Repository

attributes.name: business_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of commercial and operational impact including potential revenue risk, customer satisfaction impact, warranty exposure, and time to market (TTM) implications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Business Impact Analysis

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: Reason for closing the errata record. Fixed in Silicon: corrected in new revision; Fixed in Software: resolved via patch; Workaround Sufficient: mitigation acceptable; Product EOL: end-of-life product; Not Reproducible: cannot verify; Working as Designed: not a defect.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM - Issue Closure Classification

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this errata record was first created in the product lifecycle management (PLM) system. Used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM - Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: customer_disclosure_status
attributes.description: Status of customer communication regarding this errata. Not Disclosed: internal only; Pending Approval: awaiting management approval; Disclosed NDA: shared under non-disclosure agreement; Disclosed Public: published in public errata sheet.

attributes.name: disclosure_date
attributes.description: Date when the errata was first communicated to customers via product change notification (PCN), errata sheet update, or technical advisory. Null if not yet disclosed.
attributes.references: JEDEC Standard - Product Change Notification Requirements

attributes.name: discovered_by
attributes.description: Source or method by which the errata was discovered. Internal Validation: found during wafer testing or quality assurance; Customer Report: reported by design-in customer; Field Failure: observed in production deployment; Design Verification: identified during design for testability (DFT) or automatic test pattern generation (ATPG).

attributes.name: discovered_date
attributes.description: Date when the silicon bug or functional deviation was first identified, either during internal validation, customer testing, or field deployment.

attributes.name: engineering_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the design engineer or engineering team responsible for investigating and resolving this errata. Used for accountability and workload tracking.

attributes.name: errata_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the errata record, typically formatted as product-family prefix followed by sequential number (e.g., SOC-001234, FPGA-000567). Used in customer communications and product change notifications (PCN).

attributes.name: errata_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the errata record. Draft: initial documentation; Under Review: engineering validation; Confirmed: verified silicon bug; Disclosed: communicated to customers; Resolved: fix available; Closed: no longer applicable.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM - Change Management Workflow

attributes.name: fix_plan
attributes.description: Planned resolution approach for the errata. Next Silicon Revision: will be corrected in next tapeout; Software Patch: addressable via firmware/driver update; No Fix Planned: low priority or end-of-life (EOL) product; Under Evaluation: fix strategy being assessed.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM - Product Change Management

attributes.name: fix_target_revision
attributes.description: Silicon stepping or revision where the errata will be corrected (e.g., C0, D1). Null if fix is software-only or no fix planned.

attributes.name: functional_block
attributes.description: Name of the intellectual property (IP) core, register transfer level (RTL) module, or functional block where the errata occurs (e.g., PCIe Controller, DDR PHY, CPU Core, DMA Engine).

attributes.name: impacted_customer_count
attributes.description: Estimated or actual number of customers affected by this errata based on product shipments and silicon revision distribution. Used for risk assessment and communication prioritization.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Confidential internal notes for engineering team use only. May contain sensitive technical details, customer names, or business strategy information not suitable for external disclosure.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this errata record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM - User Activity Tracking

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this errata record. Used for change tracking and synchronization with downstream systems.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM - Change Tracking Standards

attributes.name: pcn_number
attributes.description: Reference to the product change notification (PCN) document number if this errata was formally communicated to customers. Null if disclosed through other channels or not yet disclosed.

attributes.name: regulatory_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the errata affects compliance with industry standards or regulatory requirements such as automotive IATF 16949, functional safety ISO 26262, or export control ITAR/EAR classifications. Null if no regulatory impact.
attributes.references: ISO 26262 - Functional Safety, IATF 16949 - Automotive Quality

attributes.name: related_errata_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of related errata record identifiers that share common root cause, affect the same functional block, or have dependencies. Used for impact analysis and consolidated fixes.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM - Issue Relationship Tracking

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the errata was resolved either through silicon revision fix, software patch release, or closure decision. Null if still open or under evaluation.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM - Issue Resolution Tracking

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Engineering analysis of the underlying silicon defect or design flaw causing the errata. May reference RTL logic error, timing violation, or process variation sensitivity.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Root Cause Analysis Requirements

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Business impact severity of the errata. Critical: system failure or data corruption; Major: significant functional impact; Moderate: limited functional impact with workaround; Minor: cosmetic or edge-case issue.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability

attributes.name: silicon_revision
attributes.description: Silicon stepping or revision identifier where the errata was discovered (e.g., A0, B1, C2). Corresponds to mask revision in the fabrication process.
attributes.references: JEDEC Standard - Product Marking and Revision Control

attributes.name: symptom_description
attributes.description: Detailed technical description of the observable behavior or functional deviation caused by the silicon bug. Includes conditions under which the issue manifests.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Concise summary title of the silicon bug or functional deviation. Used in errata lists and customer-facing documentation.

attributes.name: to_revision
attributes.description: FK to product.product_revision.product_revision_id — Errata are specific to a silicon revision/stepping. Must link to the affected revision.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when engineering verification of the errata was completed and status changed to verified or cannot reproduce. Null if verification still in progress or not started.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Engineering validation status of the reported errata. Unverified: initial report not yet investigated; In Progress: under engineering analysis; Verified: confirmed as silicon bug; Cannot Reproduce: unable to replicate reported behavior.

attributes.name: workaround_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a software, firmware, or operational workaround exists to mitigate the errata impact. True if workaround documented; False if no mitigation available.

attributes.name: workaround_description
attributes.description: Detailed instructions for software, firmware, or operational workaround to avoid or mitigate the errata. May include register configuration changes, driver patches, or usage restrictions. Null if no workaround available.

attributes.name: workaround_performance_impact
attributes.description: Description of any power, performance, or area (PPA) degradation introduced by the workaround (e.g., 5% throughput reduction, 10mW additional power consumption, increased latency). Null if no measurable impact or no workaround.

products.name: license_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the licensing contract between an IP core and a customer account. It captures the licensing model, royalty rates, NRE cost, and agreement dates for each IP core licensed to each account.. Existence Justification: IP cores are licensed to customers via formal contracts. Each IP core can be licensed to many accounts, and each account can hold licenses for many IP cores. The license agreement records licensing model, royalty, NRE cost, and effective dates, which are managed as a distinct business entity.

products.name: license_allocation
products.description: This association captures the many‑to‑many relationship between IC catalog entries and export licenses. Each record links one ic_catalog to one export_license and stores attributes that are specific to the licensing context, such as authorized commodities, countries, end‑users, and the license validity period.. Existence Justification: An IC catalog entry may be covered by multiple export licenses depending on commodity, destination, and end‑use, while a single export license can apply to many ICs across product families. The licensing team actively creates, updates, and retires these mappings as part of export compliance processes, and the mapping itself carries attributes such as authorized commodities, countries, and validity dates.

products.name: credit_profile
products.description: Customer-facing credit and financial risk profile maintained by the customer domain as SSOT for customer creditworthiness assessment. Captures credit limit, credit rating (internal and external Dun & Bradstreet), payment terms (Net 30, Net 60, prepay), credit hold status, credit review date, outstanding balance, overdue amount, credit utilization percentage, currency, and credit analyst notes. Distinct from finance-domain AR aging and collections records — this product owns the customer's credit posture used for real-time order-to-cash credit checks. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI-AR (Accounts Receivable).

products.name: customer_sample_request
products.description: Customer requests for engineering samples, evaluation kits, and pre-production devices prior to volume purchase. Captures requesting contact, account, part number requested, quantity, application description, sample purpose (evaluation, design-in, qualification), requested delivery date, shipping address, approval status, approving FAE, sample cost (if charged), and fulfillment status. Tracks the early-stage design-in funnel from sample to design registration to design-win.

products.name: price_agreement
products.description: Customer-specific pricing agreements and special price authorizations (SPAs) negotiated for specific part numbers. SSOT for customer-negotiated prices distinct from sales-domain standard list pricing and discount schedules. Captures agreed unit price, currency, minimum order quantity (MOQ), volume tiers, effective date, expiry date, approval chain, SPA reference number, and associated design-win or contract. These are customer-committed prices that flow into order entry — not sales pipeline pricing assumptions. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA SD pricing conditions.

products.name: customer_ltb_notification
products.description: Last Time Buy (LTB) and End-of-Life (EOL) customer notification records tracking communication of product discontinuation to affected customer accounts. Captures product part number, EOL announcement date, LTB order deadline, last shipment date, customer account, customer notification date, notification channel, customer acknowledgment status, acknowledged-by contact, LTB quantity committed by customer, LTB order reference, recommended replacement part, cross-reference compatibility notes, migration support FAE assignment, and customer transition plan status. SSOT for customer-facing EOL communication lifecycle. Supports regulatory traceability for automotive long-term supply obligations and customer transition planning.

domains.name: sales
domains.description: Sales pipeline, opportunities, quotes, design-win campaigns, NRE agreements, pricing, and customer contracts. Manages sales territories, account assignments, forecast accuracy, revenue targets by product family, end market, and geography. Integrates with Salesforce CRM and SAP SD.

products.name: opportunity
products.description: Master record: Core sales opportunity tracking design-win campaigns, pipeline stages (Prospecting→Design-In→Design-Win→Production Ramp→Won/Lost), probability, and expected revenue for semiconductor IC, SoC, ASIC, and FPGA engagements. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Opportunity object. Captures end market (automotive, mobile, AI, IoT, computing), product family, target application, competitive landscape, NRE potential, design-win status, campaign grouping (campaign type, target segment, effectiveness metrics), and stage transition history for pipeline velocity analysis. SSOT for all sales pipeline activity including campaign-level aggregation for design-in programs, product launches, and competitive displacement initiatives.

products.name: price_list
products.description: Master record: Master pricing repository defining standard and customer-specific pricing for semiconductor products by product family, package type, volume tier, and end market. Supports list price, distributor price, OEM price, and spot price variants. Contains price adjustment records capturing negotiated deviations, special bids, volume rebate adjustments, design-win incentives, and distributor markdowns with adjustment type, approved deviation amount, approval authority, validity windows, and SAP SD pricing condition override references. products.name: activity
products.description: Transaction record: Sales and FAE customer interaction activity including customer visits, technical presentations, demo evaluations, engineering sample requests (device samples for design evaluation/qualification with requested devices, quantities, package types, approval status, shipment tracking, and evaluation outcomes), design review meetings, and conference engagements. Captures activity type, date, participants, associated opportunity or account, outcome, and next action. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Activity/Task/Event objects. SSOT for all customer touchpoint tracking in the semiconductor design-in process including sample fulfillment lifecycle.

attributes.name: activity_id

attributes.name: account_id

attributes.name: activity_opportunity_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: employee_id

attributes.name: experimental_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.experimental_lot. Business justification: Activity Sample Evaluation logs the experimental lot used for testing, needed for traceability and yield analysis.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: Sample or evaluation activities are performed on specific material lots; linking to material master enables traceability and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: primary_activity_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sales opportunity linked to this activity.

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_process_step. Business justification: Sales activities (e.g., sample evaluation) reference the specific process step being evaluated; needed for traceability.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Sales activities (e.g., sample distribution) need a reliable link to the master SKU record.

attributes.name: activity_status

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Category of the sales interaction such as a customer visit, technical presentation, demo evaluation, sample request, design review, or conference engagement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_visit|technical_presentation|demo_evaluation|sample_request|design_review|conference_engagement|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Medium through which the activity was conducted.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Length of the activity measured in minutes.

attributes.name: evaluation_result

attributes.name: is_internal
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the activity was performed by internal staff (true) or by an external partner (false).

attributes.name: location

attributes.name: next_action_due_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which the follow‑up action identified in the activity should be completed.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: outcome

attributes.name: sample_approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the engineering sample request.

attributes.name: sample_quantity
attributes.description: Number of engineering samples requested in a sample‑request activity.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the activity record.

products.name: partner_inventory
products.description: Association product representing the inventory allocation relationship between a sales channel partner and a finished good. Each record captures the partner's stock level, supply metrics, and reporting obligations for a specific finished good.. Existence Justification: Channel partners actively manage inventory for multiple finished goods, and each finished good can be stocked by multiple channel partners. The business records per‑partner‑product metrics such as stock on hand, weeks of supply, sell‑through rate, and reporting obligations, which are updated and maintained as part of the partner‑inventory management process.

attributes.name: partner_inventory_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the partner_inventory association

attributes.name: channel_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the channel partner

attributes.name: finished_good_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the finished good

attributes.name: inventory_reporting_obligation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner must provide regular inventory visibility

attributes.name: sell_through_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of partner inventory sold to end customers over a defined period

attributes.name: stock_on_hand
attributes.description: Current quantity of the finished good held by the partner

attributes.name: weeks_of_supply
attributes.description: Estimated weeks of supply the partner's stock will satisfy demand

products.name: opportunity_project_assignment
products.description: This association captures the operational relationship between a sales opportunity and an R&D project. Each record links one opportunity to one project and stores attributes that belong only to the partnership, such as the project's role in the opportunity and the estimated revenue contribution.. Existence Justification: In the semiconductor business, a sales opportunity can be supported by multiple R&D projects, and a single R&D project can provide value to many different opportunities. The link is actively managed by sales and research teams, who record the role of the project and its estimated revenue contribution for each opportunity.

attributes.name: opportunity_project_assignment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the OpportunityProjectAssignment association

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the sales opportunity

attributes.name: research_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the research project

attributes.name: estimated_contribution
attributes.description: Projected revenue contribution of the project to the opportunity

attributes.name: opportunity_role
attributes.description: The role the R&D project plays in the opportunity (e.g., lead design, feasibility, validation)

products.name: lead_program_interest
products.description: This association captures the interest relationship between sales leads and R&D programs. Each record links one lead to one program and stores attributes that describe the strength of interest and fit, which are not appropriate to store on either the lead or the program entity alone.. Existence Justification: A sales lead can express interest in multiple R&D programs, and each R&D program can receive interest from many leads. The relationship is actively managed by marketing and R&D teams to track fit and prioritize outreach. The mapping carries its own attributes (interest score, fit rating) that belong to the relationship itself.

attributes.name: lead_program_interest_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the R&D program record

tag_set.value: Lead Program Interest - Rd Program Id

attributes.name: lead_interest_score
attributes.description: Numeric score indicating the lead's level of interest in the program

attributes.name: program_fit_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of how well the lead fits the program's strategic objectives

domains.name: order
domains.description: Customer orders, order fulfillment, delivery schedules, and shipment tracking. SSOT for order-to-cash lifecycle including order entry, wafer start authorizations, die bank orders, allocation, backlog management, and delivery confirmation. Manages MPW orders and production lot assignments.

products.name: order
products.description: Master record for all customer sales orders in the semiconductor order-to-cash lifecycle. Captures order header information including customer identity, order type (standard IC, ASIC, FPGA, MPW, NRE), order date, requested delivery date, priority, incoterms, payment terms, currency, total order value, and order status. SSOT for all customer-placed orders including wafer start authorizations, die bank orders, and production lot assignments. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD module.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Primary key for order

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who placed the sales order. Links to the customer master data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: blanket_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.blanket_order. Business justification: An order may be covered by a blanket purchase agreement; adding FK from order to blanket_order captures this relationship without creating a cycle.

attributes.name: channel_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.channel_partner. Business justification: Orders may be placed via channel partners; the FK enables partner‑attributed revenue and commission reporting.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact. Business justification: Order Management requires a primary sales contact for each order; the Order Confirmation Report pulls contact details, making this link essential.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Orders are charged to a cost center for expense tracking and budgeting in the finance system.

attributes.name: eccn_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.eccn_classification. Business justification: Export compliance reporting requires linking each order to its ECCN classification for customs documentation.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative or account manager responsible for managing this order and the customer relationship.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: experimental_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.experimental_lot. Business justification: Orders for experimental wafers require a link to the experimental lot to enable order‑to‑lot traceability in yield and research reporting.

attributes.name: export_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.export_license. Business justification: Export License Management: each sales order must reference the approved export license, replacing the free‑text export_license_number.

attributes.name: ip_core_development_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.ip_core_development. Business justification: Orders for IP core licenses must reference the IP core development record to manage royalties, compliance, and licensing reporting.

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) run associated with this order. Applicable only for MPW order types where multiple customer designs share a single wafer to reduce Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) costs.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Camstar MES; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Order creation originates from a closed‑won opportunity; linking enables opportunity‑to‑order conversion reporting.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP sales organization responsible for this order, defining the selling entity, pricing, and legal entity context.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.payment_term. Business justification: Required for order processing: each order references a centrally defined payment term for financial reporting and compliance with contract terms.

attributes.name: price_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.price_agreement. Business justification: Pricing Governance applies a specific price agreement to an order; the Pricing Audit Report and revenue recognition rely on this relationship.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit‑center reporting requires each sales order to be linked to the responsible profit center.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote. Business justification: Orders are generated from accepted quotes; the link supports quote‑to‑order tracking and pricing audit.

attributes.name: research_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.program. Business justification: Program‑driven volume orders must be associated with the research program for financial tracking, budget compliance, and KPI dashboards.

attributes.name: research_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Custom design order fulfillment tracks the originating research project for cost allocation and project KPI reporting.

attributes.name: restricted_party_screening_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.restricted_party_screening. Business justification: Trade compliance hold process records the screening result for the customer/account on the order.

attributes.name: sales_design_win_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Salesforce CRM design-win opportunity that originated this sales order. Links the order to the customer design-in engagement, enabling design-win to revenue conversion tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: shipping_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: Shipping Execution process stores the exact customer address for each order; the Shipping Manifest and compliance checks depend on this link.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the ordered products were delivered to the customer or ship-to location. Used for on-time delivery (OTD) performance analysis and customer satisfaction reporting.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current inventory or production capacity allocation status of the order. Indicates whether sufficient die, wafer, or finished goods inventory has been reserved to fulfill the order. Critical for backlog management and supply-demand balancing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD Module; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: backlog_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order is currently included in the active order backlog. True when the order is open and not yet fully shipped or invoiced. Used for backlog valuation, revenue forecasting, and capacity planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Business reason code or description for order cancellation. Populated only when order_status is CANCELLED. Used for lost revenue analysis, demand forecasting accuracy, and customer relationship management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: chips_act_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order is associated with products or programs eligible for US CHIPS and Science Act incentives or reporting requirements. Used for government reporting and subsidy tracking.
attributes.references: CHIPS Act Compliance (US CHIPS and Science Act); BIS/EAR

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the semiconductor manufacturer based on production capacity, wafer fab scheduling, and logistics. May differ from the requested delivery date. Used for backlog management and customer commitment tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; JEDEC; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the sales order record was first created in the source system (SAP S/4HANA SD). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and order entry performance measurement. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.ERDAT + VBAK.ERZET.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module (VBAK.ERDAT); SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the order transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, TWD, KRW). Defines the currency in which order values, pricing, and invoicing are denominated. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.WAERK.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module (VBAK.WAERK); ISO 4217; SOX

attributes.name: customer_po_number
attributes.description: The purchase order number provided by the customer at the time of order placement. Used for cross-referencing with the customer's procurement system and required for invoice matching. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.BSTNK.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The sales channel through which the order was placed. Determines pricing tiers, commission structures, and revenue reporting by channel. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.VTWEG.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module (VBAK.VTWEG); Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: end_market_segment
attributes.description: The end-market application segment for which the ordered semiconductor products are destined. Used for market segmentation analysis, revenue reporting by vertical, and strategic planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: COMPUTING|MOBILE|AUTOMOTIVE|AI_ML|IOT|INDUSTRIAL|NETWORKING|CONSUMER|DEFENSE|MEDICAL — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: export_license_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an export license is required for this order based on the destination country, end-user, and product ECCN classification. True triggers export compliance review workflow before shipment authorization.

attributes.name: gross_order_value
attributes.description: Total gross value of the sales order before application of discounts, taxes, or surcharges, expressed in the order currency. Represents the sum of all line item gross values. Used for revenue forecasting and backlog valuation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: hold_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for placing the order on hold. Populated when order_status is ON_HOLD. Common reasons include credit hold, export compliance review, customer request, or supply shortage.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; BIS/EAR; SOX

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the responsibilities of buyer and seller for delivery, risk transfer, and cost allocation. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.INCO1. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module (VBAK.INCO1); ICC Incoterms 2020; JEDEC

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: The named place or port associated with the Incoterms code, specifying where risk and cost transfer between buyer and seller (e.g., 'Shanghai Port', 'Customer Dock'). Corresponds to SAP VBAK.INCO2.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module (VBAK.INCO2); ICC Incoterms 2020

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether any products in this order are subject to ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) controls. When True, additional export authorization and end-use certification requirements apply before shipment.
attributes.references: ITAR (22 CFR Parts 120-130); BIS/EAR; CHIPS Act Compliance

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the sales order record in the source system. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.AEDAT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module (VBAK.AEDAT); SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: net_order_value
attributes.description: Net value of the sales order after application of all discounts and pricing conditions but before tax. Represents the contractually agreed revenue amount. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.NETWR. Used for revenue recognition and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module (VBAK.NETWR); SOX; IFRS 15

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions associated with the sales order, capturing customer-specific requirements, handling instructions, or internal processing notes. Corresponds to SAP order header text.

attributes.name: nre_amount
attributes.description: Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) charges associated with this order, covering one-time design, mask set, and process development costs. Applicable for ASIC, custom IC, and MPW order types. Reported separately from unit product revenue.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/CO Module; IFRS 15; SOX

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the customer placed the sales order. Represents the principal business event date for the order-to-cash lifecycle. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.AUDAT.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sales order within the order-to-cash process. Drives workflow routing, backlog reporting, and revenue recognition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRAFT|OPEN|IN_FULFILLMENT|SHIPPED|DELIVERED|CLOSED|CANCELLED|ON_HOLD — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sales order by product or engagement type. Determines order processing rules, pricing, and fulfillment workflow. Values include: STANDARD_IC (standard integrated circuit), ASIC (Application-Specific Integrated Circuit), FPGA (Field-Programmable Gate Array), MPW (Multi-Project Wafer), NRE (Non-Recurring Engineering), DIE_BANK (die bank pull order), WAFER_START (wafer start authorization). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: STANDARD_IC|ASIC|FPGA|MPW|NRE|DIE_BANK|WAFER_START — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module (VBAK.AUART); JEDEC; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms key defining the payment due date, early payment discount conditions, and cash discount percentages applicable to this order. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.ZTERM (e.g., NT30, NT60, 2/10NET30).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module (VBAK.ZTERM); SOX Compliance

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the order, influencing production scheduling, wafer start queue position, and allocation decisions. Critical orders may trigger expedite fees or override standard allocation rules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module (VBAK.LPRIO); SEMI Standards

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the products ordered comply with the EU REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) Regulation. Required for EU market access and supply chain chemical safety reporting.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the customer has requested delivery of the ordered products. Used for delivery scheduling, wafer start planning, and on-time delivery (OTD) performance measurement. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.VDATU.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the products ordered comply with the EU RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances) Directive, restricting the use of specific hazardous materials in electronic equipment. Required for EU market access and customer compliance declarations.

attributes.name: ship_to_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the destination country for shipment. Critical for export compliance screening (EAR/ITAR/BIS), trade sanctions checks, and logistics routing. Corresponds to SAP ship-to party country.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; BIS/EAR; ITAR; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: so_number
attributes.description: Externally visible sales order number as assigned by SAP S/4HANA SD module. Used in all customer-facing communications, shipping documents, and invoices. Corresponds to the VBELN field in SAP VBAK table.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: The channel or system through which the customer order was received and entered. Used for order entry efficiency analysis and digital transformation tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to the sales order, including VAT, GST, or other applicable taxes, expressed in the order currency. Required for tax reporting and financial compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/SD Module; SOX; IFRS; Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: wafer_start_authorization
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order has triggered a wafer start authorization in the fabrication facility (FAB). When True, the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) has been instructed to initiate wafer lot processing for this order.
attributes.references: Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; Camstar MES; SEMI Standards

products.name: order_line
products.description: Individual line items within a customer sales order, each representing a distinct semiconductor product SKU, quantity, unit price, requested ship date, confirmed ship date, and line-level status. Captures product configuration details such as package type, speed grade, temperature range, and special handling requirements. Supports partial shipments and line-level allocation tracking. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD order line items.

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each order line item within the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key for the order_line data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order Item (VBAP)

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer placing the order. Used for line-level customer attribution in multi-ship-to or multi-sold-to scenarios. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD KUNNR (Customer Number).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Customer Master (KNA1); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: experimental_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.experimental_lot. Business justification: Line‑item tracking of experimental lot IDs ties shipped quantities to specific research lots for detailed yield analysis.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.fab_tool. Business justification: PRODUCTION_SCHEDULING: Assign primary fab tool to each order line for capacity planning and tool utilization reporting.

attributes.name: inventory_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_wafer_lot. Business justification: REQUIRED: Order fulfillment report needs to know which wafer lot supplies each order line; linking enables traceability from line to physical wafer lot.

attributes.name: package_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to packaging.package_type. Business justification: Needed for Packaging Planning; order line specifies requested package type, linking to package_type enables yield, cost, and compliance analysis per packaging family.

attributes.name: primary_sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent sales order header to which this line item belongs. Establishes the header-to-line relationship in the order-to-cash lifecycle. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD VBELN (Sales Document Number).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order Header (VBAK)

attributes.name: process_engineer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Manufacturing assigns a process engineer to each order line for fab planning and yield optimization.

attributes.name: quote_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote_line. Business justification: Each order line is derived from a quote line; needed for line‑level margin and fulfillment analysis.

attributes.name: reach_svhc_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.reach_svhc_declaration. Business justification: REACH SVHC Declaration is required per SKU on an order line to certify hazardous substance compliance.

attributes.name: research_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Line‑item level tracking of research project origin enables precise billing, milestone status, and project performance analysis.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the semiconductor product (IC, SoC, ASIC, FPGA, or discrete device) being ordered on this line. Links to the product master for SKU-level configuration details including package type, speed grade, and temperature range.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Master (MARA); JEDEC Standard No. 21C

attributes.name: test_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to test.test_program. Business justification: Required for Test Program Assignment per SKU during order fulfillment; ensures each order line selects the correct test program for quality validation.

attributes.name: tool_chamber_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.tool_chamber. Business justification: CHAMBER_TRACEABILITY: Link order line to specific tool chamber used, enabling yield analysis and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: The date on which the semiconductor units for this order line were physically shipped from the warehouse or OSAT facility. Populated upon goods issue posting in SAP S/4HANA. Used for on-time delivery (OTD) performance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Delivery (LIKP.WADAT_IST); SEMI Standards

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply allocation method applied to this order line. Standard = normal backlog allocation; Priority = customer-priority or design-win protected allocation; Strategic = long-term agreement allocation; Spot = spot market fulfillment; Buffer = safety stock draw.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Availability Check (ATP); SEMI Standards

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for cancellation of this order line when line_status is 'cancelled'. Supports backlog analysis, demand planning accuracy, and customer relationship management. Populated only for cancelled lines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_request|supply_constraint|end_of_life|duplicate|pricing_dispute|export_hold|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Rejection Reason (VBAP.ABGRU); Salesforce CRM; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of semiconductor units confirmed by supply chain for delivery on this order line, reflecting available inventory, wafer start authorizations, and die bank allocations. May differ from ordered quantity due to allocation constraints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Schedule Line (VBEP.BMENG); SEMI Standards

attributes.name: confirmed_ship_date
attributes.description: The date confirmed by supply chain and manufacturing for shipment of this order line, based on available inventory, die bank status, and OSAT packaging capacity. May differ from requested ship date due to supply constraints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Schedule Line (VBEP.EDATU confirmed); SEMI Standards

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the semiconductor product was manufactured (FAB location). Required for customs declarations, trade compliance, tariff classification, and CHIPS Act domestic content reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; BIS/EAR — Export Administration Regulations; CHIPS Act Compliance; WTO Rules of Origin

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this order line record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking. Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Section 302 (Internal Controls); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency of this order line (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, KRW, TWD). Semiconductor industry commonly transacts in USD but supports multi-currency for global customers.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order (VBAK.WAERK)

attributes.name: customer_part_number
attributes.description: The customer's own internal part number or cross-reference number for the ordered semiconductor product. Critical for design-win tracking, customer portal integration, and order acknowledgment matching. Sourced from Salesforce CRM design-win records.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Design-Win Tracking; JEDEC Standard No. 21C

attributes.name: date_entered
attributes.description: The business date on which this order line was entered into the SAP S/4HANA SD system. Represents the commercial event date for backlog aging calculations and order-to-cash cycle time measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order (VBAK.AUDAT); SOX Section 606

attributes.name: die_bank_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line is to be fulfilled from the die bank (inventory of known good dies (KGD) awaiting packaging) rather than from finished goods or new wafer starts. True = die bank fulfillment; False = standard finished goods or new production.
attributes.references: Camstar MES — Die Bank Lot Management; SAP S/4HANA MM — Inventory Management; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) for the semiconductor product on this order line (e.g., 3A001 for advanced ICs). Required for export compliance screening, license determination, and ITAR/EAR regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: BIS/EAR — Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR Parts 730-774); ITAR (22 CFR Parts 120-130); CHIPS Act Compliance

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost responsibilities between the semiconductor company and the customer for this order line (e.g., FOB, DDP, EXW). Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD INCO1. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order (VBKD.INCO1); SEMI Standards

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: SAP SD item category classification for this order line, indicating the business nature of the line (e.g., standard product sale, consignment fill-up, customer return, engineering sample, NRE charge, MPW service, evaluation unit). Drives pricing, delivery, and billing behavior. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|consignment|returns|sample|nre|mpw|evaluation — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Item Category (VBAP.PSTYV); SEMI Standards

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential position number of this line item within the parent sales order. Used for ordering, display, and reference in customer-facing documents. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD POSNR (Item Number of the SD Document).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order Item (VBAP.POSNR)

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of this order line item within the order-to-cash lifecycle. Drives backlog management, allocation decisions, and revenue recognition. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD overall delivery status at item level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Item Delivery Status (VBUP.LFSTA); JEDEC

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The manufacturing lot number assigned to the production batch fulfilling this order line. Enables traceability from customer order back to wafer fabrication lot, die bank lot, and OSAT packaging lot. Sourced from Camstar MES lot tracking.
attributes.references: Camstar MES — Lot Management; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.2 (Traceability); IATF 16949

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material number (MATNR) identifying the specific semiconductor product SKU ordered on this line. Includes full part number with package, speed grade, and temperature range encoded per internal part numbering convention.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Master (MARA.MATNR); JEDEC Standard No. 21C

attributes.name: mpw_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line is associated with a Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) run, where multiple customer designs share a single wafer to reduce NRE costs. True = MPW order; False = dedicated production lot order.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards — MPW Services; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IEEE Standards

attributes.name: net_value
attributes.description: Total net value of this order line calculated as confirmed quantity multiplied by unit price in the transaction currency. Used for backlog reporting, revenue forecasting, and SOX-compliant revenue recognition. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD NETWR (Net Value of the Order Item).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order Item (VBAP.NETWR); SOX Section 606; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
