attributes.description: The quantity of semiconductor units (dies, packaged ICs, wafers, or reels) requested by the customer on this order line. Expressed in the sales unit of measure (e.g., pieces, wafers, reels). Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD KWMENG (Cumulative Order Quantity).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order Item (VBAP.KWMENG); SEMI Standards

attributes.name: partial_shipment_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer permits partial shipments against this order line. True = partial shipments accepted; False = complete order line quantity must ship together. Drives delivery scheduling and backlog management decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Delivery (VBAK.AUTLF); SEMI Standards

attributes.name: product_revision
attributes.description: The silicon revision or stepping of the ordered semiconductor product (e.g., A0, B1, C2). Critical for tracking product change notifications (PCNs), errata management, and ensuring customers receive the correct silicon revision per their qualification.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM — Product Change Notification (PCN); JEDEC JESD46 (PCN Standard); SEMI Standards

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the semiconductor product on this order line is compliant with the EU REACH Regulation (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals). Required for EU chemical safety compliance and customer material declarations.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU; IPC-1752 (Materials Declaration)

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the customer requires receipt of the semiconductor units at their facility. Distinct from requested ship date; accounts for transit time. Used for customer SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order Item (VBAP.MBDAT); SEMI Standards

attributes.name: requested_ship_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer has requested shipment of this order line. Drives production scheduling, wafer start authorization timelines, and OSAT packaging commitments. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD WUNSK (Customer's Requested Delivery Date at Item Level).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Schedule Line (VBEP.EDATU); SEMI Standards

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the semiconductor product on this order line is compliant with the EU Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Directive, restricting use of lead, mercury, cadmium, and other hazardous materials. Required for EU market access.
attributes.references: RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU (Restriction of Hazardous Substances); REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; IPC-1752 (Materials Declaration)

attributes.name: sap_line_item_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Sales Order Line Item Number
attributes.description: The native SAP S/4HANA SD six-digit item number (POSNR) for this order line, used for traceability back to the system of record and for EDI/customer portal reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order Item (VBAP.POSNR)

tag_set.value: SAP Sales Order Line Item Number

attributes.name: ship_to_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the destination country of this order line shipment. Used for export control screening, customs documentation, tariff determination, and trade compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; BIS/EAR — Export Administration Regulations; SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Ship-To Party (KNA1)

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of semiconductor units actually shipped against this order line across all partial shipments. Used for backlog calculation and revenue recognition. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD delivery documents.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Delivery Item (LIPS.LFIMG); SEMI Standards

attributes.name: special_handling_code
attributes.description: Code indicating special handling, storage, or shipping requirements for this order line (e.g., ESD-sensitive, moisture-sensitive level (MSL), controlled humidity, ITAR-controlled, hazmat). Drives warehouse and logistics instructions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ESD|MSL1|MSL2|MSL3|ITAR|HAZMAT|CONTROLLED_TEMP|FRAGILE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPC/JEDEC J-STD-020 (Moisture Sensitivity); ITAR (22 CFR Parts 120-130); RoHS Directive; REACH Regulation

attributes.name: speed_grade
attributes.description: The speed or performance grade of the ordered semiconductor product, indicating the maximum operating frequency or timing specification (e.g., -1, -2, -3 for FPGAs; 3200MHz, 4800MHz for memory). Differentiates SKUs within the same product family.
attributes.references: JEDEC Standard No. 21C; JEDEC JESD79 (DDR Standards); IEEE Standards

attributes.name: temperature_grade
attributes.description: Operating temperature range classification for the ordered semiconductor product. Commercial (0°C to 70°C), Industrial (-40°C to 85°C), Automotive (-40°C to 125°C, AEC-Q100), Military (-55°C to 125°C). Determines qualification standard and pricing tier.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD47 (Stress-Test-Driven Qualification); AEC-Q100 (Automotive IC Qualification); MIL-STD-883 (Military); IATF 16949

attributes.name: to_sales_order
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — Fundamental header-to-line relationship. Every order line must belong to exactly one sales order. This is the most critical FK in the domain — without it, order lines are orphaned.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Sales unit of measure for the ordered semiconductor product. EA = Each (individual packaged IC), WFR = Wafer, REEL = Tape-and-reel packaging, TRAY = JEDEC tray, TUBE = Tube packaging. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD VRKME (Sales Unit).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order Item (VBAP.VRKME); JEDEC Standard No. 21C; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Agreed net unit selling price for the semiconductor product on this order line, expressed in the transaction currency. Reflects negotiated pricing, volume discounts, and design-win pricing agreements. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD NETPR (Net Price).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Pricing (KONV); SOX Section 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to this order line record in the data platform. Supports change data capture (CDC), audit trail, and incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Section 302 (Internal Controls); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: wafer_start_authorization
attributes.description: Indicates whether a wafer start authorization (WSA) has been issued to the fabrication facility (FAB) to initiate production of wafers for fulfilling this order line. True = WSA issued; False = pending or not required (e.g., fulfilled from die bank or finished goods inventory).
attributes.references: Applied Materials SmartFactory MES — Wafer Start Authorization; Camstar MES — Lot Management; SEMI Standards

products.name: status_history
products.description: Chronological audit trail of all status transitions for a sales order throughout the order-to-cash lifecycle. Records each status change event including prior status, new status, timestamp, reason code, and the user or system that triggered the change. Supports backlog management, escalation tracking, and order lifecycle analytics. Covers statuses such as: entered, confirmed, allocated, wafer_started, in_fab, shipped, invoiced, cancelled.

attributes.name: status_history_id
attributes.description: Primary key for status_history

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account associated with the sales order at the time of this status event. Supports customer-level backlog and escalation analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Customer Master (KNA1); Salesforce CRM Account

attributes.name: allocation_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the die bank or wafer allocation record when the status transitions to allocated. Captures which inventory allocation was committed to fulfill this order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Module — Allocation Management

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The user login ID or system service account that initiated the status transition. Supports accountability tracking and audit compliance. May be a human user (SAP logon ID) or an automated system process (e.g., MES_AUTO, ERP_BATCH).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Change Document Header (CDHDR.USERNAME); SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wafer fabrication lot associated with this order status event. Populated when the status transition is triggered by a fab event such as wafer_started or in_fab. Links order lifecycle to WIP (Work in Process) tracking.
attributes.references: Camstar MES — Lot Management; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: osat_vendor_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner ID
attributes.description: Reference to the OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) partner responsible for packaging and final test of the order. Populated when the order transitions to packaging or test phases. Supports OSAT-level delivery tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Vendor Master (LFA1); JEDEC Packaging Standards

tag_set.value: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner ID

attributes.name: primary_status_order_id
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — Status history records track transitions for a specific order. Must reference the parent order.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outbound shipment record when the status transitions to shipped. Links the order status history to the physical delivery event for shipment tracking and delivery confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Delivery (LIKP/LIPS); JEDEC JESD22

attributes.name: cancellation_type
attributes.description: Classifies the reason for order cancellation when new_status is cancelled. Values: customer_request (customer-initiated), eol (End of Life product discontinuation), capacity (fab capacity unavailable), yield_fail (unacceptable yield), export_block (export compliance hold), duplicate (duplicate order entry). Null for non-cancellation transitions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Reason for Rejection (ABGRU); Oracle Agile PLM EOL Management

attributes.name: change_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential integer representing the ordinal position of this status transition within the complete history of the sales order line. Sequence 1 is the initial entry event. Enables ordered reconstruction of the full order lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Change Document Sequence; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The internally confirmed delivery date at the time of this status transition. May differ from requested_delivery_date due to fab capacity, yield, or supply chain constraints. Tracks delivery commitment evolution across the order lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Confirmed Delivery Date (VBEP.EDATU); IATF 16949 Delivery Performance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this status history record was first written to the data platform (Silver layer ingestion time). Distinct from transition_timestamp which records the business event time. Supports data lineage and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: die_bank_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line is fulfilled from die bank inventory (pre-fabricated, unpackaged dies held in inventory) rather than a new wafer start. Die bank orders have a compressed status lifecycle bypassing wafer_started and in_fab states.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD Module — Die Bank Inventory; Camstar MES

attributes.name: duration_in_prior_status_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours the order line spent in the prior_status before transitioning to new_status. Calculated at ingestion time from the difference between this transition_timestamp and the previous record's transition_timestamp. Supports cycle time and SLA analytics.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Delivery Performance Metrics; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition was associated with a customer escalation event. When True, the order was under active escalation management at the time of the transition. Supports escalation tracking and priority queue analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Escalation Case Management; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: escalation_priority
attributes.description: Priority level of the customer escalation active at the time of this status transition. P1 is highest urgency (e.g., automotive line-down risk), P4 is lowest. Populated only when escalation_flag is True.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Priority; IATF 16949 Customer Escalation Management

attributes.name: export_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition triggered or was subject to an export control review under EAR or ITAR regulations. When True, the order required compliance screening before proceeding to the next status.
attributes.references: BIS/EAR Export Administration Regulations; ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations); CHIPS Act Compliance

attributes.name: hold_code
attributes.description: Standardized hold code applied to the order at the time of this status transition (e.g., CREDIT_HOLD, EXPORT_REVIEW, YIELD_HOLD, CAPACITY_HOLD). Null when no hold is active. Critical for backlog management and compliance review workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Delivery Block (VBAK.LIFSK) / Billing Block (VBAK.FAKSK); EAR/ITAR Export Compliance

attributes.name: is_current_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents the most recent (current) status of the order line. True for the latest status transition record; False for all historical records. Enables efficient current-state queries without window functions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Current Order Status (VBUK)

attributes.name: mpw_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order line is associated with a Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) run. MPW orders share wafer capacity across multiple customers and have distinct status transition rules compared to dedicated production orders.
attributes.references: Camstar MES — MPW Lot Management; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The order status assigned as a result of this transition event. Represents the current state after the change. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: entered|confirmed|allocated|wafer_started|in_fab|shipped|invoiced|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Order Status (VBUK/VBUP); SEMI E10 Equipment State Model

attributes.name: order_line_number
attributes.description: The specific line item number within the sales order to which this status transition applies. A single sales order may have multiple lines (e.g., different part numbers or delivery dates) each with independent status histories.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order Item (VBAP.POSNR)

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units (dies, wafers, or packaged devices) on the order line at the time of this status transition. Captured as a snapshot to support backlog quantity analytics across status states.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order Item Quantity (VBAP.KWMENG); JEDEC

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: The semiconductor part number (IC, SoC, ASIC, or FPGA) associated with the order line at the time of this status event. Denormalized for audit trail completeness and historical accuracy even if the part number changes later.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Master (MARA.MATNR); JEDEC Part Numbering Standard

attributes.name: pcn_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to a Product Change Notification (PCN) that triggered or is associated with this status transition. Relevant when an order status changes due to a product or process change notification issued to the customer.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM — PCN Management; JEDEC JESD46 Product Change Notification Standard

attributes.name: prior_status
attributes.description: The order status immediately before this transition event. Together with new_status, defines the state transition vector for lifecycle analytics and backlog management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: entered|confirmed|allocated|wafer_started|in_fab|shipped|invoiced|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Order Status (VBUK/VBUP); SEMI E10 Equipment State Model

attributes.name: process_node
attributes.description: The semiconductor process technology node (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 28nm, 65nm) used to fabricate the product on this order line. Captured as a snapshot at the time of the status event for process-level backlog analytics.
attributes.references: SEMI Process Technology Classification; SAP S/4HANA PP Module — Production Version

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the ordered quantity: EA (each/packaged unit), WFR (wafer), DIE (individual die), or LOT (production lot). Aligns with SAP base unit of measure configuration for semiconductor products.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Unit of Measure (MARA.MEINS); SEMI M1 Wafer Specification

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the status transition occurred (e.g., CUST_REQUEST, CAPACITY_HOLD, YIELD_FAIL, ALLOC_RELEASE, SHIP_CONFIRM, CANCEL_EOL). Sourced from SAP SD reason code configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product for full enumeration]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Reason for Rejection (ABGRU); Oracle Agile PLM Change Reason

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the status transition beyond the structured reason code. Captures escalation notes, customer communication references, or fab hold explanations entered by the user or system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Change Document Text (CDTXT)

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The customer-requested delivery date on the order line at the time of this status event. Snapshot preserved in the history record to track whether delivery commitments changed across status transitions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Requested Delivery Date (VBAP.EDATU)

attributes.name: sla_breached_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the duration in the prior status exceeded the SLA target hours, constituting an SLA breach. True when duration_in_prior_status_hours > sla_target_hours. Supports escalation triggering and customer reporting.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Customer-Specific Requirements; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: The contracted or internally defined SLA target duration (in hours) for the order to remain in the prior_status before transitioning. Used to assess whether the transition was on-time or breached the SLA threshold.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Customer-Specific Requirements; SAP S/4HANA SD — Delivery Schedule

attributes.name: source_document_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the source business document that triggered this status transition (e.g., a purchase order number, a delivery note number, an invoice number, or a MES lot release number). Provides cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Reference Document (VBKD.BSTKD); Camstar MES Lot Release

attributes.name: source_system_event_reference
attributes.description: The unique event or change document identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., SAP Change Document number CDHDR.CHANGENR, Camstar transaction ID, or Salesforce case event ID). Enables end-to-end traceability from the Silver layer back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Change Document Header (CDHDR.CHANGENR); Camstar MES Transaction Log

attributes.name: to_sales_order
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — Status history records belong to a specific sales order. Required for audit trail integrity.

attributes.name: transition_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the status transition occurred. This is the principal business event time for this EVENT_LOG record, distinct from record audit timestamps.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Change Document (CDHDR.UDATE/UTIME); ISO 8601

attributes.name: transition_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the status transition: forward progression through the order lifecycle, backward reversal (e.g., re-open), cancellation, or data correction. Supports lifecycle analytics and anomaly detection.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Order Processing; SEMI E10

attributes.name: triggered_by_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated the status change event. Distinguishes between manual user-driven changes and automated system-driven transitions (e.g., MES wafer start confirmation triggering wafer_started status). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SAP_SD|MES_CAMSTAR|MES_SMARTFACTORY|SALESFORCE_CRM|AGILE_PLM|MANUAL|API_INTEGRATION — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; Camstar MES; SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this status history record was last modified in the data platform. In an ideal append-only event log this should rarely change; populated to support correction workflows and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: wafer_start_authorization_number
attributes.description: The wafer start authorization number issued by the fab planning system when the order transitions to wafer_started status. Ties the commercial order to the physical manufacturing release in the MES.
attributes.references: Camstar MES — Wafer Start Authorization; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

products.name: wafer_start_authorization
products.description: Formal authorization record that triggers wafer fabrication starts in the FAB for a specific customer order or forecast commit. Captures authorized wafer quantity, target process node, fab site, planned start date, priority class (hot lot, standard, MPW), NRE flag, and linkage to the originating sales order or die bank replenishment plan. SSOT for wafer start demand signals passed from order management to manufacturing execution (MES). Bridges order domain to fabrication domain.

attributes.name: wafer_start_authorization_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying a wafer start authorization record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SEMI E10, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account on whose behalf the wafer start is authorized. Supports order-to-cash traceability and customer-level fab demand reporting. Fulfills the PARTY_REFERENCE minimum category for TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module, Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: fab_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fabrication facility (FAB) where the authorized wafer starts are to be executed. Determines routing of the demand signal to the correct MES instance.
attributes.references: Applied Materials SmartFactory MES, Camstar MES, SEMI E10

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MPW run record that groups multiple customer designs sharing this wafer start. Populated only when is_mpw is True. Enables allocation of wafer cost and die yield across participating customers.
attributes.references: SEMI, Camstar MES, SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: primary_wafer_order_id
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — Wafer start authorizations are triggered by customer orders. The WSA must reference the originating sales order for demand traceability.

attributes.name: reticle_set_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the photolithography reticle (mask) set to be used for this wafer start. Critical for EUV/DUV lithography scheduling and mask inventory management. Ensures the correct GDSII-derived mask set is reserved for the lot.
attributes.references: SEMI P1, SEMI P37, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the semiconductor product (IC, SoC, ASIC, FPGA, etc.) for which wafers are being authorized to start fabrication. Links to the product master in PLM.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM, Oracle Agile PLM, SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual calendar date on which wafer fabrication commenced at the fab site, as recorded by the MES. Compared against planned_start_date to measure schedule adherence and on-time start performance.
attributes.references: SEMI E10, Camstar MES, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: Organizational approval tier required and applied for this wafer start authorization. Higher-value or hot-lot authorizations may require director or VP approval. Supports SOX internal controls and delegation-of-authority compliance.

attributes.name: authorization_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the wafer start authorization, used across order management, MES, and fab planning systems. Typically formatted as WSA-{SITE}-{SEQUENCE}. This is the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category field for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.
attributes.references: SEMI E10, Camstar MES Lot Management, SAP S/4HANA PP Module

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the wafer start authorization record, tracking progression from initial creation through fab release and completion. Fulfills the LIFECYCLE_STATUS minimum category for TRANSACTION_HEADER. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|released_to_fab|in_progress|completed|cancelled|on_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEMI E10, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES, SAP S/4HANA PP Module

attributes.name: authorization_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wafer start authorization was formally approved and issued. This is the principal BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for this TRANSACTION_HEADER — the moment the authorization became binding and the demand signal was created.
attributes.references: SEMI E10, SAP S/4HANA PP/SD Module

attributes.name: authorized_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the person who formally approved and issued the wafer start authorization. Required for SOX compliance and audit trail. Typically a fab planning manager or order management lead.
attributes.references: SOX, ISO 9001, SAP S/4HANA PP Module

attributes.name: authorized_wafer_qty
attributes.description: Number of wafers authorized to start fabrication under this authorization record. This is the primary quantitative demand signal passed from order management to the MES. Fulfills the QUANTITATIVE_RESULT minimum category for this non-monetary TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: SEMI E10, Camstar MES, SAP S/4HANA PP Module

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the wafer start authorization was cancelled, when authorization_status is 'cancelled'. Used for backlog management analysis, demand forecasting accuracy improvement, and fab capacity recovery planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_request|forecast_revision|capacity_constraint|design_change|yield_risk|export_hold|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/PP Module, SEMI E10

attributes.name: chips_act_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wafer start authorization qualifies for US CHIPS and Science Act incentives or domestic production reporting requirements. Relevant for fab sites receiving CHIPS Act funding and for regulatory compliance reporting to the US Department of Commerce.
attributes.references: US CHIPS and Science Act, BIS/EAR

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP cost center to which the wafer fabrication costs for this authorization are allocated. Used for internal cost accounting, NRE cost recovery, and fab P&L reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the wafer start authorization record was first created in the source system. Fulfills the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED minimum category for TRANSACTION_HEADER. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: cycle_time_target_days
attributes.description: Target number of calendar days from wafer start to wafer out (completion of all fab processing steps). Defined by process node and priority class. Hot lots have compressed cycle time targets. Used for delivery commit date calculation and fab performance measurement.
attributes.references: SEMI E10, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: design_revision
attributes.description: Version or revision identifier of the IC design (GDS/GDSII tapeout revision) being fabricated in this wafer start. Ensures the correct design revision is linked to the physical lot for traceability from design to silicon.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM, Oracle Agile PLM, SEMI

attributes.name: die_bank_replenishment_code
attributes.description: Reference to the die bank replenishment plan that triggered this authorization when the wafer start is driven by inventory replenishment rather than a direct customer sales order. Nullable when authorization originates from a sales order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM Module, Camstar MES

attributes.name: die_per_wafer
attributes.description: Number of individual die sites on each wafer for the specified product and process node. Determined by die size and wafer diameter. Used in conjunction with yield_target_pct to compute expected_good_die_qty.

attributes.name: expected_good_die_qty
attributes.description: Projected number of Known Good Dies (KGD) expected from this wafer start, calculated from authorized_wafer_qty, die per wafer count, and yield_target_pct. Used for order fulfillment planning and die bank replenishment forecasting.
attributes.references: SEMI E10, Camstar MES, SAP S/4HANA PP Module

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification applicable to the product being fabricated under this authorization, per US EAR (Export Administration Regulations) and ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations). Determines whether export licenses are required before releasing wafers to certain fab sites or customers.
attributes.references: BIS/EAR, ITAR, US CHIPS Act Compliance

attributes.name: fab_work_order_number
attributes.description: SAP PP production order or work order number generated in ERP when the wafer start authorization is released to manufacturing. Bridges the order management domain to the ERP manufacturing execution module for cost collection and WIP tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module, SEMI E10

attributes.name: is_mpw
attributes.description: Indicates whether this authorization is for a Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) run, where multiple customer designs share a single wafer to reduce NRE cost. MPW lots require special reticle set management and die allocation tracking.

attributes.name: is_nre
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wafer start authorization is for a Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) run, such as a first-time tapeout, process qualification, or engineering lot, as opposed to a production volume order. NRE lots have distinct cost accounting and yield expectations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module, Siemens Teamcenter PLM, SEMI

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the wafer start authorization record. Fulfills the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED minimum category for TRANSACTION_HEADER. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and change tracking.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: MES-assigned lot identifier for the wafer batch initiated under this authorization. Populated after the authorization is released to the fab and a lot is created in the MES (Camstar or SmartFactory). Links the authorization to the physical WIP lot in the fab.
attributes.references: SEMI E10, Camstar MES, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or exceptions associated with this wafer start authorization. May include hot-lot justification, customer escalation notes, or fab-specific handling instructions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module, Camstar MES

attributes.name: nre_charge_usd
attributes.description: Non-Recurring Engineering fee in US dollars associated with this wafer start authorization, applicable for first-time tapeouts, mask set fabrication, and engineering qualification lots. Populated when is_nre is True. Used for customer invoicing and cost recovery tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module, SOX, JEDEC

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Expected date by which wafer fabrication (FEOL through BEOL) is planned to be completed and wafers released for wafer test and probing. Drives downstream packaging and delivery commit date calculations.
attributes.references: SEMI E10, SAP S/4HANA PP Module, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled calendar date on which wafer fabrication is planned to begin at the fab site. Used for fab capacity planning, WIP (Work in Process) scheduling, and order commit date calculations.
attributes.references: SEMI E10, SAP S/4HANA PP Module, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: priority_class
attributes.description: Fabrication priority classification assigned to this wafer start authorization. Hot lots receive highest fab priority and cycle time targets; MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) lots share wafer capacity across multiple designs; NRE pilot lots are for non-recurring engineering qualification runs.
attributes.references: SEMI E10, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES, Camstar MES

attributes.name: process_node
attributes.description: Target semiconductor process technology node for the wafer start (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 14nm, 28nm, 65nm). Determines the process design kit (PDK) and fab line assignment. Critical for capacity planning and yield forecasting.

attributes.name: process_technology_code
attributes.description: Internal fab process technology identifier (e.g., N5P, N7FF+, HVM28LP) that maps to a specific process flow within the fabrication facility. More granular than process_node; used for exact MES routing and recipe assignment.
attributes.references: Applied Materials SmartFactory MES, Camstar MES, PDK

attributes.name: required_ship_date
attributes.description: Customer-committed or order-driven date by which finished product must ship. Used to back-calculate the wafer start date and validate that the planned_start_date supports on-time delivery. Key input to TTM (Time to Market) and delivery performance metrics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module, Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system of record from which this wafer start authorization record originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA PP, Camstar MES, Applied Materials SmartFactory, Salesforce CRM design-win). Supports data lineage and Silver Layer reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., SAP production order number, Camstar lot ID, Salesforce opportunity ID). Enables cross-system traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and operational systems.
attributes.references: ISO 9001, SOX Data Lineage, SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: wafer_size_mm
attributes.description: Diameter of the silicon wafer substrate in millimeters (e.g., 200mm, 300mm, 450mm). Determines equipment compatibility and fab line routing at the fabrication facility.

attributes.name: wafer_unit_cost_usd
attributes.description: Standard cost per wafer in US dollars for the specified process node and fab site at the time of authorization. Used for cost of goods sold (COGS) estimation, margin analysis, and financial planning.

attributes.name: wsa_to_sales_order
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — Wafer start authorizations are triggered by sales orders. This link is essential for demand-to-supply traceability and is explicitly mentioned in the WSA description.

attributes.name: yield_target_pct
attributes.description: Expected die yield percentage (good dies per wafer as a percentage of total die sites) for this wafer start, based on process node maturity and historical SPC data. Used to calculate expected good die output and validate order fulfillment feasibility.

products.name: mpw_order
products.description: Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) order record managing shared wafer shuttle runs where multiple customer designs are co-fabricated on a single wafer. Captures shuttle run ID, process node, fab site, reticle slot assignments per customer, die quantity per design, NRE charges, tapeout deadline, planned wafer start date, and delivery schedule. Supports fabless customers and design houses participating in MPW programs. Distinct from standard production orders due to shared-reticle economics and slot-based allocation.

attributes.name: mpw_order_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the MPW order record. Primary key for the mpw_order data product within the order domain.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD21C; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fabless customer or design house placing this MPW order. Links to the customer master record for billing, contract terms, and design-win tracking in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: customer_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master agreement or NRE contract governing this MPW order, including pricing, IP ownership, and delivery terms. Links to the contract master in SAP S/4HANA or Oracle Agile PLM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal sales representative or account manager responsible for this MPW order. Used for commission tracking, design-win attribution, and customer relationship management in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Organization

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Externally-known identifier for the shared wafer shuttle run in which this MPW order participates. Used to group all customer designs co-fabricated on the same wafer lot. Sourced from the fab or MPW program operator (e.g., TSMC shuttle run code, GlobalFoundries MPW run number).
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; Camstar MES Lot Management

attributes.name: parent_sales_order_id
attributes.description: FK to order.order.order_id — MPW orders are a specialized order type linked to the master order record for customer and commercial terms.

attributes.name: primary_mpw_order_sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order. Business justification: MPW order belongs to a specific sales order; adding child-to-parent FK enables order‑level reporting and removes duplicate order_number.

attributes.name: tapeout_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tapeout record (final GDSII design submission) associated with this MPW order. Links the order to the design domain tapeout product for design-to-manufacturing traceability.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM PCN

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the ordered dies were delivered to the customer. Used to measure on-time delivery performance, close the order-to-cash cycle, and trigger final revenue recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Goods Issue; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the MPW order record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA measurement from order entry.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the order value and NRE charges (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Supports multi-currency billing for international fabless customers.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: design_name
attributes.description: Name or code of the customer's IC design (chip project) being fabricated in this MPW slot. Used for design-to-order traceability, customer communication, and design-win reporting in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Salesforce CRM Design-Win

attributes.name: design_revision
attributes.description: Version or revision identifier of the customer's IC design submitted for this MPW run (e.g., v1.0, Rev-B, tapeout_2). Ensures the correct GDSII version is linked to the order for traceability and re-spin management.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM PCN; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: die_quantity_delivered
attributes.description: Actual number of known-good dies (KGD) delivered to the customer from this MPW order. May differ from die_quantity_ordered due to yield loss. Used for fulfillment reconciliation and yield-adjusted billing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery; JEDEC JESD21C; Camstar MES

attributes.name: die_quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Number of known-good dies (KGD) ordered by the customer from this MPW shuttle run. Used for delivery planning, yield-adjusted fulfillment, and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD21C; SAP S/4HANA SD Order Quantity

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) applicable to the IC design in this MPW order. Required for export license determination and BIS/EAR compliance reporting. Example values: EAR99, 3E001, 3A001.
attributes.references: EAR 15 CFR 774 Commerce Control List; BIS/EAR; ITAR 22 CFR 120-130

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the wafer fabrication facility (FAB) where this MPW shuttle run is manufactured (e.g., internal fab or OSAT partner site code). Used for capacity planning, yield tracking, and export compliance (ITAR/EAR).
attributes.references: SEMI E10; ITAR 22 CFR 120-130; EAR 15 CFR 730-774

attributes.name: itar_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MPW order involves ITAR-controlled technology requiring State Department licensing and restricted handling. True = ITAR-controlled; False = not ITAR-controlled. Drives access controls and shipment documentation requirements.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Flag

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Fab-assigned wafer lot number for the MPW shuttle run associated with this order. Used for WIP tracking in Camstar MES, yield analysis, and defect traceability through the fabrication process.
attributes.references: Camstar MES Lot Management; SEMI E10; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: mpw_program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the MPW shuttle program under which this order is placed. Determines pricing tiers, slot priority, NRE subsidies, and export control applicability (e.g., government programs may require ITAR review).
attributes.references: ITAR 22 CFR 120-130; EAR 15 CFR 730-774; CHIPS Act Compliance

attributes.name: mpw_to_order
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — MPW orders may be linked to a parent sales order for billing and customer relationship tracking.

attributes.name: mpw_to_sales_order
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — MPW orders are a specialized order type that should link back to the parent sales order for billing and customer relationship tracking.

attributes.name: nre_charge_usd
attributes.description: One-time Non-Recurring Engineering charge billed to the customer for mask set preparation, reticle slot allocation, and design-in support for this MPW order. Expressed in US dollars. Shared proportionally among shuttle participants based on reticle slot area.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; SOX Section 404; JEDEC

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the customer formally placed the MPW order. Represents the principal business event date for order-to-cash lifecycle tracking and backlog reporting.

attributes.name: order_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing special instructions, customer-specific requirements, design constraints, or internal processing notes associated with this MPW order. Not used for structured data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Order Text; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the MPW order from initial entry through fabrication completion. Drives backlog management, revenue recognition, and customer communication workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|confirmed|tapeout_received|wafer_started|in_fab|completed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Order Status; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: order_value_usd
attributes.description: Total monetary value of this MPW order in US dollars, comprising NRE charges plus die unit price multiplied by ordered quantity. Used for backlog reporting, revenue forecasting, and SAP FI billing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Recognition; SOX Section 404; IFRS 15

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Semiconductor package type requested for the delivered dies (e.g., bare die/KGD, WLCSP, BGA, QFN, flip-chip). Determines OSAT engagement, packaging cost, and delivery lead time. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bare_die|WLCSP|BGA|QFN|flip_chip|CSP — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: planned_delivery_date
attributes.description: Committed date by which the ordered dies are planned to be delivered to the customer after wafer fabrication, dicing, and optional packaging. Used for customer delivery scheduling and order-to-cash SLA tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Scheduling; JEDEC JESD21C

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Customer-issued purchase order number referencing this MPW order. Required for invoice matching, accounts receivable, and customer procurement compliance. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD order entry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; ISO 6422 Purchase Order

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this MPW order for slot allocation, fab scheduling, and customer support escalation. Critical orders receive expedited processing and dedicated account management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Order Priority; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: process_node
attributes.description: Semiconductor fabrication process technology node used for this MPW shuttle run (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 28nm, 65nm). Determines the PDK, design rules, and fab site eligibility. Critical for yield modeling and NRE pricing.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; ITRS/IRDS Roadmap; PDK Specification

attributes.name: reticle_slot_area_mm2
attributes.description: Physical area in square millimeters allocated to this customer's design within the shared MPW reticle. Determines die size, die-per-wafer count, and proportional NRE cost allocation among shuttle participants.

attributes.name: reticle_slot_number
attributes.description: The specific slot number assigned to this customer's design on the shared MPW reticle. Each slot represents a distinct die area on the shared mask set. Slot allocation drives NRE cost sharing and die quantity calculations.
attributes.references: SEMI P10; Camstar MES Reticle Management

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the materials and processes used in this MPW order comply with the EU RoHS Directive restricting hazardous substances in electronic equipment. Required for EU market access and customer compliance declarations.
attributes.references: RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU; REACH Regulation EC 1907/2006; IPC-1752

attributes.name: sales_region_code
attributes.description: Geographic sales region code associated with this MPW order (e.g., AMER, EMEA, APAC, JAPAN). Used for regional revenue reporting, quota management, and export control jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Organization; EAR 15 CFR 730-774

attributes.name: tapeout_deadline
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the customer must submit the final GDSII design data (tapeout) to secure their reticle slot in the MPW shuttle run. Missing this date results in slot forfeiture and potential NRE penalty.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM PCN; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: tapeout_received_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the customer's final GDSII tapeout data was received and accepted by the fab or design services team. Used to confirm slot lock and trigger wafer start authorization.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: unit_price_usd
attributes.description: Per-die price charged to the customer for the ordered die quantity from this MPW run. Expressed in US dollars. Used for revenue recognition, invoice generation, and margin analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the MPW order record. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: wafer_quantity
attributes.description: Number of wafers allocated to this customer's design within the MPW shuttle run. Determines the maximum achievable die yield and is used for fab capacity reservation and WIP tracking.
attributes.references: Camstar MES Wafer Tracking; SEMI E10

attributes.name: wafer_start_date_actual
attributes.description: Actual date on which wafer fabrication was initiated for this MPW shuttle run. Compared against planned wafer start date to measure schedule adherence and TTM performance.
attributes.references: Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; Camstar MES; SEMI E10

attributes.name: wafer_start_date_planned
attributes.description: Planned date for initiating wafer fabrication (wafer start) for this MPW shuttle run at the fab site. Used for fab capacity scheduling, WIP planning, and customer delivery commitment.
attributes.references: Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; Camstar MES; SEMI E10

attributes.name: yield_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of good dies produced relative to the total possible dies from the allocated wafer area in this MPW run. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Used for quality reporting, customer communication, and yield improvement programs.
attributes.references: SEMI E10; SPC Guidelines; ISO 9001:2015; IATF 16949

products.name: die_bank_order
products.description: Order record for drawing down inventory from a customer-specific or generic die bank (KGD inventory held in wafer or singulated die form). Captures die bank source lot, requested die quantity, die type, package conversion instructions, requested delivery date, and fulfillment status. Supports just-in-time packaging and assembly workflows where die inventory is pre-built and orders trigger OSAT packaging runs. Distinct from wafer start orders as no new fab starts are required.

attributes.name: die_bank_order_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for the die bank order record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that placed the die bank order. Links to the customer master for account-level reporting, design-win tracking, and allocation priority management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master; Salesforce CRM Account

attributes.name: die_bank_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific die bank (customer-specific or generic KGD inventory pool) from which this order draws down inventory. Identifies the source die bank record in the inventory management system.
attributes.references: Camstar MES Die Bank; SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory

attributes.name: inventory_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific wafer fabrication lot from which the die bank inventory was sourced. Enables full traceability from die bank order back to the originating fab lot for quality and yield analysis.
attributes.references: Camstar MES Lot Management; SAP S/4HANA PP Production Order

attributes.name: osat_vendor_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Vendor ID
attributes.description: Reference to the OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) vendor designated to perform the packaging and assembly conversion for this die bank order. Drives OSAT purchase order creation and work order dispatch.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; IATF 16949 Supplier Management

tag_set.value: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Vendor ID

attributes.name: primary_die_order_id
attributes.description: FK to order.order.order_id — Die bank orders draw from pre-built inventory against a customer order for commercial and delivery tracking.

attributes.name: test_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) test program used to qualify the die bank inventory as Known Good Die. Ensures the correct test coverage was applied before die bank entry.
attributes.references: Camstar MES; JEDEC JESD47 KGD Testing; ATPG Standards

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Date on which the packaged dies or bare die shipment was physically dispatched from the OSAT or warehouse facility. Used for on-time delivery measurement and revenue recognition triggering.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Goods Issue; IATF 16949

attributes.name: allocated_die_quantity
attributes.description: Number of dies formally allocated from the die bank inventory against this order. May differ from requested quantity due to partial allocation, inventory constraints, or backlog management decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Management; Camstar MES

products.name: shipment
products.description: Physical shipment record tracking the outbound movement of semiconductor products from origin (fab, OSAT, distribution center) to customer destination. Header captures shipment number, carrier, tracking number, ship date, estimated and actual arrival dates, package count, gross weight, HS tariff codes, export license reference, and shipment status. Line-level detail captures shipped quantity per order line, lot numbers, wafer lot IDs, package types, serial numbers, unit of measure, and inspection certificate references. Delivery confirmation section captures proof of delivery (POD) including confirmed receipt date, receiving location, confirmed quantity, customer PO reference, discrepancy flags (quantity shortage, wrong part, damaged goods), and customer signoff reference. POD receipt triggers downstream invoice release and revenue recognition. Supports multi-leg shipments, cross-border trade compliance (EAR, ITAR), RMA dispute resolution, and full traceability from order line through physical delivery. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD outbound delivery, carrier POD data, and customer EDI 856 ASN acknowledgements.
