attributes.description: Maximum allowable relative humidity percentage for storage of the raw material. Particularly critical for silicon wafers, photomasks, and hygroscopic chemicals where moisture exposure causes defects or degradation.
attributes.references: SEMI M1 (Silicon Wafer Standard); SEMI P1 (Photomask Standard); GHS SDS Section 7

attributes.name: storage_temp_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the raw material. Exceeding this threshold may degrade material quality, trigger safety hazards, or invalidate process qualification. Used for warehouse environmental compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: SEMI C1; GHS SDS Section 7; ISO 14001

attributes.name: storage_temp_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the raw material. Used to configure environmental monitoring alerts in the warehouse management system and ensure compliance with material safety data sheet (SDS) requirements.
attributes.references: SEMI C1; GHS SDS Section 7; ISO 14001

attributes.name: supplier_part_number
attributes.description: The part number or catalog number assigned by the primary supplier to this raw material. Used for purchase order creation, supplier communication, and incoming inspection cross-referencing. Stored in SAP INFO record (EINE.IDNLF).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - EINE.IDNLF; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: wafer_diameter_mm
attributes.description: Nominal diameter of the silicon wafer in millimeters (e.g., 200.0 for 8-inch, 300.0 for 12-inch). Applicable only to silicon wafer material class. Critical for process tool compatibility and fab line qualification. Null for non-wafer materials.
attributes.references: SEMI M1 (Specification for Polished Monocrystalline Silicon Wafers); SEMI M49

attributes.name: wafer_type
attributes.description: Specifies the silicon wafer substrate type: bare_silicon (polished CZ), epitaxial (epi-layer deposited), soi (Silicon-on-Insulator), fz (Float Zone), or cz (Czochralski). Determines process compatibility and electrical characteristics. Null for non-wafer materials.
attributes.references: SEMI M1; SEMI M44 (SOI Wafers); JEDEC

products.name: finished_good
products.description: Master record for packaged semiconductor finished goods held in inventory including ICs, SoCs, ASICs, FPGAs, and discrete devices in final package form. Tracks SKU, product family, package type (WLCSP, BGA, QFN, CoWoS), device marking, date code, lot traceability code, HTS classification, RoHS compliance status, ECCN number for export control, and shelf life. Links to product domain SKU catalog.
products.reference: SAP MM Finished Goods Material Master

attributes.name: finished_good_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the finished good master record in the inventory system. Primary key for the finished_good data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Needed for Order Fulfillment process to associate shipped finished goods with the purchasing customer account for invoicing and compliance.

attributes.name: certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.certification. Business justification: Finished goods must be associated with product certifications to satisfy regulatory audits and customer qualification requirements.

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.ic_design_project. Business justification: Linking finished goods to their design project supports warranty tracking and post‑sale support processes.

attributes.name: osat_vendor_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner ID
attributes.description: Reference to the Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) partner responsible for packaging and assembly of this finished good. Used for consignment stock tracking and supplier quality management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-Vendor Master; SEMI Standards

tag_set.value: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner ID

attributes.name: release_engineer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Finished‑Good Release process mandates an engineer to approve product release, linking the lot to the responsible employee for regulatory traceability.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU catalog entry in the product domain that defines the commercial product specification for this finished good.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-Material Master; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or distribution center where this finished good inventory is physically held, including OSAT consignment locations.

attributes.name: tapeout_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.tapeout. Business justification: Finished‑good traceability to the originating tapeout is needed for quality audits and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: aec_q_qualified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the finished good has been qualified to AEC-Q100 (IC), AEC-Q101 (discrete), or AEC-Q200 (passive) automotive reliability standards. Required for automotive supply chain design-in.
attributes.references: AEC-Q100; AEC-Q101; AEC-Q200; IATF 16949; JEDEC JESD47

attributes.name: bin_code
attributes.description: Test bin classification code assigned during wafer sort or final test indicating the performance and quality tier of the die/device. Bin codes map to specific product SKUs and determine commercial grade.
attributes.references: Camstar MES; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; SEMI E142

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the finished good was manufactured or substantially transformed. Required for customs declarations, trade compliance, and preferential tariff determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; WCO Rules of Origin; US CBP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the finished good master record was first created in the inventory system. Audit trail field for data governance and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; SOX Section 302/404; ISO 9001

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the standard cost and inventory valuation of this finished good (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'TWD').

attributes.name: date_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing date code in YYWW format (year + work week) indicating when the device was assembled and packaged. Used for shelf life tracking, lot traceability, and field failure analysis.

attributes.name: device_marking
attributes.description: Alphanumeric marking laser-inscribed or printed on the physical package surface. Includes part number, speed grade, temperature grade, and manufacturer code. Used for traceability and counterfeit detection.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Classification of the semiconductor device type. Indicates whether the finished good is an Integrated Circuit (IC), System on Chip (SoC), Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC), Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA), discrete device, or other category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IC|SoC|ASIC|FPGA|Discrete|MCU|DSP|PMIC|Memory|RF|Sensor|Analog — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dppm_target
attributes.description: Quality target expressed as Defective Parts Per Million (DPPM) for outgoing quality of this finished good. Used in customer quality agreements and SPC monitoring. Automotive-grade typically requires <10 DPPM.

attributes.name: eccn_number
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) assigned under the US Export Administration Regulations (EAR) administered by BIS. Determines export licensing requirements and restricted country applicability. Sensitive for trade compliance purposes.
attributes.references: BIS/EAR Export Administration Regulations; 15 CFR Part 774; CHIPS Act Compliance

attributes.name: eol_date
attributes.description: Announced End of Life (EOL) date after which the finished good will no longer be manufactured or sold. Triggers Last Time Buy (LTB) notifications to customers per JEDEC JESD48 standard.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD48; Oracle Agile PLM; IPC-1752

attributes.name: hts_code
attributes.description: Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) classification code used for customs declaration, import/export duty determination, and trade statistics reporting. Follows the 10-digit US HTS format.
attributes.references: US International Trade Commission HTS; WCO Harmonized System; BIS/EAR

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current inventory disposition status of the finished good lot. 'available' indicates unrestricted stock; 'quarantine' indicates pending quality review; 'reserved' indicates allocated to an order; 'consignment' indicates stock held at OSAT or customer site; 'hold' indicates engineering or compliance hold.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-Inventory Management; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.4

attributes.name: inventory_valuation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to value this finished good inventory in the general ledger. 'standard' = standard cost; 'moving_average' = moving average price (MAP); 'fifo' = First In First Out; 'lifo' = Last In First Out.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO; IAS 2 Inventories; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the finished good is subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) controls administered by the US State Department DDTC. ITAR-controlled items require specific export licenses and handling procedures.
attributes.references: ITAR 22 CFR Parts 120-130; US State Department DDTC

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled

attributes.name: kgd_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the die used in this finished good has been verified as a Known Good Die (KGD) through wafer-level testing prior to packaging. Critical for advanced packaging (CoWoS, InFO, chiplet) and high-reliability applications.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD49; SEMI Standards; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the finished good master record. Used for change data capture (CDC), data lineage tracking, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; SOX Section 302/404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Commercial lifecycle stage of the finished good. 'active' = in production and available; 'nrnd' = Not Recommended for New Designs; 'eol' = End of Life (EOL) announced; 'ltb' = Last Time Buy (LTB) window open; 'discontinued' = no longer available.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; JEDEC JESD48; IPC-1752

attributes.name: lot_traceability_code
attributes.description: Unique lot or batch identifier linking the finished good back to the wafer fabrication lot, enabling full forward and backward traceability through the manufacturing supply chain. Aligns with Camstar MES lot number.
attributes.references: Camstar MES; SEMI E10; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.2; IATF 16949

attributes.name: msd_level
attributes.description: Moisture Sensitivity Level (MSL) classification per IPC/JEDEC J-STD-020 indicating the device's sensitivity to ambient moisture during storage and handling. Level 1 = unlimited floor life; Level 6 = must be baked immediately before use. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1|2|2a|3|4|5|5a|6 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPC/JEDEC J-STD-020; IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033; JEDEC JESD22-A113

attributes.name: package_body_size_mm
attributes.description: Physical body dimensions of the semiconductor package expressed as length x width in millimeters (e.g., '10x10', '5.5x5.5'). Used for PCB design, handling equipment setup, and storage tray selection.

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Physical semiconductor package format of the finished good (e.g., Ball Grid Array (BGA), Quad Flat No-lead (QFN), Wafer-Level Chip Scale Package (WLCSP), Chip on Wafer on Substrate (CoWoS), Integrated Fan-Out (InFO)). Determines handling, PCB footprint, and storage requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BGA|QFN|QFP|WLCSP|CoWoS|InFO|LGA|DIP|SOP|CSP|FCBGA|PGA — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pcn_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the most recent Product Change Notification (PCN) affecting this finished good. PCNs document changes to materials, processes, or package that may impact customer qualification status.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD46; Oracle Agile PLM; IPC-7711/7721

attributes.name: pin_count
attributes.description: Total number of electrical pins, balls, or leads on the finished good package. Critical for PCB design compatibility, socket selection, and ATE (Automatic Test Equipment) configuration.

attributes.name: product_family
attributes.description: Product family grouping to which this finished good belongs (e.g., high-performance compute SoC family, automotive microcontroller family). Used for portfolio reporting and demand planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current product qualification status indicating whether the finished good has passed all required reliability and quality qualification tests for its target market segment (consumer, industrial, automotive, military).
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD47; AEC-Q100; MIL-STD-883; ISO 9001; IATF 16949

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: Current physical inventory quantity of this finished good in units (individual packaged devices). Reflects unrestricted stock available for order fulfillment as tracked in SAP MM inventory management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-Inventory Management; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the finished good complies with EU REACH Regulation (EC No 1907/2006) regarding chemical substance safety, including absence of Substances of Very High Concern (SVHC) above threshold concentrations.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation EC No 1907/2006; IPC-1752

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the finished good complies with the EU RoHS Directive (2011/65/EU) restricting use of hazardous substances including lead, mercury, cadmium, and hexavalent chromium in electronic equipment.
attributes.references: EU RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU; IPC-1752; JEDEC JESD97

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage duration in days from the manufacturing date before the finished good must be baked, re-qualified, or scrapped. Particularly relevant for moisture-sensitive devices (MSD) per IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033.
attributes.references: IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033; JEDEC JESD22-A113; SAP S/4HANA MM-Shelf Life Management

attributes.name: shelf_life_expiry_date
attributes.description: Calculated date on which the shelf life of this finished good lot expires, derived from the manufacturing date code plus shelf life days. Triggers re-bake or scrap workflow in SAP MM.
attributes.references: IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033; SAP S/4HANA MM-Shelf Life Management

attributes.name: speed_grade
attributes.description: Performance speed grade or frequency bin classification of the finished good (e.g., '-1', '-2', '3.0GHz', '800MHz'). Determined during wafer sort and final test binning. Differentiates product variants within the same die.
attributes.references: JEDEC Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM-Material Master

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost per unit of the finished good in the functional currency as maintained in SAP CO (Controlling) for inventory valuation, cost of goods sold calculation, and variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-Product Costing; SOX Section 302/404; IAS 2 Inventories

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this finished good. Exceeding this threshold may degrade device reliability or void qualification. Used to configure warehouse environmental monitoring alerts.

attributes.name: temperature_grade
attributes.description: Operating temperature range classification of the finished good. 'commercial' (0°C to 70°C), 'industrial' (-40°C to 85°C), 'automotive' (-40°C to 125°C/150°C per AEC-Q100), 'military' (-55°C to 125°C), 'extended' for specialized ranges.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for inventory counting of the finished good. 'EA' = each (individual device); 'TRAY' = JEDEC tray; 'REEL' = tape-and-reel; 'TUBE' = tube/stick packaging; 'BOX' = bulk box.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; JEDEC JESD22; IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033

products.name: die_bank
products.description: Master record for die bank inventory — singulated known-good dies (KGD) stored in waffle packs, gel packs, or tape-and-reel awaiting packaging or direct shipment. Tracks die bank ID, product code, process node, die revision, KGD certification status, bin classification, quantity available, storage location, storage temperature, wafer lot origin, tapeout version, and die bank creation date. Critical for fabless and OSAT-model inventory management.
products.reference: KGD Die Bank / SAP MM Special Stock

attributes.name: die_bank_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for the die bank inventory record. Primary key for the die_bank data product.

attributes.name: device_architecture_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.device_architecture. Business justification: Die banks are allocated per device architecture; link supports the Die Bank Allocation per Architecture operational dashboard.

attributes.name: die_storage_location_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.storage_location.storage_location_id — Die banks in waffle/gel packs must track their physical storage location for retrieval and environmental compliance.

attributes.name: eccn_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.eccn_classification. Business justification: Die banks contain IP that may be subject to ECCN rules; linking enables tracking of classification per bank for export compliance.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fabrication facility (FAB) where the parent wafer lot was manufactured. Supports multi-fab sourcing analysis and compliance traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Plant; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating wafer lot from which these dies were singulated. Provides full traceability from die bank back to fabrication lot in Camstar MES and SAP PP.
attributes.references: Camstar MES Lot Tracking; SAP S/4HANA PP; SEMI E10

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Needed for Die Bank Allocation and Yield Reporting, tying each die bank to the specific IC catalog it supports; removes denormalized product_code/name.

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.ic_design_project. Business justification: Die‑bank inventory is tracked per design project for yield analysis and customer yield reporting.

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MPW shuttle run if the parent wafer lot was fabricated as part of a multi-project wafer program. Null for dedicated production wafer lots.
attributes.references: SEMI MPW Standards; Camstar MES; SAP PP

attributes.name: osat_vendor_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner ID
attributes.description: Reference to the OSAT partner at whose facility this die bank is held as consignment stock, if applicable. Null if stored at internal warehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; JEDEC

tag_set.value: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner ID

attributes.name: primary_storage_location_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.storage_location.storage_location_id — Die banks are stored at specific locations (cleanroom storage, cold storage). Location tracking is critical for environmental compliance and retrieval.

attributes.name: probe_card_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the probe card used during wafer sort for the parent wafer lot. Enables correlation of test results to probe card condition and supports yield excursion root cause analysis.
attributes.references: Camstar MES Equipment Tracking; SEMI E10

attributes.name: responsible_engineer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Die Bank Inventory must record the responsible engineer who authorizes releases and handles quality holds, supporting compliance audits.

attributes.name: bin_class
attributes.description: FK to inventory.bin_classification.bin_classification_id — Every die bank entry is classified by bin (speed grade, power class, pass/fail). This FK drives KGD allocation and customer shipment decisions.

attributes.name: bin_classification
attributes.description: Electrical test bin classification assigned during wafer probe/sort (e.g., Bin1=Full-speed pass, Bin2=Speed-binned, Bin3=Partial-function, Bin99=Fail). Determines product grade, pricing tier, and eligible end markets. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bin1|bin2|bin3|bin4|bin5|bin6|bin99|scrap — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD47; ATPG/ATE Bin Mapping; SAP QM

attributes.name: carrier_type
attributes.description: Physical carrier medium in which the singulated dies are stored (e.g., waffle pack, gel pack, tape-and-reel, JEDEC tray). Determines handling requirements, automated pick-and-place compatibility, and storage density.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD22-B102; SEMI G42; IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033

attributes.name: die_bank_code
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known unique business identifier for the die bank lot, used in MES, ERP, and OSAT partner communications. Follows internal lot numbering conventions.
attributes.references: Camstar MES Lot Management; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this die bank record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the unit cost and inventory valuation of this die bank (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: die_bank_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the die bank inventory record. 'Available' indicates dies are ready for allocation; 'Reserved' indicates committed to an order; 'Consumed' indicates fully used in packaging; 'Quarantined' indicates hold pending quality investigation; 'Scrapped' indicates disposed; 'Expired' indicates shelf life exceeded.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Management; Camstar MES; SEMI E10

attributes.name: die_revision
attributes.description: Silicon revision or stepping identifier for the die (e.g., A0, B1, C2). Tracks design iterations post-tapeout; critical for distinguishing engineering samples from production silicon.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM PCN Process; JEDEC JESD46

attributes.name: die_size_mm2
attributes.description: Physical area of a single die in square millimeters. Critical for packaging selection, cost-per-die calculations, and wafer yield modeling.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; JEDEC; IC Design PDK

attributes.name: esd_sensitivity_class
attributes.description: JEDEC Human Body Model (HBM) or Charged Device Model (CDM) ESD sensitivity classification for the dies. Determines handling precautions, packaging requirements, and ESD-protected area (EPA) storage mandates.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD22-A114; JEDEC JS-001; ANSI/ESD S20.20

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calculated date on which the die bank shelf life expires, based on creation date plus shelf_life_days under specified storage conditions. After this date, dies require re-qualification before use.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) assigned to this die product. Determines export license requirements and restricted country applicability under BIS/EAR and ITAR.
attributes.references: BIS/EAR Export Administration Regulations; ITAR 22 CFR 120-130; CHIPS Act

attributes.name: inventory_valuation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to value this die bank inventory in the ERP system (e.g., Standard Cost, Moving Average Price, FIFO, LIFO). Determines how cost of goods sold is calculated upon consumption.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Inventory Valuation; IAS 2 Inventories; SOX

attributes.name: is_consignment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this die bank is held as consignment stock at an OSAT partner or customer site (True) versus owned and stored at an internal facility (False). Affects inventory ownership, liability, and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Consignment Processing; IAS 2

attributes.name: is_engineering_sample
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dies in this bank are engineering samples (True) or production-qualified silicon (False). Engineering samples may have restricted use, limited warranty, and different pricing terms.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM; JEDEC JESD46; SAP SD

attributes.name: kgd_status
attributes.description: Known Good Die (KGD) certification status indicating whether the dies in this bank have passed all required electrical and functional tests and are certified for packaging or direct shipment. Certified dies meet full production test specifications.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD22; SEMI G42; ATE Test Standards

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical or visual inspection of the die bank, including carrier integrity check, quantity verification, and storage condition audit. Required for periodic quality surveillance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 8.6; IATF 16949; SAP QM Inspection Lot

attributes.name: lot_origin
attributes.description: FK to inventory.wafer_lot.wafer_lot_id — Die banks trace back to their source wafer lot for genealogy and quality traceability. Critical for IATF 16949.

attributes.name: moisture_sensitivity_level
attributes.description: JEDEC/IPC Moisture Sensitivity Level classification for the dies, indicating how sensitive the package or die is to ambient moisture and the required floor life before reflow. Governs dry-pack and bake-out requirements.

attributes.name: process_node
attributes.description: Semiconductor fabrication process technology node at which the dies were manufactured (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 28nm, 65nm). Critical for yield benchmarking, packaging compatibility, and customer qualification.

attributes.name: quality_hold_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for placing this die bank on quality hold or quarantine status. Populated when die_bank_status is 'quarantined'. Examples: parametric excursion, contamination event, ESD damage suspected.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Usage Decision; SEMI E10; ISO 9001

attributes.name: quantity_available
attributes.description: Current count of dies available for allocation or shipment in this die bank record. Decremented upon reservation or consumption. Expressed in units of individual dies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Management; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: quantity_initial
attributes.description: Original count of dies placed into this die bank at the time of creation, before any consumption, scrap, or reservation. Used as the baseline for yield and consumption tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt; Camstar MES

attributes.name: quantity_reserved
attributes.description: Count of dies in this die bank that are currently reserved against open orders or packaging work orders but not yet physically consumed. Supports ATP (Available-to-Promise) calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD ATP; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: quantity_scrapped
attributes.description: Cumulative count of dies from this die bank that have been scrapped due to handling damage, quality failures, or shelf life expiry. Used for loss tracking and yield analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Scrap Recording; SEMI E10

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the die and carrier materials comply with EU REACH Regulation (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals), confirming no SVHC (Substances of Very High Concern) above threshold.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation EC 1907/2006; SEMI S23

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dies and their carrier materials comply with the EU RoHS Directive (Restriction of Hazardous Substances), restricting lead, mercury, cadmium, and other hazardous materials. Required for EU market access.
attributes.references: EU RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU; IPC-1752A; REACH Regulation

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the dies can be stored under specified conditions before they are considered expired and require re-qualification or scrap. Drives FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory rotation.
attributes.references: IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033; JEDEC JESD22; SEMI G42

attributes.name: storage_humidity_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable relative humidity percentage for storage of this die bank. Moisture-sensitive dies require controlled humidity to prevent MSL (Moisture Sensitivity Level) violations.
attributes.references: IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033; JEDEC JESD22-A120; SEMI G42

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this die bank. Exceeding this limit risks solder bump oxidation, adhesive degradation, or ESD damage.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD22-A119; IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033; SEMI G42

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this die bank. Violations may cause electrostatic or material degradation. Enforced by warehouse management system.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD22-A119; IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033; SEMI G42

attributes.name: tapeout_version
attributes.description: Identifier of the tapeout submission (GDSII release version) from which the wafers in this die bank were fabricated. Enables traceability back to the design release in EDA and PLM systems.
attributes.references: Cadence Virtuoso GDSII; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SEMI P10

attributes.name: test_program_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the ATE (Automatic Test Equipment) test program used during wafer probe/sort to classify and bin the dies in this die bank. Critical for test traceability and re-test qualification.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD47; ATE Test Program Management; SAP QM

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Standard or moving average cost per individual die in the die bank, expressed in the functional currency. Used for inventory valuation, cost of goods sold, and transfer pricing to OSAT partners.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Product Costing; IAS 2; SOX

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to this die bank record in the data platform. Used for change tracking, incremental ETL, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: wafer_lot_origin_fk
attributes.description: FK to inventory.wafer_lot.wafer_lot_id — Die banks originate from wafer lots after singulation. This traceability link is required for IATF 16949 compliance and customer complaint root cause analysis.

attributes.name: wafer_probe_yield_pct
attributes.description: Electrical test yield percentage from wafer probe/sort for the parent wafer lot, representing the fraction of dies that passed all probe tests. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 92.5000). Used for cost modeling and quality benchmarking.
attributes.references: SEMI E10; KLA ICOS Inspection; SAP QM

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Business date on which this die bank record was created, representing when the singulated dies were formally received into die bank inventory following wafer dicing and initial inspection.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt; Camstar MES; SEMI E10

products.name: photomask_asset
products.description: Master record for photomasks (reticles) used in photolithography patterning steps. Tracks mask ID, mask set name, layer name, technology node, EUV/DUV classification, mask generation (tapeout version), OPC version, MEEF value, mask vendor, mask type (binary/attPSM/altPSM), inspection status, defect count, usage count, maximum usage limit, storage location, and retirement date. Masks are high-value, reusable inventory assets.
products.reference: Mask Management System / Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: photomask_asset_id
attributes.description: Primary key for photomask_asset

attributes.name: custody_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Photomask Custody Tracking logs the employee with physical custody of each mask to meet EHS and export‑control compliance.

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IC design project for which this photomask was created. Links the mask asset to the product design domain for end-to-end traceability from design intent to physical mask.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM, Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: pdk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Process Design Kit (PDK) version under which this mask was designed and qualified. Ensures mask-process compatibility and supports PDK version change impact analysis.

attributes.name: photomask_id
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier assigned to the photomask by the mask vendor or internal mask management system. Used for cross-system traceability and vendor communication.

attributes.name: primary_storage_location_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.storage_location.storage_location_id — High-value photomasks must track their storage location for retrieval and environmental control.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: PHOTOMASK PROCUREMENT: Mask vendor is a supplier; linking enables vendor performance, cost, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: tapeout_experiment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.tapeout_experiment. Business justification: Tapeout experiments must record assigned photomasks; this FK enables the Tapeout Mask Allocation compliance report.

attributes.name: tapeout_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tapeout record that generated the GDS/GDSII data used to manufacture this photomask. Links the mask asset to the design domain for full design-to-fab traceability.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM, Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: asset_valuation_usd
attributes.description: Financial book value of the photomask asset in US dollars as recorded in the fixed asset or inventory valuation module. EUV masks can cost $500K–$1M+; DUV masks range from $10K–$100K. Used for inventory valuation, depreciation, and insurance purposes.

attributes.name: cd_uniformity_nm
attributes.description: Measured critical dimension (CD) uniformity across the mask in nanometers, as determined during mask inspection. A key quality metric indicating pattern fidelity; tighter CD uniformity is required at advanced nodes.
attributes.references: SEMI P1, KLA ICOS Inspection Systems, ITRS/IRDS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this photomask asset record was first created in the inventory management system. Provides audit trail for record provenance.

attributes.name: defect_count
attributes.description: Total number of defects detected on the photomask surface during the most recent inspection cycle. Compared against the maximum allowable defect specification to determine pass/fail disposition. Tracked per KLA ICOS inspection records.
attributes.references: KLA ICOS Inspection Systems, SEMI P1

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility (FAB) where this photomask is assigned for use. A mask may be qualified for use at a specific fab site due to equipment compatibility and process qualification requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Result of the most recent mask inspection performed by metrology equipment (e.g., KLA ICOS). Indicates whether the mask meets defect density and CD uniformity specifications for continued production use.
attributes.references: KLA ICOS Inspection Systems, SEMI P1, ISO 9001

attributes.name: is_mpw_mask
attributes.description: Indicates whether this photomask was manufactured as part of a Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) shuttle run, where multiple designs share a single mask set to reduce NRE costs. MPW masks have shared ownership and usage constraints.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent mask inspection was performed using metrology equipment (e.g., KLA ICOS). Used to schedule next inspection interval and assess mask health currency.
attributes.references: KLA ICOS Inspection Systems, SEMI P1

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this photomask asset record. Used for change tracking, data lineage, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the photolithography process layer this mask patterns (e.g., POLY, METAL1, VIA2, DIFFUSION). Identifies the specific fabrication step in the FEOL/MOL/BEOL stack.

attributes.name: lithography_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lithography exposure technology for which this mask is designed. Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) masks are used for sub-7nm nodes; Deep Ultraviolet (DUV) masks are used for 7nm and above. Drives storage, handling, and cost classification.
attributes.references: SEMI P37 (EUV Mask), SEMI P1 (DUV Mask)

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date on which the photomask was manufactured and released by the mask vendor. Used for age-based shelf life tracking and vendor lead time analysis.

attributes.name: mask_generation
attributes.description: Version or generation identifier of the mask corresponding to the tapeout revision (e.g., v1.0, v2.1, ECO_rev3). Tracks which design tapeout iteration this mask was manufactured from, enabling traceability to the GDS/GDSII submission.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM, Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: mask_set_name
attributes.description: Name of the mask set to which this photomask belongs. A mask set groups all reticles required to pattern a complete device layer stack for a given design tapeout.

attributes.name: mask_size_mm
attributes.description: Physical size of the photomask substrate in millimeters (e.g., 152mm for standard 6-inch reticle). Determines compatibility with the lithography scanner chuck and handling equipment.

attributes.name: mask_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the photomask asset. Active masks are available for production use; quarantined masks are held pending defect review; retired masks have exceeded usage limits or been superseded; scrapped masks have been physically destroyed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|quarantined|retired|in_inspection|pending_qualification|scrapped — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEMI E10, Oracle Agile PLM, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: mask_substrate_material
attributes.description: Material of the photomask substrate. Fused silica and quartz are standard for DUV masks; Low Thermal Expansion Material (LTEM) and Ultra-Low Expansion (ULE) glass are used for EUV masks to minimize thermal distortion.

attributes.name: mask_type
attributes.description: Physical mask type classification: binary (chrome-on-glass), attenuated phase-shifting mask (attPSM), alternating phase-shifting mask (altPSM), chromeless phase lithography (CPL), or EUV reflective mask. Determines optical proximity correction (OPC) strategy and imaging performance.

attributes.name: max_defect_limit
attributes.description: Specification-defined maximum number of defects permitted on the photomask before it must be quarantined or retired. Established during mask qualification per process node requirements.

attributes.name: max_usage_limit
attributes.description: Manufacturer- or process-qualified maximum number of exposure shots allowed before mandatory retirement or re-qualification of the photomask. Exceeding this limit triggers automatic quarantine in the MES.
attributes.references: SEMI P1, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES, ISO 9001

attributes.name: meef_value
attributes.description: Mask Error Enhancement Factor (MEEF) quantifying how mask CD (critical dimension) errors are amplified onto the wafer. A MEEF > 1 indicates that mask errors are magnified; used in process window analysis and mask specification setting.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which the next mandatory mask inspection must be completed, based on usage count thresholds or calendar-based inspection intervals defined in the mask management plan.
attributes.references: SEMI P1, ISO 9001, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: nre_cost_usd
attributes.description: Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) cost in USD associated with the design and manufacture of this photomask set. NRE costs are one-time charges incurred at tapeout and are tracked for product cost accounting and customer billing.

attributes.name: opc_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) recipe applied during mask data preparation. OPC compensates for diffraction effects in photolithography; version tracking ensures reproducibility and supports yield analysis.

attributes.name: pellicle_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protective pellicle membrane is currently mounted on the photomask. Pellicles protect the mask pattern from particle contamination during exposure. EUV masks use specialized EUV-transparent pellicles.

attributes.name: pellicle_type
attributes.description: Type of pellicle membrane mounted on the photomask. Standard pellicles are used for DUV masks; EUV pellicles are specialized thin-film membranes for EUV lithography. None indicates no pellicle is installed.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the photomask was formally qualified for production use following initial inspection and process verification. Marks the start of the active production lifecycle.
attributes.references: SEMI P1, ISO 9001, Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: registration_error_nm
attributes.description: Measured overlay registration error of the mask pattern in nanometers, indicating how accurately the mask features are positioned relative to the design intent. Critical for multi-layer overlay budget management.
attributes.references: SEMI P1, KLA ICOS Inspection Systems

attributes.name: reticle_pod_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Reticle Storage Pod (RSP) or reticle SMIF pod in which this photomask is currently housed. RSP tracking is critical for contamination prevention and automated mask library management.
attributes.references: SEMI E84, SEMI E1.9, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the photomask was retired from production use, either due to exceeding usage limits, excessive defect count, design obsolescence, or end-of-life (EOL) of the associated product. Nullable for active masks.
attributes.references: SEMI P1, Oracle Agile PLM, SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: scanner_model
attributes.description: Model identifier of the lithography scanner (stepper/scanner) for which this photomask is qualified (e.g., ASML NXT:2000i, ASML NXE:3600D). Masks are qualified to specific scanner models due to optical system compatibility.
attributes.references: SEMI P1, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: storage_humidity_pct
attributes.description: Required relative humidity percentage for photomask storage environment. Controlled humidity prevents electrostatic discharge damage and contamination on the mask substrate.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: Required storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this photomask. EUV masks and phase-shifting masks may have tighter temperature requirements to prevent pellicle degradation or substrate stress.

attributes.name: technology_node
attributes.description: Process technology node for which this photomask was designed (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm, 28nm). Determines compatibility with the Process Design Kit (PDK) and fabrication process.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of wafer exposure shots (uses) this photomask has undergone since manufacture or last qualification. Tracked by the MES to manage mask wear and schedule preventive inspection.
attributes.references: Applied Materials SmartFactory MES, Camstar MES, SEMI E10

products.name: storage_location
products.description: Master record for physical and logical storage locations within FAB cleanrooms, chemical warehouses, gas cabinets, die bank vaults, and OSAT partner facilities. Captures location code, location name, facility type (cleanroom/warehouse/cold-storage/gas-cabinet/nitrogen-cabinet/die-vault), building, bay, row, shelf, temperature range, humidity range, ESD protection class, nitrogen purge capability, hazmat classification, maximum capacity, current utilization, and location status (active/blocked/decommissioned). Enables precise inventory placement, environmental compliance tracking, and MSD floor life management.
products.reference: SAP MM Storage Location / Warehouse Management

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the storage location master record within the inventory management system. Primary key for the storage_location entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Storage Location (LGORT)

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Storage Location Management assigns a manager responsible for safety, access control, and inventory integrity, used in location audit reports.

attributes.name: access_restriction_level
attributes.description: Physical access control level for this storage location. unrestricted — open access; badge-access — requires valid facility badge; authorized-personnel — restricted to named personnel list (e.g., for ITAR-controlled materials); security-vault — highest security for KGD die banks, photomask vaults, and ITAR-controlled IP. Supports ITAR/EAR export control compliance.
attributes.references: ITAR — International Traffic in Arms Regulations; BIS/EAR — Export Administration Regulations; ISO 45001

attributes.name: bay
attributes.description: Bay designation within the building or cleanroom where this storage location is physically situated (e.g., 'BAY-03', 'A-WEST'). Used for precise physical navigation, equipment layout planning, and cleanroom zone management per SEMI E187.
attributes.references: SEMI E187 — Cleanroom Layout; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: building_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the physical building within the facility where this storage location resides (e.g., 'FAB1', 'CHEM-WH-B', 'OSAT-PKG-C'). Supports facility layout mapping, emergency response planning, and environmental zone management.
attributes.references: SEMI S2 — Facility Safety; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure used to express the maximum capacity and current utilization of this storage location. Varies by facility type: cassette (wafer storage), pod (photomask storage), tray (packaged chip storage), container (chemical storage), box (die bank storage), pallet (bulk warehouse storage).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Unit of Measure (MEINS); JEDEC JESD22 — Package Handling

attributes.name: cleanroom_iso_class
attributes.description: ISO 14644-1 cleanroom classification for this storage location, defining the maximum allowable airborne particulate concentration. Critical for wafer, photomask, and KGD die storage compliance. Applicable only to cleanroom facility types; null for non-cleanroom locations. Values: ISO-1 (cleanest) through ISO-6.
attributes.references: ISO 14644-1 — Cleanroom Classification; SEMI E187 — Semiconductor Cleanroom Standards

attributes.name: commissioned_date
attributes.description: Date on which this storage location was formally commissioned and made available for inventory use. Marks the start of the location's operational lifecycle. Used for asset age tracking, depreciation scheduling, and facility capacity planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Location Master; ISO 9001 — Quality Management Records

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where this storage location is physically situated (e.g., 'USA', 'TWN', 'KOR', 'JPN'). Critical for ITAR/EAR export control jurisdiction determination, REACH/RoHS regulatory applicability, and multi-national inventory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 — Country Codes; ITAR 22 CFR Part 120; BIS/EAR 15 CFR Part 734

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location master record was first created in the system (ISO 8601 format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for record provenance and data governance compliance per SOX and ISO 9001 quality management requirements.
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; ISO 9001 — Quality Management Records; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: current_utilization_units
attributes.description: Current number of inventory units occupying this storage location at the time of last inventory update. Compared against max_capacity_units to compute utilization percentage for capacity planning and inventory placement decisions. Updated by MES and SAP MM inventory movements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Stock Overview; Camstar MES — Lot Location Tracking

attributes.name: decommissioned_date
attributes.description: Date on which this storage location was permanently decommissioned and removed from active inventory use. Populated only when location_status is 'decommissioned'. Supports facility lifecycle management and historical inventory traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Location Master; ISO 9001 — Quality Management Records

attributes.name: esd_protection_class
attributes.description: ESD protection classification of this storage location per ANSI/ESD S20.20 and JEDEC JESD625 standards. Determines suitability for storing ESD-sensitive devices (ICs, dies, packaged chips). class-0 (most sensitive, <250V HBM) through class-3 (>2000V HBM); unprotected for non-ESD-controlled areas.
attributes.references: ANSI/ESD S20.20 — ESD Control Program; JEDEC JESD625 — ESD Sensitive Device Handling

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical facility type housing this storage location. Drives environmental compliance rules, MSD floor life management, and hazmat handling procedures. Valid values: cleanroom (ISO-classified FAB area), warehouse (general materials storage), cold-storage (temperature-controlled for chemicals/biologics), gas-cabinet (pressurized specialty gas storage), nitrogen-cabinet (nitrogen-purged dry storage for moisture-sensitive devices), die-vault (secure KGD die bank storage).
attributes.references: SEMI S2 — Environmental, Health & Safety Guideline; SEMI E187 — Cleanroom Classification

attributes.name: fire_suppression_type
attributes.description: Type of fire suppression system installed at this storage location. Critical for chemical warehouse and gas cabinet locations storing flammable or reactive materials. Drives emergency response planning and insurance compliance. Values: sprinkler, halon (legacy), fm200 (clean agent), co2, dry-powder, none.
attributes.references: SEMI S2 — Environmental, Health & Safety; ISO 14001 — Environmental Management; NFPA 318 — Cleanroom Fire Protection

attributes.name: geo_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the facility where this storage location resides. Used for multi-site supply chain mapping, emergency response planning, and regulatory jurisdiction determination for ITAR/EAR export control compliance.
attributes.references: WGS84 — World Geodetic System; BIS/EAR — Geographic Jurisdiction

attributes.name: geo_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the facility where this storage location resides. Used in conjunction with geo_latitude for multi-site supply chain mapping and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: WGS84 — World Geodetic System; BIS/EAR — Geographic Jurisdiction

attributes.name: hazmat_classification
attributes.description: UN/DOT hazardous materials classification code applicable to materials stored at this location (e.g., 'UN1170' for ethanol, 'UN2014' for hydrogen peroxide, 'FLAMMABLE-LIQUID', 'CORROSIVE', 'COMPRESSED-GAS', 'NON-HAZMAT'). Governs storage segregation, emergency response, and regulatory reporting under REACH, RoHS, and TSCA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: flammable-liquid|corrosive|compressed-gas|oxidizer|toxic|non-hazmat|pyrophoric — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU; TSCA — Toxic Substances Control Act; UN GHS — Globally Harmonized System

attributes.name: inventory_valuation_method
attributes.description: Inventory valuation method applied to stock held at this storage location for financial reporting purposes. standard-cost (used for WIP wafer lots), moving-average (raw materials), fifo (finished goods), fefo (shelf-life-managed chemicals). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA FI/CO valuation area configuration and SOX financial reporting requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Inventory Valuation; SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; IAS 2 — Inventories

attributes.name: is_osat_partner_location
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner Location Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is physically situated at an OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) partner facility rather than an internal company site. True for consignment stock locations at OSAT partners. Drives consignment inventory valuation, ownership tracking, and inter-company transfer accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Consignment Stock; JEDEC JESD31 — OSAT Inventory Management

tag_set.value: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner Location Flag

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is designated for ITAR-controlled materials, requiring strict access logging, personnel authorization, and regulatory reporting. True for locations storing defense-related ICs, ASIC designs, or photomasks subject to ITAR jurisdiction. Drives export control compliance workflows.
attributes.references: ITAR — 22 CFR Parts 120-130; BIS/EAR — 15 CFR Parts 730-774

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag

attributes.name: kgd_storage_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Known Good Die (KGD) Storage Certified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is certified for KGD (Known Good Die) die bank storage, meeting requirements for ESD protection, nitrogen purge, temperature/humidity control, and access security. KGD storage certification is required for high-value tested dies awaiting packaging or shipment.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD31 — KGD Storage Requirements; SEMI G42 — Die Bank Management

tag_set.value: Known Good Die (KGD) Storage Certified Flag

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent environmental and safety inspection conducted for this storage location. Used to track compliance with SEMI S2, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 periodic inspection requirements. Drives inspection scheduling and regulatory audit readiness.
attributes.references: SEMI S2 — Environmental, Health & Safety; ISO 14001 — Environmental Management; ISO 45001 — Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this storage location master record (ISO 8601 format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC), data synchronization between SAP S/4HANA and the Databricks Silver Layer, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; ISO 9001 — Quality Management Records; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the storage location, aligned with SAP S/4HANA MM storage location key (LGORT) and Camstar MES location identifiers. Used for lot traceability, WIP tracking, and inventory placement across FAB, warehouse, and OSAT partner facilities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Location Master; Camstar MES Location Management

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the storage location (e.g., 'Bay 3 Shelf 12 — EUV Photomask Vault', 'Cleanroom A Chemical Cabinet Row 5'). Used in operational reports, MES screens, and inventory placement instructions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Location Master; SEMI E10 Equipment Identification

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the storage location. 'active' — available for inventory placement; 'blocked' — temporarily unavailable due to maintenance, contamination, or audit hold; 'decommissioned' — permanently retired from use. Controls whether new inventory can be assigned to this location.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Location Status; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES Location State

attributes.name: max_capacity_units
attributes.description: Maximum number of inventory units (wafer cassettes, chemical containers, photomask pods, chip trays, or die boxes) that can be physically stored at this location. Used for capacity planning, inventory placement optimization, and utilization reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM — Storage Bin Capacity; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES Capacity Management

attributes.name: max_humidity_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable relative humidity percentage (0–100%) for this storage location. Exceedance above maximum triggers MSD floor life reset, inventory quarantine, and environmental non-conformance reporting per IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033.
attributes.references: IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033 — MSD Handling; SEMI E187 — Cleanroom Environmental Control

attributes.name: max_temperature_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this location. Defines the upper bound of the acceptable temperature range. Exceedance triggers inventory quarantine and environmental non-conformance reporting per ISO 14001 and SEMI C10 chemical storage guidelines.
attributes.references: IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033 — MSD Handling; SEMI C10 — Chemical Storage; ISO 14001

attributes.name: min_humidity_pct
attributes.description: Minimum allowable relative humidity percentage (0–100%) for this storage location. Critical for MSD floor life management, photomask storage, and chemical stability. Exceedance below minimum may cause ESD risk or material degradation.
attributes.references: IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033 — MSD Handling; SEMI E187 — Cleanroom Environmental Control

attributes.name: min_temperature_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this location. Defines the lower bound of the acceptable temperature range for stored materials (chemicals, photoresists, gases, packaged devices). Used for environmental compliance monitoring and MSD (Moisture Sensitive Device) floor life management per IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033.
attributes.references: IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033 — Moisture Sensitive Device Handling; SEMI C10 — Chemical Storage

attributes.name: msd_floor_life_capable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Moisture Sensitive Device (MSD) Floor Life Management Capable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is equipped and certified to manage MSD floor life tracking per IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033. True for nitrogen-purged cabinets, dry-storage cabinets, and controlled-humidity cleanroom locations. Enables automatic floor life clock suspension for stored MSDs.
attributes.references: IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033 — Handling, Packing, Shipping and Use of Moisture/Reflow Sensitive SMDs

tag_set.value: Moisture Sensitive Device (MSD) Floor Life Management Capable Flag

attributes.name: msd_sensitivity_level
attributes.description: Maximum Moisture Sensitivity Level (MSL) of devices that can be safely stored at this location per IPC/JEDEC J-STD-020. MSL-1 (unlimited floor life at ≤30°C/85%RH) through MSL-5 (most sensitive, 24-hour floor life). Determines which packaged semiconductor devices are eligible for placement at this location.
attributes.references: IPC/JEDEC J-STD-020 — Moisture/Reflow Sensitivity Classification; J-STD-033 — MSD Handling

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory environmental and safety inspection of this storage location. Automatically calculated based on inspection frequency requirements per SEMI S2 and ISO 14001. Triggers inspection work orders in the facility management system.
attributes.references: SEMI S2 — Environmental, Health & Safety; ISO 14001 — Environmental Management

attributes.name: nitrogen_purge_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is equipped with nitrogen purge capability to maintain an inert, moisture-free atmosphere. True for nitrogen-cabinet and die-vault locations used for long-term KGD die storage, photomask preservation, and moisture-sensitive chemical storage. Drives MSD floor life management decisions.
attributes.references: IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033 — MSD Handling; SEMI C10 — Chemical Storage Guidelines

attributes.name: osat_partner_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner Name
attributes.description: Name of the OSAT partner company at whose facility this storage location resides (e.g., 'ASE Group', 'Amkor Technology', 'JCET'). Populated only when is_osat_partner_location is True. Used for consignment stock management, partner performance reporting, and supply chain visibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master; Salesforce CRM — Partner Account

tag_set.value: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner Name

attributes.name: photomask_storage_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location meets the environmental and cleanliness requirements for photomask (reticle) storage, including ISO cleanroom class, nitrogen purge, and ESD protection. Photomasks are high-value assets used in EUV/DUV lithography and require specialized storage conditions.
attributes.references: SEMI P1 — Specification for Photomask Handling; SEMI E187 — Cleanroom Standards

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA plant identifier to which this storage location belongs. Represents the manufacturing or distribution facility (FAB, OSAT partner site, or warehouse) in the enterprise organizational hierarchy. Enables multi-plant inventory management and inter-plant transfer tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Plant (WERKS); SEMI E10 Facility Identification

attributes.name: row
attributes.description: Row designation within the bay for this storage location (e.g., 'R-12', 'ROW-A'). Provides granular physical addressing for inventory placement, pick-and-put-away operations, and automated storage/retrieval system (ASRS) integration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM — Warehouse Row; Camstar MES Location Hierarchy

attributes.name: shelf
attributes.description: Shelf or bin designation within the row for this storage location (e.g., 'S-04', 'BIN-002'). Lowest level of the physical location hierarchy, enabling precise inventory placement and retrieval for wafer cassettes, chemical containers, photomasks, and packaged chip trays.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM — Storage Bin; Camstar MES Bin Management

attributes.name: shelf_life_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether shelf life expiry tracking is enabled for materials stored at this location. True for chemical storage, photoresist storage, and gas cabinet locations where materials have defined shelf lives. Enables automated expiry alerts and FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Shelf Life Management (MHDRZ); SEMI C10 — Chemical Shelf Life

attributes.name: weight_capacity_kg
attributes.description: Maximum allowable total weight in kilograms for materials stored at this location. Critical for shelf structural integrity compliance, particularly for heavy chemical drums, gas cylinders, and bulk wafer cassette storage. Enforced per facility safety standards.
attributes.references: SEMI S2 — Environmental, Health & Safety Guideline; ISO 45001 — Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: wip_staging_area
attributes.business_glossary_term: Work in Process (WIP) Staging Area Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is designated as a WIP (Work in Process) staging area for wafer lots between process steps. True for inter-bay buffers, equipment load ports, and process queue areas within the FAB cleanroom. Enables WIP flow tracking and cycle time analysis in the MES.
attributes.references: Applied Materials SmartFactory MES — WIP Management; Camstar MES — Lot Tracking; SEMI E10 — Equipment Productivity

tag_set.value: Work in Process (WIP) Staging Area Flag

products.name: stock_balance
products.description: Transactional snapshot of on-hand inventory quantities by material, storage location, lot, and stock type (unrestricted, quality inspection, blocked, consignment). Captures quantity on hand, quantity available (unreserved), quantity reserved (linked to active inventory_reservation records), quantity in transit, quantity in WIP, unit of measure, last physical count date, and stock aging days. Supports real-time inventory visibility, ATP calculations, and production planning decisions. Financial valuation fields are maintained in stock_valuation.
products.reference: SAP MM Stock Overview (MMBE) / MRP Stock

attributes.name: stock_balance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each stock balance snapshot record in the inventory management system. Primary key for the stock_balance data product.

attributes.name: experimental_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.experimental_lot. Business justification: Tracks raw material consumption per experimental lot for cost accounting and yield analysis.

attributes.name: inventory_controller_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Stock Balance Reconciliation assigns a controller employee who validates periodic counts, supporting financial reporting and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: inventory_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production or procurement lot associated with this stock balance record. Enables full lot traceability from raw silicon wafer through WIP to finished packaged chip, as required by IATF 16949 and JEDEC traceability standards.
attributes.references: Camstar MES Lot Management; JEDEC JESD31

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility (FAB, OSAT partner site, assembly and test facility) where this stock balance is maintained.

attributes.name: primary_stock_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record representing the specific semiconductor material, component, or product (e.g., silicon wafer, photomask, packaged IC, chemical) for which this stock balance is recorded.

attributes.name: primary_stock_raw_material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.raw_material. Business justification: raw_material is a master for raw materials; linking stock_balance to raw_material via raw_material_id replaces generic material_master references and enables direct lookup of raw material attributes.

attributes.name: primary_storage_location_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.storage_location.storage_location_id — Stock balance is always held AT a specific storage location. This is a fundamental dimension of inventory position — you cannot have a meaningful stock balance without knowing WHERE the stock is. Day-

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: INVENTORY RECEIPT: Stock balance must be tied to the PO that supplied the material for traceability and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: secondary_raw_material_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.raw_material.raw_material_id — Stock balance for raw materials must reference the raw_material master record. This is the core master-transaction relationship for material inventory visibility.

attributes.name: stock_storage_location_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.storage_location.storage_location_id — Stock balance is always per-location. Without this FK, inventory visibility by location is impossible.

attributes.name: batch_classification
attributes.description: Quality grade classification of the wafer or material batch. 'prime' = meets all specifications for production; 'test' = test wafers used for process qualification; 'engineering' = engineering samples not for production; 'monitor' = process monitor wafers; 'reject' = failed quality inspection and not usable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Batch Classification; SEMI M1; IATF 16949

attributes.name: bin_classification
attributes.description: Die or wafer bin classification code assigned during wafer sort or final test, indicating the performance grade or speed bin of the die (e.g., 'BIN1_HIGH_PERF', 'BIN2_STD', 'BIN3_LOW_SPEED', 'REJECT'). Used for die bank management, customer order fulfillment by grade, and yield analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product as bin classifications vary by product family]
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD47; ATE Bin Classification Standards; SEMI E142

attributes.name: consignment_partner_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) partner or external consignee at whose facility this consignment stock is physically held. Populated only for stock_type = 'consignment'. Used for consignment reconciliation and OSAT partner performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Consignment Stock; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: export_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material is subject to export control regulations (True), including ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) or EAR (Export Administration Regulations) administered by BIS. Export-controlled inventory requires additional authorization before transfer to foreign nationals or shipment to controlled countries.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material is classified as hazardous (True) under applicable regulations (OSHA HazCom, REACH, TSCA, or DOT). Hazardous materials include certain process chemicals, gases (e.g., arsine, phosphine), and solvents used in semiconductor fabrication. Triggers special storage, handling, and disposal requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200; REACH Regulation; TSCA; ISO 14001

attributes.name: kgd_status
attributes.description: Indicates the Known Good Die (KGD) qualification status for die bank inventory. 'known_good' = die has passed all electrical and functional tests; 'failed' = die has failed one or more tests; 'untested' = die has not yet been tested; 'conditionally_good' = die passed with minor deviations within specification limits. Applicable only to die bank material types.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD47; SEMI G42; ATE Test Standards

attributes.name: last_goods_issue_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods issue (GI) posting for this material from this storage location. Used to identify dormant inventory, assess consumption velocity, and support slow-moving inventory analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Issue; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: last_goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods receipt (GR) posting for this material at this storage location. Used to calculate stock aging, assess replenishment lead times, and support FIFO/FEFO inventory consumption sequencing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count or cycle count performed for this material at this storage location. Used to assess inventory accuracy, schedule next count, and support SOX financial reporting requirements for inventory valuation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory; SOX Section 404; ISO 9001

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The human-readable lot or batch identifier assigned by the MES (Camstar or Applied Materials SmartFactory) for WIP wafer lots, or by the ERP for raw material and finished goods batches. Critical for traceability, yield analysis, and IATF 16949 compliance.
attributes.references: Camstar MES; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: msd_level
attributes.description: Moisture Sensitivity Level (MSL) classification per IPC/JEDEC J-STD-020 for packaged semiconductor devices and components. Determines floor life limits and baking requirements before reflow soldering. Applicable to finished goods and packaging inventory. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1|2|2a|3|4|5|5a|6 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: qty_available
attributes.description: Quantity of unrestricted stock that is not committed to any open reservation or production order. Represents the net available quantity for Available-to-Promise (ATP) calculations and new production planning decisions. Computed as unrestricted stock minus open reservations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM ATP; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: qty_blocked
attributes.description: Quantity of material placed in blocked stock due to quality rejection, ITAR/EAR export control restrictions, supplier non-conformance, or regulatory hold. Blocked stock is not available for production or shipment until formally released.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Blocked Stock; ITAR; EAR/BIS; ISO 9001

attributes.name: qty_in_transit
attributes.description: Quantity of material that has been shipped from a source location but has not yet been received at the destination location. Includes inter-plant transfers, OSAT shipments, and inbound supplier deliveries in transit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Stock Transfer; SEMI E10

attributes.name: qty_in_wip
attributes.description: Quantity of material currently consumed into active production orders and undergoing fabrication processing (e.g., wafer lots in FEOL/BEOL processing, die in packaging). Tracked by the MES and reflected in SAP PP WIP accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP WIP; Camstar MES; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; SEMI E10

attributes.name: qty_on_hand
attributes.description: Total physical quantity of the material present at the storage location across all stock types, expressed in the base unit of measure. Represents the gross inventory position before reservations or quality holds are considered.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Management; SEMI E10

attributes.name: qty_quality_inspection
attributes.description: Quantity of material currently held in SAP QM quality inspection stock, pending disposition decision (accept, reject, rework). Includes incoming inspection lots, in-process inspection holds, and post-process quality holds.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Inspection Lot; ISO 9001 Clause 8.6; IATF 16949

attributes.name: qty_reserved
attributes.description: Total quantity committed to active inventory reservations linked to open production orders, sales orders, or transfer orders. Corresponds to open inventory_reservation records and reduces the available quantity for new demand.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Reservations; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stock balance record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports audit trail requirements for SOX financial reporting and data governance lineage tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stock balance record was last updated in the lakehouse silver layer, reflecting the most recent refresh from the source system. Used for incremental load processing and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: reorder_point_qty
