attributes.description: The minimum on-hand quantity threshold at which a replenishment order should be triggered for this material at this storage location. Maintained in SAP MRP parameters and used by production planning to prevent stockouts of critical raw materials, chemicals, and gases.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: rohs_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material lot is compliant with the EU RoHS Directive (Restriction of Hazardous Substances), restricting the use of lead, mercury, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, PBB, and PBDE. Required for finished goods destined for EU markets and tracked per Oracle Agile PLM compliance records.
attributes.references: EU RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU; Oracle Agile PLM; REACH Regulation

attributes.name: safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: Buffer stock quantity maintained above the reorder point to protect against demand variability and supply lead time uncertainty. Defined in SAP MRP safety stock parameters. Critical for high-value materials like EUV photomasks and specialty process gases with long procurement lead times.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Safety Stock; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: shelf_life_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the material's shelf life expires and it becomes unusable for production. Applicable to chemicals, photoresists, gases, and certain packaging materials. Enforced by SAP batch management shelf-life expiration date (SLED) functionality. Materials past this date must be quarantined and disposed per REACH and RoHS regulations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management SLED; REACH Regulation; RoHS Directive; SEMI C-series Standards

attributes.name: slow_moving_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stock balance has been flagged as slow-moving (True) based on the stock_aging_days exceeding the material-specific slow-moving threshold. Used for inventory write-down risk assessment, EOL (End of Life) planning, and LTB (Last Time Buy) decision support.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Analysis; APICS CPIM; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal business event timestamp indicating when this stock balance snapshot was captured from the source system (SAP MM or MES). Represents the point-in-time inventory position and is the primary temporal key for real-time inventory visibility and ATP calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Management; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this stock balance record was sourced. Enables data lineage tracking and reconciliation across SAP MM, Camstar MES, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES, and Oracle Agile PLM in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance; GDPR Article 30; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: SAP special stock indicator identifying non-standard stock ownership or custody arrangements. 'E' = sales order stock; 'K' = consignment stock at customer; 'Q' = project stock; 'W' = consignment stock from vendor; 'O' = stock at subcontractor (OSAT). Empty value indicates standard own stock.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Special Stock; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: stock_aging_days
attributes.description: Number of days the current on-hand stock has been held at this storage location since the oldest receipt date. Used for slow-moving inventory identification, shelf-life monitoring, and obsolescence risk assessment. Critical for chemicals, gases, and photoresists with defined shelf lives.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Aging; SEMI Standards; RoHS Directive

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: SAP stock category indicating the usability status of the inventory. 'unrestricted' is available for production or shipment; 'quality_inspection' is under QM hold pending disposition; 'blocked' is rejected or quarantined; 'consignment' is held at OSAT partner sites; 'restricted' is subject to export control or ITAR/EAR restrictions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Stock Types; ITAR; EAR/BIS

attributes.name: storage_condition_code
attributes.description: Required storage environment classification for this material. Drives warehouse management system (WMS) slotting and compliance with SEMI, REACH, and OSHA storage requirements. 'nitrogen_purge' for moisture-sensitive devices (MSD); 'cold_storage' for temperature-sensitive chemicals; 'cleanroom_class1/10' for wafers and photomasks; 'hazmat' for regulated chemicals.
attributes.references: SEMI E187; REACH Regulation; IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033 MSD Handling; ISO 14001

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for all quantity fields on this stock balance record. 'EA' = each (packaged chips), 'WFR' = wafer, 'LOT' = wafer lot, 'KG' = kilogram (chemicals), 'L' = liter (liquid chemicals/gases), 'M2' = square meter (substrate), 'MASK' = photomask, 'DIE' = individual die. Aligned with SAP base UoM configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|WFR|LOT|KG|L|M2|MASK|DIE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; SEMI Standards; ISO 80000

attributes.name: unrestricted_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stock balance record represents inventory that is fully available for unrestricted use in production or shipment (True), or whether it is subject to any hold, restriction, or quality disposition (False). Derived from stock_type but maintained as an explicit flag for rapid ATP query performance.

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: SAP valuation class code that determines the general ledger (GL) accounts to which inventory postings are made for this material. Links inventory movements to the correct balance sheet accounts for financial reporting. Detailed financial valuation fields are maintained in the stock_valuation data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Valuation Class; SOX Section 404; GAAP/IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: wafer_process_node
attributes.description: The semiconductor process technology node at which the wafer lot or die was fabricated (e.g., '7nm', '14nm', '28nm', '180nm'). Critical for inventory segregation, process compatibility checks, and customer design-in alignment.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards; ITRS/IRDS Roadmap; PDK Specifications

products.name: goods_movement
products.description: Transactional record for every inventory movement event: goods receipts from suppliers, goods issues to production, inter-location transfers, scrap disposals, returns, and posting reversals. Captures movement type, date, material, quantity, UoM, source/destination locations, reference document (PO/production order/delivery note), posting date, and document number. Provides the complete inventory audit trail required for SOX Section 404 controls, IATF 16949 traceability, and real-time stock balance updates.
products.reference: SAP MM Goods Movement (MIGO) / Material Document

attributes.name: goods_movement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the goods movement transaction. Primary key for the goods movement record.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer for goods issue transactions related to sales orders or consignment stock transfers. Links to customer master for finished goods shipments.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost center on each goods movement is needed for accurate cost allocation in financial statements.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who executed the goods movement transaction. Used for SOX Section 404 audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls, SAP S/4HANA Security

attributes.name: export_license_usage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.export_license_usage. Business justification: Each goods movement (shipment) must record the specific export license usage to satisfy license utilization reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: GL account on movement ties inventory transactions to the general ledger for audit‑ready posting.

attributes.name: goods_stock_balance_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.stock_balance.stock_balance_id — Goods movements update stock balances — the transactional movement must reference the balance it affects for real-time inventory accuracy.

attributes.name: goods_storage_location_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.storage_location.storage_location_id — Every goods movement must reference destination location for receiving and placement.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order. Business justification: REQUIRED: Financial and logistics reporting ties inventory movements to the originating sales order for cost of goods sold and compliance.

attributes.name: primary_goods_material_master_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the material being moved. References the material master record for silicon wafers, chemicals, gases, photomasks, packaged chips, or die banks.

attributes.name: primary_goods_stock_balance_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.stock_balance.stock_balance_id — Every goods movement posting updates the stock balance. This is the fundamental inventory equation: stock_balance = sum(goods_movements). Critical for reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: primary_goods_storage_location_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.storage_location.storage_location_id — Every goods movement must reference source location for audit trail and inventory reconciliation.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: LOGISTICS: Each goods movement (receipt/shipment) is driven by a PO; linking supports audit, costing, and on‑time delivery metrics.

attributes.name: research_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Links material movements to a research project, required for the Project Material Movement Log.

attributes.name: source_storage_location_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.storage_location.storage_location_id — Every goods movement has a source location (for issues, transfers) or destination location (for receipts). Location reference is mandatory for movement posting and audit trail.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier for goods receipt transactions. Links to vendor master for silicon wafer suppliers, chemical vendors, gas suppliers, or OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) partners.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number for batch-managed materials such as chemicals, gases, or raw wafers. Distinct from wafer lot number; used for supplier batch traceability and shelf-life management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Batch Management, REACH Regulation - Chemical Traceability

attributes.name: bin_classification
attributes.description: Quality bin or grade classification for die or wafer inventory: Bin 1 (prime), Bin 2 (downgrade), Bin 3 (scrap), or custom bin codes. Used for Known Good Die (KGD) status tracking and yield analysis.
attributes.references: SEMI E142 - Substrate Tracking, JEDEC Standards - Die Quality Classification

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the valuation amount. Typically company currency (USD, EUR, JPY, etc.) for inventory accounting.

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: Delivery note or packing slip number from the supplier or shipping carrier. Used for goods receipt matching and three-way match (PO, goods receipt, invoice) reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Goods Receipt, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: destination_plant_code
attributes.description: Plant or FAB site code where the material was moved to. Used for inter-plant transfers and multi-site inventory tracking. Critical for global supply chain visibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Plant Master, SEMI E120 - Lot Traceability

attributes.name: destination_storage_location
attributes.description: Storage location code where the material was moved to. Represents warehouse, stockroom, or FAB storage area. Empty for goods issues to external customers or scrap.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Storage Location Master

attributes.name: document_line_item
attributes.description: Line item number within the material document. Supports multi-line goods movement documents where multiple materials or lots are moved in a single transaction.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Unique material document number generated by the ERP system for this goods movement. Primary business identifier for the transaction, used for audit trail and reversal references.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Wafer lot or batch identifier for Work in Process (WIP) inventory. Critical for lot traceability and IATF 16949 compliance. Tracks wafer lots through fabrication, die banks, and packaging.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Automotive Quality Management, SEMI E120 - Lot Traceability

attributes.name: movement_date
attributes.description: Date when the physical goods movement occurred. Business event date for inventory transaction, distinct from posting date. Critical for SOX Section 404 audit trail and inventory valuation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls, SAP S/4HANA MM - Goods Movement

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory movement transaction: goods receipt from supplier, goods issue to production, inter-location transfer, scrap disposal, return from production, or posting reversal. Aligns with SAP MM movement type codes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Material Movement Types

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the goods movement transaction. Used for documenting special handling instructions, quality issues, or operational exceptions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Material Document Text

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the goods movement was posted to the financial ledger. Used for period-end closing and financial reporting. May differ from movement date for backdated or delayed postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Financial Accounting, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: production_order_number
attributes.description: Production order number for goods issues to manufacturing or goods receipts from production. Links inventory movements to wafer fabrication, die packaging, or assembly operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Production Order, SEMI E120 - Lot Traceability

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material moved in this transaction. Positive for receipts and transfers-in, negative for issues and transfers-out. Precision supports wafer counts, die counts, and chemical volumes.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the business reason for the goods movement: quality hold, scrap due to defect, return to vendor, obsolescence, cycle count adjustment, or other operational reason. Required for scrap and adjustment transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Reason Codes, IATF 16949 - Nonconforming Product Control

attributes.name: reference_document_line_item
attributes.description: Line item number within the reference document. Provides precise linkage to the specific line of the purchase order, production order, or delivery note.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: Number of the source document that triggered this goods movement. Links to purchase order, production order, delivery note, or other originating transaction for full traceability.

attributes.name: reference_document_type
attributes.description: Type of source document that triggered this goods movement: purchase order (PO) for receipts, production order for manufacturing issues/receipts, delivery note for shipments, transfer order for inter-location moves, sales order for customer shipments, or reservation for planned consumption.

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Material reservation number for planned goods issues. Links to production order or maintenance order reservations for material requirements planning (MRP) and allocation.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this goods movement is a reversal of a previous transaction. True for cancellation or correction postings. Used for audit trail and error correction tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Goods Movement Reversal, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Material document number of the original transaction being reversed. Populated only when reversal_indicator is true. Provides linkage for audit trail and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Goods Movement Reversal, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number for serialized inventory items such as high-value equipment parts or Known Good Die (KGD) units. Enables unit-level traceability for critical components.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Serial Number Management, IATF 16949 - Product Identification

attributes.name: shelf_life_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date for time-sensitive materials such as photoresists, chemicals, or adhesives. Used for shelf-life management and FIFO (First In First Out) inventory control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Shelf Life Management, REACH Regulation - Chemical Safety

attributes.name: source_plant_code
attributes.description: Plant or FAB site code where the material originated. Used for inter-plant transfers and multi-site inventory tracking. Aligns with SEMI E120 traceability requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Plant Master, SEMI E120 - Lot Traceability

attributes.name: source_storage_location
attributes.description: Storage location code where the material was moved from. Represents warehouse, stockroom, or FAB storage area. Empty for goods receipts from external suppliers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Storage Location Master

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator for special stock types: consignment stock at OSAT partners, project-specific stock, sales order allocated stock, returnable packaging, or pipeline inventory. Affects ownership and valuation rules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Special Stock Management

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Stock status classification: unrestricted (available for use), quality inspection (pending QA release), blocked (quality hold or obsolete), or restricted use (conditional release). Determines material availability for production and sales.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Stock Types, IATF 16949 - Control of Nonconforming Product

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the goods movement transaction was recorded in the system. Used for audit trail, sequence verification, and real-time inventory updates.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls, ISO 8601 - Date and Time Format

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the movement quantity: wafers (EA), dies (PC), liters (L), kilograms (KG), or other standard units. Aligns with ISO 80000 quantity standards.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 - Quantities and Units, SAP S/4HANA MM - Units of Measure

attributes.name: valuation_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the goods movement in company currency. Calculated as quantity multiplied by material standard cost or moving average price. Used for inventory valuation and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Material Valuation, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: work_center
attributes.description: Work center or production resource where the material was issued or received. Identifies specific FAB equipment, packaging line, or assembly station for process traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Work Center Master, SEMI E120 - Equipment Traceability

products.name: inventory_lot_hold
products.description: Transactional record capturing hold events placed on wafer lots or finished goods inventory. Tracks hold ID, lot reference, hold type (engineering/quality/customer/export-control), hold reason code, hold initiator, hold date, release date, release authority, hold disposition (rework/scrap/release/return), and associated quality notification or FMEA reference. Critical for quality management and regulatory compliance workflows.
products.reference: SAP QM Quality Notification / Camstar MES Hold

attributes.name: inventory_lot_hold_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory lot hold record. Primary key for the inventory lot hold transaction.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer associated with the lot under hold. Applicable for customer-specific holds or customer-requested holds.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.ar_invoice. Business justification: Hold Management may place a regulatory hold due to an unpaid invoice; linking the hold to that invoice enables audit and release workflow.

attributes.name: capa_record_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the corrective action plan or CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) record associated with this hold. Links the hold to the formal corrective action process.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing equipment or tool associated with the hold. Links the hold to the specific machine or tool that processed the lot before the hold was placed.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_step_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing process step where the hold was triggered. References the specific operation or stage in the fabrication flow (e.g., lithography, etch, CMP).

attributes.name: fmea_record_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Reference ID
attributes.description: Reference to the FMEA document or record associated with this hold. Links the hold to the failure mode analysis that identified the risk or defect mode.

tag_set.value: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Reference ID

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.ic_design_project. Business justification: Lot‑hold decisions are often triggered by design‑specific issues; linking hold records to the project enables root‑cause analysis.

attributes.name: inventory_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the wafer lot or finished goods lot subject to this hold. References the inventory lot under hold restriction.

attributes.name: primary_inventory_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the person or system that initiated the hold. References employee ID or automated system identifier responsible for placing the hold.

attributes.name: quality_notification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated quality notification or non-conformance report. Links the hold to the formal quality management record (e.g., SAP QM notification number).

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product or device type associated with the lot under hold. References the IC design, SoC, or ASIC product code.

attributes.name: trade_compliance_hold_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.trade_compliance_hold. Business justification: Lot holds often stem from trade compliance issues; linking hold records to the underlying trade compliance hold provides traceability for release decisions.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing work order or production order associated with the lot under hold. Links the hold to the specific production run or batch.

attributes.name: containment_action
attributes.description: Description of the immediate containment action taken to prevent further impact. Details the steps taken to isolate the affected lot and prevent similar issues in other lots.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hold record was first created in the system. Audit trail timestamp for record creation.

attributes.name: defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects detected that triggered the hold. Represents the count of non-conformances or defects identified during inspection or testing.

attributes.name: die_quantity
attributes.description: Total number of die (individual chips) in the lot subject to this hold. Applicable for finished goods or die bank inventory holds.

attributes.name: dppm_value
attributes.description: Calculated defect rate in parts per million for the lot under hold. Quality metric indicating the severity of the defect condition.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification code for the lot under hold. Indicates the regulatory classification under EAR (Export Administration Regulations) or ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations). Used for export-control holds.
attributes.references: EAR (Export Administration Regulations), ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations)

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility or site where the lot was processed. Indicates the manufacturing location associated with the hold.

attributes.name: hold_comments
attributes.description: Additional free-text comments or notes related to the hold. Provides supplementary information, investigation findings, or disposition rationale.

attributes.name: hold_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the hold was placed on the lot. Represents the principal business event timestamp when the lot became restricted from further processing or shipment.

attributes.name: hold_disposition
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the lot after hold investigation. Indicates the action taken: rework (reprocess the lot), scrap (discard the lot), release (approve for continued flow), return (send back to supplier or customer), quarantine (extended hold pending further review), or retest (re-inspect or re-qualify).

attributes.name: hold_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the hold automatically expires if not explicitly released. Null if no expiration is set. Used for time-limited holds that auto-release after a defined period.

attributes.name: hold_initiator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the person or system that initiated the hold. Provides human-readable identification of the hold originator.

attributes.name: hold_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the hold event. Externally-known unique code assigned to this hold transaction for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: hold_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the hold. Indicates the urgency and business impact of the hold (critical for safety or regulatory issues, high for customer impact, medium for process improvement, low for administrative holds).

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the specific reason for the hold. Maps to internal quality management or MES reason code taxonomy (e.g., DEFECT_EXCURSION, SPC_VIOLATION, CUSTOMER_RETURN, ITAR_REVIEW).

attributes.name: hold_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text explanation of the hold reason. Provides context and specifics beyond the hold reason code, including root cause details, defect description, or customer complaint reference.

attributes.name: hold_release_authority_name
attributes.description: Full name of the person or system that released the hold. Provides human-readable identification of the release authority.

attributes.name: hold_release_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the hold was released or lifted. Null if the hold is still active. Marks the point when the lot was cleared for continued processing or shipment.

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the hold. Indicates whether the hold is currently active (lot is restricted), released (hold lifted and lot available), expired (hold auto-released after time limit), or cancelled (hold invalidated).

attributes.name: hold_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hold event. Indicates the functional area or business reason category that triggered the hold (engineering investigation, quality issue, customer request, export control compliance, process deviation, equipment failure, or material defect). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: engineering|quality|customer|export_control|process|equipment|material — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_regulatory_hold
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the hold is mandated by regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., export control, environmental, safety). True if the hold is regulatory-driven, false otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hold record was last updated. Audit trail timestamp for record modification.

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the identified root cause of the issue that triggered the hold. Maps to internal root cause taxonomy (e.g., MATERIAL_DEFECT, PROCESS_DRIFT, EQUIPMENT_FAILURE, OPERATOR_ERROR).

attributes.name: wafer_quantity
attributes.description: Number of wafers in the lot subject to this hold. Represents the count of silicon wafers affected by the hold restriction.

products.name: physical_inventory
products.description: Transactional record of physical inventory count events including cycle counts, annual wall-to-wall counts, and triggered counts (post-movement discrepancy or system exception). Captures count document number, count date, material/lot reference, storage location, system book quantity, physically counted quantity, variance quantity, variance value, count status (planned/in-progress/completed/posted), recount flag, counter ID, supervisor approval, and posting date. Supports SOX Section 404 financial controls, IATF 16949 inventory accuracy requirements, and ISO 9001 documented evidence of stock verification.

attributes.name: physical_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical inventory count event record.

attributes.name: physical_storage_location_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.storage_location.storage_location_id — Physical counts are performed AT specific storage locations. Location is a mandatory dimension for count execution and variance analysis.

attributes.name: primary_physical_counter_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the person who performed the physical count, ensuring accountability and traceability per ISO 9001 requirements.

attributes.name: primary_storage_location_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.storage_location.storage_location_id — Physical counts are always performed at a specific location. Required for SOX audit trail.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the supervisor approved the physical count results, authorizing variance posting to the system.

attributes.name: bin_classification
attributes.description: Bin classification code for die or chip inventory, categorizing units by electrical test performance (e.g., Bin 1 for prime Known Good Die (KGD), Bin 2-9 for various performance grades or defects).

attributes.name: book_quantity
attributes.description: System-recorded inventory quantity (book quantity) at the time of the physical count, representing the expected quantity per ERP records.

attributes.name: consignment_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether this inventory is consignment stock held at an OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) partner or customer location, owned by the company but physically located off-site.

attributes.name: consignment_partner_code
attributes.description: Vendor or partner code identifying the OSAT partner or customer location where consignment inventory is held.

attributes.name: count_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the physical count activity was completed and submitted for review.

attributes.name: count_date
attributes.description: The date on which the physical inventory count was performed or is scheduled to be performed.

attributes.name: count_document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique document number assigned to this physical inventory count event for traceability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: count_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the counter or supervisor regarding count conditions, discrepancies observed, damaged goods, or other relevant observations.

attributes.name: count_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the physical count activity began for this inventory event.

attributes.name: count_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the physical inventory count event: planned (scheduled but not started), in-progress (counting underway), completed (count finished awaiting approval), posted (variance posted to system), cancelled, or on-hold.

attributes.name: count_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical inventory count event: cycle count (periodic rotation), annual wall-to-wall (full facility), triggered count (post-movement discrepancy or system exception), spot check, variance recount, or regulatory audit.

attributes.name: counted_quantity
attributes.description: Physically counted quantity recorded by the counter during the inventory count event.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this physical inventory count record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year when the count was performed, supporting periodic financial close and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the physical inventory count was performed, supporting annual financial reporting and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: freeze_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether inventory movements were frozen (blocked) during the count period to ensure accuracy and prevent discrepancies.

attributes.name: inventory_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the inventory being counted: raw material (silicon wafers, chemicals, gases, photomasks), WIP (Work in Process wafer lots), finished goods (packaged chips), die bank, consignment stock, or spare parts.

attributes.name: kgd_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the die or chip inventory has been verified as Known Good Die (KGD) through electrical testing, is non-KGD (failed test), untested, or in quarantine pending test results.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this physical inventory count record was last updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Lot or batch identifier for WIP wafer lots, die banks, or consignment stock being counted, enabling full traceability per IATF 16949 requirements.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material being counted: raw materials (silicon wafers, chemicals, gases, photomasks), Work in Process (WIP) wafer lots, finished goods (packaged chips), or die bank inventory.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the manufacturing plant or facility where the physical count was performed.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the inventory variance was posted to the financial and inventory management system, adjusting book quantities and valuations.

attributes.name: recount_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether this count is a recount of a previously counted item due to variance exceeding tolerance thresholds or supervisor request.

attributes.name: recount_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for why a recount was triggered: variance exceeds threshold, supervisor request, system discrepancy, damaged goods, quality hold, or initial count error.

attributes.name: shelf_life_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date for materials with limited shelf life (chemicals, photoresists, gases, adhesives), beyond which the material may not meet specification and must be disposed or retested.

attributes.name: standard_cost_usd
attributes.description: Standard cost per unit of the material at the time of count, used for variance valuation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: storage_condition_code
attributes.description: Code indicating required storage conditions for the material: ambient, controlled temperature, controlled humidity, nitrogen purge (for moisture-sensitive devices), vacuum, or cleanroom environment.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the counted quantity: EA (each for wafers or chips), KG (kilograms for chemicals), L (liters for gases or liquids), or other standard UOM codes.

attributes.name: variance_exceeds_tolerance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether the calculated variance exceeds the defined tolerance threshold, requiring investigation or recount per quality management procedures.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: Calculated difference between counted quantity and book quantity (counted minus book), representing inventory discrepancy. Positive values indicate surplus, negative values indicate shortage.

attributes.name: variance_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: Acceptable variance tolerance percentage for this count event, beyond which a recount or investigation is triggered. Typically set per material category and value class.

attributes.name: variance_value_usd
attributes.description: Financial value of the inventory variance in US dollars, calculated as variance quantity multiplied by standard cost or moving average price. Critical for SOX Section 404 financial controls and inventory valuation accuracy.

products.name: consignment_stock
products.description: Master record for inventory consigned to OSAT assembly/test partners or customer vendor-managed inventory (VMI) hubs where ownership transfers upon consumption or shipment. Tracks consignment agreement ID, OSAT partner reference, material/die bank reference, consigned quantity, consumed quantity, returned quantity, in-transit quantity, ownership transfer trigger (consumption/shipment/time-based), valuation currency, reconciliation frequency (weekly/monthly), last reconciliation date, settlement document reference, and liability aging. Enables monthly consignment settlement with OSAT partners, VMI replenishment automation, and accurate liability reporting for finance.
products.reference: SAP MM Consignment Stock / OSAT VMI

attributes.name: consignment_stock_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the consignment stock record. Primary key.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.ar_invoice. Business justification: Consignment Billing Report ties each consignment stock record to the customer invoice that records consumption for revenue and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: consignment_agreement_id
attributes.description: Business identifier for the consignment agreement governing this stock arrangement between the semiconductor company and the OSAT partner or VMI hub.

attributes.name: consignment_die_bank_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.die_bank.die_bank_id — Consignment stock at OSAT partners frequently consists of die bank inventory (KGD dies sent for packaging). This is a primary use case in fabless semiconductor model.

attributes.name: consignment_storage_location_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.storage_location.storage_location_id — Consignment stock is held at specific OSAT partner locations. Required for consignment reconciliation and liability tracking.

attributes.name: inventory_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating wafer lot for traceability of consigned die or finished goods.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or die bank being consigned (finished goods, die banks, or raw materials).

attributes.name: osat_vendor_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner ID
attributes.description: Reference to the OSAT partner or customer VMI hub where the consignment stock is physically located.

tag_set.value: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner ID

attributes.name: primary_consignment_die_bank_id
attributes.description: Reference to the die bank if the consignment stock consists of Known Good Die (KGD) awaiting packaging.

attributes.name: primary_consignment_storage_location_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.storage_location.storage_location_id — Consignment stock must reference the OSAT/partner storage location for reconciliation and ownership transfer.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: CONSIGNMENT: Consigned inventory is owned by a supplier; the FK identifies the responsible supplier for liability and settlement.

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of consigned material currently available at the OSAT partner location for consumption.

attributes.name: bin_location
attributes.description: Specific bin or rack location within the OSAT partner warehouse where the consignment stock is stored.

attributes.name: consigned_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of material consigned to the OSAT partner or VMI hub under this agreement.

attributes.name: consignment_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the consignment agreement expires or when the material must be consumed, returned, or settled.

attributes.name: consignment_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the material was first consigned to the OSAT partner or VMI hub under this agreement.

attributes.name: consignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consignment stock record.

attributes.name: consignment_type
attributes.description: Type of consignment arrangement: OSAT assembly, OSAT test, vendor-managed inventory hub, or customer consignment.

attributes.name: consumed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of consigned material that has been consumed or used by the OSAT partner, triggering ownership transfer.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the consigned material was manufactured or substantially transformed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this consignment stock record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for valuation and settlement amounts.

attributes.name: eccn_number
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number assigned to the consigned material under US Export Administration Regulations.

attributes.name: in_transit_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of consigned material currently in transit to or from the OSAT partner or VMI hub.

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consigned material is subject to ITAR export control regulations.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled

attributes.name: kgd_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consigned die or material has been tested and certified as Known Good Die.

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent consignment stock reconciliation between the semiconductor company and the OSAT partner.

attributes.name: last_settlement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent financial settlement for consumed consignment stock with the OSAT partner.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this consignment stock record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: liability_aging_days
attributes.description: Number of days the consignment stock has been at the OSAT partner location, used for aging analysis and liability reporting.

attributes.name: lot_traceability_code
attributes.description: Traceability code linking the consigned material to its manufacturing lot, wafer lot, and production history for quality and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: msd_level
attributes.description: JEDEC moisture sensitivity level classification for the consigned material, indicating required storage and handling conditions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1|2|2a|3|4|5|5a|6 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: next_reconciliation_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next consignment stock reconciliation based on the reconciliation frequency.

attributes.name: ownership_transfer_trigger
attributes.description: Event that triggers ownership transfer from the semiconductor company to the OSAT partner: consumption, shipment, time-based, or withdrawal.

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consigned material complies with EU REACH regulation for chemical substance safety.

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant

attributes.name: reconciliation_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which consignment stock levels are reconciled between the semiconductor company and the OSAT partner.

attributes.name: returned_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of consigned material returned to the semiconductor company from the OSAT partner or VMI hub.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consigned material complies with EU RoHS directive restricting hazardous substances in electronic equipment.

attributes.name: settlement_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the most recent settlement document or invoice generated for consumed consignment stock.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the consigned material can be stored before it must be used or returned, applicable to moisture-sensitive devices.

attributes.name: shelf_life_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the consigned material reaches the end of its shelf life and must be consumed, returned, or scrapped.

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Stock keeping unit code for the consigned material, used for inventory tracking and identification.

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Standard unit cost of the consigned material used for inventory valuation and settlement calculations.

attributes.name: storage_humidity_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum relative humidity percentage allowed for storage of the consigned material at the OSAT partner location.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum storage temperature in degrees Celsius required for the consigned material at the OSAT partner location.

attributes.name: total_valuation_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the consigned stock at the OSAT partner location, calculated as available quantity times standard cost.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the consigned material quantities (each, piece, kilogram, wafer, die, etc.). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|LB|M|FT|L|GAL|WAFER|DIE — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: stock_valuation
products.description: Transactional record capturing the financial valuation of inventory positions including WIP wafer lots, raw materials, die banks, and finished goods. Tracks valuation date, material or lot reference, valuation class, valuation method (standard cost/moving average/FIFO), standard price, moving average price, total stock value, WIP cost accumulation, NRE cost allocation, currency, and cost center. Supports SAP CO-PC product costing and SOX financial reporting.
products.reference: SAP CO-PC Product Cost / MM Valuation

attributes.name: stock_valuation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for stock_valuation

attributes.name: channel_partner_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner ID
attributes.description: Reference to the OSAT partner where consignment inventory is held for packaging and test operations.

tag_set.value: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner ID

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Links each stock valuation record to the cost center that bears the inventory cost for reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Associates valuation entries with a GL account to post inventory value changes to the ledger.

attributes.name: primary_stock_balance_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.stock_balance.stock_balance_id — Financial valuation must reference the quantity position it values. Links financial and physical inventory views.

attributes.name: primary_stock_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record being valued (raw material, WIP wafer lot, die bank, or finished good).

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Supports profit‑center‑level inventory valuation for margin analysis across product lines.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.storage_location. Business justification: stock_valuation tracks valuation per location using a code; a FK to storage_location provides referential integrity and eliminates duplicate location data.

attributes.name: bin_classification
attributes.description: The test bin classification code indicating the quality grade and performance characteristics of the die or packaged chip.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center responsible for the inventory and its associated costs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inventory valuation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this valuation record.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year for this valuation record.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this valuation record belongs, supporting period-based financial reporting.

attributes.name: inventory_category
attributes.description: The category of inventory being valued: raw material (silicon wafers, chemicals, gases, photomasks), WIP (Work In Process) wafer lots, die bank, finished goods (packaged chips), consignment stock at OSAT partners, or MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle.
attributes.references: SEMI Standards, SAP MM Material Type

attributes.name: is_consignment

attributes.name: shelf_life_expiry_date

attributes.name: sox_control_flag

attributes.name: standard_price

attributes.name: total_stock_value
attributes.description: The total financial value of the inventory position (quantity × unit price), representing the balance sheet valuation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: valuation_class

attributes.name: valuation_date

attributes.name: valuation_method

attributes.name: valuation_status
attributes.description: The current status of the inventory valuation: active (available for use), blocked (restricted), quality hold (pending inspection), obsolete (end of life), or scrapped.

attributes.name: valuation_type

attributes.name: valuation_variance

attributes.name: yield_impact_factor

products.name: inventory_kgd_certification
products.description: Transactional record documenting the Known Good Die (KGD) certification status for die bank inventory. Captures certification ID, die bank reference, wafer lot origin, test program version, probe yield percentage, bin distribution, electrical test pass rate, burn-in test result, reliability screen result, certification date, certifying engineer, certification expiry date, and KGD grade. Drives die allocation for advanced packaging (CoWoS, InFO, TSV) and direct die shipments.

attributes.name: inventory_kgd_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the KGD certification record. Primary key for the certification transaction.

attributes.name: die_bank_id

attributes.name: inventory_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating wafer lot from which the die bank was created. Provides full upstream traceability to fabrication.

attributes.name: primary_inventory_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality engineer who performed the certification and signed off on the KGD status. Provides accountability and traceability.

attributes.name: probe_card_id

attributes.references: SEMI E30 - Generic Model for Communications and Control of Manufacturing Equipment (GEM)

attributes.name: ate_equipment_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) used for electrical testing. Enables equipment-specific yield analysis and calibration tracking.
attributes.references: SEMI E30 - Generic Model for Communications and Control of Manufacturing Equipment (GEM)

attributes.name: bin_1_count
attributes.description: Number of die classified as Bin 1 (highest quality, full specification pass). Prime die suitable for all applications.
attributes.references: SEMI E142 - Specification for Substrate Tracking

attributes.name: bin_2_count
attributes.description: Number of die classified as Bin 2 (good quality with minor parametric variations). Suitable for most applications.
attributes.references: SEMI E142 - Specification for Substrate Tracking

attributes.name: bin_3_count
attributes.description: Number of die classified as Bin 3 (acceptable quality with reduced specifications). May be suitable for specific applications or downgraded products.
attributes.references: SEMI E142 - Specification for Substrate Tracking

attributes.name: burn_in_duration_hours

attributes.name: burn_in_temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius at which burn-in testing was performed. Typical values are 125°C or 150°C.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD22-A108 - Temperature, Bias, and Operating Life

attributes.name: burn_in_test_result
attributes.description: Result of high-temperature operating life (HTOL) burn-in stress testing. Identifies early-life failures and ensures reliability.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD22-A108 - Temperature, Bias, and Operating Life

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the KGD certification was issued. Represents the business event timestamp when the die bank was officially certified as Known Good Die.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the KGD certification expires. After this date, die must be re-certified or scrapped based on shelf-life and storage conditions.
attributes.references: JEDEC Standard for Die Bank Management

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the KGD certification. Externally-known unique code used for traceability and customer communication.
attributes.references: JEDEC Standard for Die Bank Management

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the KGD certification. Indicates whether the certification is active, expired, or has been revoked due to quality issues.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this KGD certification record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: dppm_rate
attributes.description: Calculated defect rate in parts per million for this KGD certification batch. Key quality metric for customer quality agreements and Six Sigma tracking.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability (RAM)

attributes.name: eccn_code

attributes.name: electrical_test_pass_rate_pct

attributes.name: fail_bin_count
attributes.description: Total number of die classified into fail bins (did not meet minimum electrical or functional specifications). Not certified as KGD.
attributes.references: SEMI E142 - Specification for Substrate Tracking

attributes.name: itar_controlled

attributes.name: kgd_grade

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this KGD certification record was last updated. Tracks changes for audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: packaging_application

attributes.name: probe_yield_pct

attributes.references: SEMI E10 - Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability (RAM)

attributes.name: quality_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the certified KGD is currently under quality hold due to suspected reliability issues, customer complaints, or internal quality alerts.

attributes.name: quality_hold_reason

attributes.name: reach_compliant

attributes.description: Indicates whether the certified KGD meets EU REACH Regulation requirements for chemical substance registration and safety.

attributes.name: reliability_screen_result
attributes.description: Result of comprehensive reliability screening tests including temperature cycling, humidity exposure, and electrostatic discharge (ESD) testing.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD47 - Stress-Test-Driven Qualification of Integrated Circuits

attributes.name: remarks

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the certified KGD meets EU RoHS Directive requirements for restriction of hazardous substances (lead, mercury, cadmium, etc.).

attributes.name: test_facility_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the test facility (internal or Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test partner) where KGD certification testing was performed.
attributes.references: SEMI E120 - Specification for Wafer and Die Traceability

attributes.name: test_program_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) test program used for electrical and functional testing during KGD certification.
attributes.references: SEMI E30 - Generic Model for Communications and Control of Manufacturing Equipment (GEM)

products.name: inventory_lot_genealogy
products.description: Association record capturing parent-child relationships between wafer lots, die banks, and finished goods to enable full forward and backward traceability across split, merge, rework, retest, and packaging transformations. Tracks genealogy record ID, parent entity type and ID, child entity type and ID, relationship type (split/merge/rework/retest/package), transformation date, quantity in, quantity out, yield at transformation, process step at split/merge, and operator reference. Supports IATF 16949 traceability, automotive PPAP documentation, customer complaint root cause analysis, and field return investigation.
products.reference: SEMI E90 Substrate Tracking / Lot Genealogy

attributes.name: inventory_lot_genealogy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lot genealogy association record. Primary key for traceability relationships between wafer lots, die banks, and finished goods across manufacturing transformations.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the operator who executed or supervised the transformation operation. Used for training effectiveness analysis and quality investigation.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing equipment that performed the transformation. Links to equipment master data for tool-specific traceability and FMEA analysis.

attributes.name: inventory_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_wafer_lot. Business justification: inventory_lot_genealogy already captures parent/child IDs generically; adding a direct FK to the wafer lot simplifies lineage queries without removing existing generic columns.

attributes.name: automotive_ppap_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automotive Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transformation requires PPAP documentation for automotive customers. True for new products, process changes, or supplier changes affecting automotive-qualified parts.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.3.4.4 Production Part Approval Process

tag_set.value: Automotive Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Required

attributes.name: bin_classification
attributes.description: Bin classification assigned to the child entity after transformation. Identifies pass/fail status and performance grade for Known Good Die (KGD) tracking.

attributes.name: child_entity_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the child entity. References the specific wafer lot, die bank, or finished good that resulted from the transformation process.

attributes.name: child_entity_type
attributes.description: Type of the child entity in the genealogy relationship. Identifies whether the output material is a wafer lot, die bank, or finished good after transformation.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes about the transformation operation. Captures operator observations, special handling instructions, or investigation findings.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the genealogy record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer notification is required for this transformation. True for significant process changes, rework operations, or quality excursions that trigger PCN or customer alert requirements.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility or OSAT partner site where the transformation occurred. Critical for multi-site traceability and supply chain visibility.

attributes.name: genealogy_status
attributes.description: Current status of the genealogy record. Active indicates ongoing transformation, completed indicates finished operation, voided indicates cancelled or reversed transaction, under_investigation indicates quality review in progress.

attributes.name: kgd_status
attributes.description: Known Good Die status of the child entity. Indicates whether the output material has passed all quality gates and is approved for customer shipment or further assembly.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the genealogy record was last updated. Tracks changes to transformation data for compliance and investigation purposes.

attributes.name: lot_traceability_code
attributes.description: Composite traceability code combining parent and child lot identifiers. Used for rapid lookup during customer complaint investigations and field return analysis.

attributes.name: parent_entity_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the parent entity. References the specific wafer lot, die bank, or finished good that served as input to the transformation process.

attributes.name: parent_entity_type
attributes.description: Type of the parent entity in the genealogy relationship. Identifies whether the source material is a wafer lot, die bank, finished good, or raw material before transformation.

attributes.name: pcn_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Product Change Notification associated with this transformation. Links genealogy to formal customer communication for process or material changes.
attributes.references: JEDEC JEP131 Product Change Notification Guidelines

attributes.name: process_step_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing process step code where the transformation occurred. References the specific operation in the process flow (e.g., wafer probe, die saw, wire bond, final test).

attributes.name: process_step_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the manufacturing process step. Provides business context for the transformation operation.

attributes.name: quality_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child entity is under quality hold. True if material is blocked from further processing or shipment pending investigation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7 Control of Nonconforming Outputs

attributes.name: quality_hold_reason
attributes.description: Reason for quality hold if quality_hold_flag is true. Documents the specific quality issue requiring investigation or containment action.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7 Control of Nonconforming Outputs

attributes.name: quantity_in
attributes.description: Quantity of parent entity material consumed in the transformation. Measured in units appropriate to parent entity type (wafers, dies, or packaged units).

attributes.name: quantity_out
attributes.description: Quantity of child entity material produced by the transformation. Measured in units appropriate to child entity type (wafers, dies, or packaged units).

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Type of transformation relationship between parent and child entities. Defines the manufacturing operation that created the genealogy link: split (one-to-many), merge (many-to-one), rework, retest, package, assembly, die attach, wire bond, molding, or singulation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: split|merge|rework|retest|package|assembly|die_attach|wire_bond|molding|singulation — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rework_cycle_count
attributes.description: Number of rework cycles applied to the material. Tracks cumulative rework history for quality risk assessment and customer notification requirements.

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material scrapped during the transformation operation. Used for yield loss analysis and cost accounting.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability

attributes.name: scrap_reason_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the reason for material scrap. Links to defect classification taxonomy for root cause analysis and FMEA.

attributes.name: test_program_version
attributes.description: Version of the test program used during transformation (for retest operations). Critical for correlating test results across genealogy and validating test program changes.

attributes.name: transformation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transformation operation occurred. Critical for forward and backward traceability in automotive PPAP documentation and field return investigations.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for quantity tracking. Specifies whether quantities are counted in wafers, dies, packaged units, kilograms, or liters depending on material type.

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing work order number authorizing the transformation operation. Links genealogy to production planning and scheduling systems.

attributes.name: yield_at_transformation_pct
attributes.description: Yield percentage achieved during the transformation operation. Calculated as (quantity_out / quantity_in) * 100. Critical for process capability analysis and SPC monitoring.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 Specification for Definition and Measurement of Equipment Reliability

products.name: reservation
products.description: Transactional record for inventory allocation and reservation events that earmark specific quantities of WIP lots, die bank dies, raw materials, or finished goods for a designated demand source (customer order, production order, packaging run, engineering sample request). Captures reservation ID, material/lot reference, reserved quantity, UoM, demand source type and ID, reservation date, requested delivery date, priority, reservation status (active/consumed/cancelled/expired), consuming goods_movement reference, and reserving user. Enables ATP (available-to-promise) calculations, prevents double-allocation of scarce KGD inventory, and supports OSAT packaging run scheduling.

domains.name: packaging
domains.description: Die packaging and assembly operations covering all package types including WLCSP, InFO, CoWoS, TSV-based 3D-IC, flip-chip, wire bonding, and traditional leadframe/BGA formats. Manages OSAT partnerships, assembly process flows, substrate BOMs, package qualification, and assembly yield data.

products.name: assembly_order
products.description: Primary transactional record for die packaging and assembly work orders issued to OSAT partners or internal assembly lines. Captures assembly order number, package type (WLCSP, InFO, CoWoS, flip-chip, wire bond, BGA, leadframe), die lot reference, substrate lot, quantity ordered, target ship date, assembly site, process flow revision, and order status lifecycle (released, in-process, completed, on-hold). SSOT for all assembly execution events in the packaging domain. Shipment logistics and delivery tracking are owned by the order domain; cost accounting is owned by the finance domain.

Captures lot number, parent wafer lot reference, die count, package type, assembly site (OSAT vendor), current process step, WIP status (queued, in-process, hold, complete), start/target/actual completion dates, cumulative yield, and hold flags. Central WIP identity that all step records, yield results, inspections, and defects reference. SSOT for assembly lot identity and real-time WIP status within the packaging domain. Equipment asset records are owned by the equipment domain; SPC charting is owned by the quality domain.

Also serves as the authoritative record for scrap quantities and loss reasons within the packaging domain. Feeds assembly yield trending, OSAT scorecard, cost of poor quality (COPQ) analysis, and product cost calculations. Distinct from wafer probe yield (owned by test domain).

products.name: assembly_step_record
products.description: Consolidated transactional record for all assembly process step executions including die attach, wire bonding, flip-chip bumping, molding/encapsulation, TSV formation, underfill, singulation, and marking. Captures step type, lot ID, process parameters (material, temperature, pressure, force profiles as structured data), equipment ID, operator ID, measurement results, inspection outcomes, and pass/fail disposition. Supports full traceability from packaged unit back through every process step. Replaces individual step-level tables with a single flexible entity differentiated by step type.

products.name: risk_assessment

products.name: supplier_scorecard
products.description: Unified supplier performance management, corrective action, and continuous improvement records. Captures periodic scorecard assessments (scoring period, overall rating, on-time delivery rate, incoming quality rejection rate in DPPM, PCN compliance, strategic tier), plus formal Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs) issued for quality escapes, inspection failures, delivery non-conformances, or audit findings. products.name: material_certification
products.description: Supplier-originated material compliance documents including quality certifications and product change notifications. Captures Certificate of Conformance (CoC), Certificate of Analysis (CoA), RoHS compliance declarations, REACH SVHC declarations, TSCA certifications, and Product Change Notifications (PCNs). For certifications: certification type, issuing supplier, material lot number, test results, compliance standard, issue date, expiry date, and document reference. For PCNs: PCN number, supplier, affected material or component, change type (process, material, site, EOL), change description, effective date, impact assessment, required customer notification obligation, and re-qualification decision. SSOT for all supplier-originated material compliance and change documentation within the supply domain. Required for regulatory compliance, incoming quality release, process stability, and customer PCN pass-through obligations.

domains.name: research
domains.description: R&D for next-generation process nodes, novel device architectures (FinFET, GAA, CFET), advanced packaging technologies, materials research, and new IP core development. products.name: research_program
products.description: Master record for R&D programs representing major multi-year technology development initiatives such as next-generation process node development (e.g., 2nm GAA, 1.4nm CFET), advanced packaging platforms, or novel device architecture programs. Captures program charter, technology generation target, strategic objectives, budget envelope, timeline with detailed milestone tracking (milestone name, type, planned/actual dates, completion criteria, gate review outcomes, action items, approving authority), milestone types (technical gates, management reviews, customer demos, tapeout milestones, silicon return, qualification gates), sponsoring business unit, program director, technology readiness level (TRL), and program lifecycle status. SSOT for all R&D program identity, governance, milestone, and gate review data. Supports technology roadmap execution tracking and CHIPS Act program reporting.

attributes.name: planned_completion_date

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the program is scheduled to begin execution (charter approval and resource allocation).

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Relative priority ranking of this program within the R&D portfolio (1=highest priority). Used for resource allocation and executive attention.

attributes.name: program_code

attributes.name: program_name

attributes.name: program_status

attributes.name: program_type

attributes.name: risk_level

attributes.name: strategic_objective

attributes.name: tapeout_milestone_count

attributes.name: target_application_domain

attributes.name: technical_lead_name

attributes.name: technology_generation_target
attributes.description: Target technology node or generation for this program (e.g., '2nm', '1.4nm', 'N3', 'N2'). For non-node programs, describes the technology generation (e.g., 'Gen 5 CoWoS', '3rd Gen GAA').

attributes.name: technology_platform

attributes.name: technology_readiness_level
attributes.description: Current TRL score (1-9) indicating maturity: 1=basic principles, 3=proof of concept, 5=validation in relevant environment, 7=prototype demonstration, 9=actual system proven in production. Aligned with NASA/DOD TRL framework.

products.name: project
products.description: Individual research and development project records within an R&D program. Represents discrete proof-of-concept (PoC) projects, feasibility studies, process integration experiments, materials research efforts, and IP development initiatives. Tracks project scope, objectives, assigned principal investigator, start/end dates, project phase (exploratory, feasibility, development, qualification), funding source, NRE budget allocation, collaboration type (internal, university, consortium), and current project status. Supports PLM integration with Siemens Teamcenter and Oracle Agile PLM.

attributes.description: Total number of photomask layers required to manufacture a complete wafer at this technology node. Increases with node complexity and multi-patterning requirements.

attributes.description: Number of metal interconnect layers available in the BEOL (Back End of Line) stack for this technology node. Typically ranges from 6 to 15+ layers for advanced nodes.

attributes.description: Minimum spacing between metal interconnect lines in the first metal layer, measured in nanometers. Defines routing density.

attributes.name: minimum_feature_size_nm
attributes.description: The smallest feature dimension that can be reliably manufactured at this technology node, measured in nanometers. Critical metric for node classification.

attributes.name: multi_patterning_technique
attributes.description: Advanced lithography technique used to achieve sub-wavelength patterning (e.g., LELE - Litho-Etch-Litho-Etch, SADP - Self-Aligned Double Patterning, SAQP - Self-Aligned Quadruple Patterning). Required for nodes below 20nm with DUV lithography.

products.name: technology_roadmap
products.description: Technology roadmap records defining the multi-year strategic plan for process node progression, device architecture evolution, and advanced packaging capability development. Captures roadmap version, planning horizon, technology milestones, target introduction dates, PPA improvement targets per node generation, key enabling technologies, and roadmap approval status. Includes integrated competitive benchmarking: competitor/foundry performance comparisons (transistor density, drive current, leakage, frequency, power), benchmark sources (public disclosure, teardown analysis, published papers, industry reports), benchmark methodology, confidence levels, benchmark dates, and strategic implication assessments. Supports executive technology strategy, competitive positioning, investment prioritization, and CHIPS Act compliance reporting.
